entries.name: Annihilator Construction
entries.description: Ann(M) = {r: rM = 0}.

entries.name: Integral Closure
entries.description: Expands ring to include monic polynomial roots from fraction field. Geometric: normalization resolving mild singularities.
entries.complexity: Decidable for f.g. algebras over fields

entries.name: Primary Decomposition
entries.description: Lasker-Noether: ideal = intersection of primary ideals. Geometric: irreducible component decomposition.
entries.input: Proper ideal I in Noetherian ring

entries.name: Noether Normalization
entries.description: F.g. k-algebra is finite integral extension of polynomial subring.
entries.output: Polynomial subring k[y_1,...,y_d] with A finite over it

entries.name: Fractional Ideal Construction
entries.description: Group of fractional ideals of integral domain.

entries.name: I-adic Topology Construction
entries.description: Topology on R with I^n as neighborhood basis of 0.

entries.name: Tensor Product of Fields
entries.description: K ⊗_k L. May not be a field.

entries.name: Tensor Product of Algebras
entries.description: A ⊗_k B with componentwise multiplication.

entries.name: Henselization
entries.description: Smallest local extension satisfying Hensel's lemma.

entries.name: Strict Henselization
entries.description: Henselization + separably closed residue field.

entries.name: Projective Resolution
entries.description: ...->P_2->P_1->P_0->M->0. Replaces module with projective complex.
entries.output: Exact sequence of projectives over M

entries.name: Injective Resolution
entries.description: 0->M->I^0->I^1->... Dual of projective resolution.
entries.output: Exact sequence of injectives from M

entries.name: Free Resolution
entries.description: Projective resolution with all free modules. Always exists.
entries.output: Exact sequence of free modules over M

entries.name: Flat Resolution
entries.description: Resolution using flat modules.
entries.output: Exact sequence of flat modules over M

entries.name: Mapping Cone Construction
entries.description: From chain map f, builds Cone(f) detecting quasi-isomorphism.

entries.name: Mapping Cylinder Construction
entries.description: Replaces chain map with homotopy-equivalent inclusion.

entries.name: Koszul Complex Construction
entries.description: From sequence (x_1,...,x_n), builds complex detecting regularity.

entries.name: Derived Functor Application
entries.description: Replaces non-exact F with R^iF or L_iF via resolutions.

entries.name: Left Derived Functor
entries.description: Via projective resolution of right-exact functor.

entries.name: Right Derived Functor
entries.description: Via injective resolution of left-exact functor.

entries.name: Ext Functor
entries.description: R^n Hom(A,-)(B). Ext^1 classifies extensions.
entries.complexity: Polynomial for f.p. modules over polynomial rings

entries.name: Tor Functor
entries.description: L_n(A⊗-)(B). Measures tensor non-exactness.

entries.name: Pushforward
entries.description: f_*F(U) = F(f^{-1}(U)). Pushes sheaf forward along morphism.
entries.input: Morphism f: X->Y + sheaf F on X

entries.name: Derived Pushforward
entries.description: Rf_* via injective resolution. Higher direct images R^if_*.

entries.name: Pullback
entries.input: Morphism f: X->Y + sheaf G on Y

entries.name: Derived Pullback
entries.description: Lf^* for non-flat morphisms.

entries.name: Tensor Product
entries.description: M ⊗_R N. Universal property for bilinear maps.

formal.note: The universal property: a linear map out of the tensor product is determined by its values on pure tensors, and lift realizes each bilinear map.
Right exactness: tensoring an exact sequence ending in a surjection gives an exact sequence.

entries.name: Derived Tensor Product
entries.description: M ⊗^L N via flat resolution.

entries.name: Verdier Duality
entries.description: Poincare duality for singular spaces. Rf_! has right adjoint f^!.

entries.name: Serre Duality
entries.description: H^i(X,F) ≅ H^{n-i}(X, F^∨ ⊗ ω_X)^∨ for smooth projective X.
entries.input: Coherent sheaf F on smooth projective variety

entries.name: Grothendieck Duality
entries.description: Generalizes Serre to proper morphisms. Dualizing complex.

entries.name: Koszul Duality
entries.description: Exchanges quadratic algebra with dual operad.

entries.name: Greenlees-May Duality
entries.description: Local cohomology / completion duality.

entries.name: Pontryagin Duality
entries.description: LCA group G -> dual group G^ of characters. G ≅ G^^.

entries.name: Langlands Duality
entries.description: Conjectural: automorphic reps of G <-> Galois reps of G^L.

entries.name: Spec Construction
entries.description: Ring R -> Spec(R) (prime ideals + Zariski topology + structure sheaf). Algebra-to-geometry bridge.

entries.name: Global Spec Construction
entries.description: Relative Spec for O_S-algebra A.

entries.name: Proj Construction
entries.description: Graded ring -> projective scheme.

entries.name: Affine Cone Construction
entries.description: Projective X -> affine cone C(X).

entries.name: Normalization (geometric)
entries.description: Expands ring to include monic polynomial roots from fraction field. Geometric: normalization resolving mild singularities.

entries.name: Blow-up
entries.description: Replaces a closed subvariety Z (singular or not) by the space of directions pointing out of it, the exceptional divisor. The fundamental birational surgery.

landed.description: Replaces singular locus with projective tangent directions. Fundamental birational surgery.

corrected.reason: Graded imprecise: the landed text says the singular locus, but any closed subvariety can be blown up.

receipts.quote: which replaces a subspace of a given space with the space of all directions pointing out of that subspace.
are the most fundamental transformation in [[birational geometry]]

entries.name: Blowing Down
entries.description: Inverse of blow-up. Contracts exceptional divisor.
entries.input: Variety X + a curve E that is the exceptional curve of a blow-up: on a smooth projective surface, a (-1)-curve (smooth rational, self-intersection -1)

corrected.reason: Graded imprecise: "contractible exceptional" hides the condition. Castelnuovo: a (-1)-curve on a smooth projective surface contracts to a smooth point, and the contraction inverts the blow-up there.

receipts.quote: (which means a smooth [[algebraic curve#rational curves|rational curve]] of [[intersection theory#self-intersection|self-intersection]] number −1)
a (−1)-[[algebraic curve|curve]] on <math>X</math>

entries.conditions: The curve contracted is a (-1)-curve (a smooth rational curve of self-intersection -1) on a smooth projective surface: then it contracts to a smooth point and the contraction is inverse to the blow-up (Castelnuovo). Other curves contract, when they do, to singular points.

conditionReceipts.quote: (which means a smooth [[algebraic curve#rational curves|rational curve]] of [[intersection theory#self-intersection|self-intersection]] number −1)

entries.name: Flip
entries.description: MMP: replaces K-negative curve with K-positive. Preserves smoothness.

entries.name: Flop
entries.description: Like flip for numerically trivial curves.

entries.name: Cremona Transformation
entries.description: Birational automorphism of P^n.

entries.name: Tschirnhaus Transformation
entries.description: Polynomial substitution to eliminate coefficients. Brings quintic to Bring-Jerrard form.

entries.name: Nagata's Compactification
entries.description: Embeds separated scheme as dense open in proper scheme.
entries.input: Separated scheme X of finite type
entries.output: Proper X-bar with X dense open

entries.name: Fiber Product Construction
entries.description: X x_S Y for X->S<-Y.

entries.name: Quotient Stack Construction
entries.description: [X/G] for group action. Captures orbit + automorphism data.

entries.name: Etale Equivalence Relation Quotient
entries.description: Quotient by etale equivalence relation -> algebraic space.
entries.input: Scheme X + etale equiv relation R

entries.name: Induction
entries.description: Rep of subgroup H -> rep of group G. Right adjoint to restriction.

entries.name: Restriction
entries.description: Rep of G restricted to subgroup H. May decompose.

entries.name: Inflation
entries.description: Pulls rep of G/N back to G. N acts trivially.

entries.name: Deflation
entries.description: Pushes rep of G to G/N by averaging over N.

entries.name: Brauer Induction
entries.description: Virtual char = Z-combination of induced chars from elementary subgroups.

entries.name: Bruhat Decomposition
entries.description: G = ⊔ BwB. Borel double cosets indexed by Weyl group.

entries.name: Cartan Decomposition
entries.description: G = KAK. Lie-theoretic generalization of SVD.
entries.preserved: Compact/abelian separated, spectral data in A

entries.name: Iwasawa Decomposition
entries.description: G = KAN. Compact x abelian x nilpotent.

entries.name: Birkhoff Factorization
entries.description: Loop group element = product of holomorphic parts on complement regions.

entries.name: Bialynicki-Birula Decomposition
entries.description: Torus action on smooth proj variety -> cell decomposition by fixed points.

entries.name: GNS Construction
entries.description: State on C*-algebra -> cyclic representation on Hilbert space. Algebra-quantum bridge.

entries.name: Cayley-Dickson Construction
entries.description: Iteratively doubles algebra: R->C->H->O->S. Each step breaks a property.

entries.name: Burnside Ring Construction
entries.description: Grothendieck ring of finite G-sets.

entries.name: Simplicial Set Construction
entries.description: Simplicial set from category/space/algebraic data.

entries.name: Fox Derivative
entries.description: Group ring derivation for combinatorial group theory/knot theory.

entries.name: Adjunction
entries.description: Functors (F,G) with Hom(FA,B) ≅ Hom(A,GB). Universal structural relationship.

entries.name: Vaughan Jones Construction
entries.description: Subfactor -> Jones index + knot polynomial.

entries.name: Strahle Construction
entries.description: Historical geometric construction for musical temperament.

entries.name: Coset Construction
entries.description: G/H: set of cosets.

entries.name: Plus Construction (Quillen)
entries.description: Kills perfect normal subgroup of π_1, preserves homology. Key for algebraic K-theory.

entries.name: Algebraic K-theory Construction
entries.description: K_n(R) from ring R via plus/Q-construction.

entries.name: Stanley-Reisner Ring Construction
entries.description: Simplicial complex Δ -> graded ring k[Δ] = k[x_i]/I_Δ.

entries.name: Ward's Twistor Construction
entries.description: Holomorphic bundle on twistor space -> self-dual Yang-Mills connection.

entries.name: Colombeau's Construction
entries.description: Algebra of generalized functions containing distributions with multiplication.

entries.name: Integral Monoid Ring Construction
entries.description: Z[M] for commutative monoid M.

entries.name: Integral Group Ring Construction
entries.description: Z[G] for group G, convolution multiplication.

entries.name: Eilenberg-Moore Algebra Construction
entries.description: Category of algebras for monad (T,η,μ).

entries.name: Kleisli Category Construction
entries.description: Alternative monad construction: same objects, Kleisli arrows.

entries.name: Lindenbaum-Tarski Algebra
entries.description: Boolean algebra from propositional theory by quotienting by logical equivalence.

entries.name: Buchberger's Algorithm
entries.description: Computes Groebner basis. Reduces multivariate division to deterministic process.
entries.input: Generating set of ideal + monomial ordering
entries.complexity: Doubly exponential worst case; practical often polynomial

entries.name: Wu's Method
entries.description: Automates geometric theorem proving via characteristic sets.

entries.name: Ritt's Algorithm
entries.description: Characteristic set of differential polynomial system.

entries.name: Ritt's Decomposition Algorithm
entries.description: Decomposes characteristic sets into irreducible components.

entries.name: Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition
entries.description: Semi-algebraic set -> cylindrical cells with constant polynomial signs. Quantifier elimination over R.

entries.name: Elimination Theory Reduction
entries.description: Projects polynomial system by eliminating variables.

entries.name: Resultant Computation
entries.description: Single polynomial detecting common root of two polynomials.

entries.name: Discriminant Computation
entries.description: Resultant of f with f'. Detects multiple roots.

entries.name: Pseudodivision
entries.description: Non-standard division for characteristic sets. Works when leading coefficients not invertible.

entries.name: Ore Localization
entries.description: Non-commutative fraction ring for Ore domains.
entries.input: Ring R + Ore multiplicative set S

entries.name: Centralizer Construction
entries.description: C_G(S) = {g: gs=sg for all s in S}.

entries.name: Stone-Cech Compactification
entries.description: Universal compactification of completely regular space.
entries.output: Compact Hausdorff βX with X dense

entries.name: Freudenthal Magic Square
entries.description: 4x4 array of Lie algebras from composition algebra pairs. Produces all exceptional Lie algebras.

entries.name: Similarity Transformation
entries.description: P^{-1}AP. Changes basis. Preserves eigenvalues, det, trace.

entries.name: Dual Curve Construction
entries.description: Curve C -> dual C* parametrizing tangent lines.

entries.name: Parallel Curve Construction
entries.description: Curve at constant normal distance d.

entries.name: Evolute Construction
entries.description: Locus of centers of curvature.

entries.name: Involute Construction
entries.description: Inverse of evolute.

entries.name: Pedal Curve Construction
entries.description: Foot of perpendicular from point P to tangent lines.

entries.name: Negative Pedal Curve
entries.description: Inverse of pedal construction.

entries.name: Homogeneous Coordinate Transformation
entries.description: Affine A^n -> projective P^n via homogeneous coordinates.

entries.name: Zariski Tangent Space Construction
entries.description: Tangent space at point: (m/m^2)*.

entries.name: Kahler Differential Construction
entries.description: Module Ω_{A/k} with universal derivation.

entries.name: Grothendieck Group Construction
entries.description: Monoid -> abelian group by adding inverses.

entries.name: Prym Variety Construction
entries.description: Double cover -> Prym abelian variety.

entries.name: Todd Class Construction
entries.description: Characteristic class td(E) via Chern classes.

entries.name: Hilbert Symbol Construction
entries.description: (a,b)_v detecting local solvability of ax^2+by^2=1.

entries.name: Vector Bundle Construction
entries.description: Transition functions -> vector bundle.

entries.name: Derived Category Construction
entries.description: Abelian category -> derived category by localizing at quasi-isos.

entries.name: Fractional (Mobius) Transformation
entries.description: z -> (az+b)/(cz+d). Conformal auto of Riemann sphere.

entries.name: Monoidal Category Construction
entries.description: Category + tensor + unit + coherence.

entries.name: Adjoint Functor Construction
entries.description: Constructs left/right adjoint via Freyd's theorem.

entries.name: Ischebeck Spectral Sequence
entries.description: Spectral sequence computing Ext via filtration.

entries.name: Serre Subcategory Construction
entries.description: Thick subcategory + quotient category.

entries.name: Socle Filtration
entries.description: Ascending chain Soc^0 ⊆ Soc^1 ⊆ ... decomposing module into simple layers.

entries.name: Radical Operation
entries.description: rad(I) = {r: r^n in I}. Same variety as I.

entries.name: Chinese Remainder Theorem Reduction
entries.description: R/(∩I_j) ≅ ΠR/I_j for coprime ideals.

entries.name: Exact Sequence Construction
entries.description: Constructs sequence with im(f_i) = ker(f_{i+1}).

entries.name: Snake Lemma Construction
entries.description: Diagram with exact rows -> six-term exact sequence with connecting δ.

entries.name: Five Lemma Construction
entries.description: 4 of 5 maps are isos -> fifth is too.

entries.name: Fubini-Study Metric
entries.description: Canonical Kahler metric on CP^n from Hermitian inner product.

entries.name: Covariant Transformation
entries.description: Tensor components transform via Jacobian: T'_i = (∂x^j/∂x'^i)T_j.

entries.name: Contravariant Transformation
entries.description: Tensor via inverse Jacobian: T'^i = (∂x'^i/∂x^j)T^j.

entries.name: Invariant Theory Reduction
entries.description: R^G = {r: g*r=r}. Ring of invariants.

entries.name: Cut-elimination (Gentzen's Hauptsatz)
entries.description: Algorithmically removes all uses of the cut rule from a sequent calculus proof. Reduces cuts on complex formulas to cuts on subformulas until eliminated. Result is analytic: every formula in proof is subformula of conclusion (subformula property). Foundational for consistency proofs.
entries.input: Sequent calculus proof with cut rules
entries.broken: Cut rule applications, proof length (may increase super-exponentially)
entries.complexity: Upper bound: tower of exponentials in proof length; hyper-exponential in general

entries.name: Proof normalization
entries.description: Eliminates deductive detours in natural deduction: consecutive intro-elim pairs for same connective. Yields canonical form. Guarantees logical harmony.
entries.input: Natural deduction proof with intro-elim detours
entries.complexity: Depends on logic; strongly normalizing for typed lambda calculi

entries.name: β-reduction
entries.description: Function application in lambda calculus: (λx.M)N -> M[N/x]. Under Curry-Howard: normalization of proof = execution of program.
entries.broken: Redex structure, term size (may increase temporarily)
entries.complexity: O(1) per step; total steps may be non-elementary

entries.name: η-reduction
entries.description: Function extensionality: λx.Mx -> M when x not free in M. Identifies functions with same extensional behavior.

entries.name: Strong normalization
entries.description: Property that ALL reduction sequences terminate, regardless of strategy. Not itself a transformation but certifies termination of D3-002/003/004.
entries.output: Normal form (guaranteed to exist and be reached)
entries.complexity: Termination bound: depends on type system (primitive recursive for System T, etc.)

entries.name: Proof net reduction
entries.description: Graph-theoretic cut-elimination for linear logic. Operates on proof nets (graph representations) rather than sequent trees. Eliminates syntactic bureaucracy of rule permutations.
entries.complexity: Polynomial in proof net size for multiplicative linear logic

entries.name: Geometry of Interaction (GoI) transformation
entries.description: Dynamic execution-based semantics for linear logic. Models transformations as particle flows/feedback loops in star-autonomous category. Formalizes resource flow during computation.
entries.input: Proof net or linear logic proof
entries.output: Execution trace in GoI algebra (operator algebra on Hilbert space)
entries.broken: Static proof structure (replaced by dynamic execution)

entries.name: External contraction transformation
entries.description: Hypersequent structural rule: contracts identical components across parallel sequent contexts.

entries.name: External weakening transformation
entries.description: Hypersequent structural rule: adds new component to hypersequent context.

entries.name: Communication rule transformation
entries.description: Passes information between parallel deductive contexts in hypersequent calculus. Enables intermediate logic formalization.

entries.name: Deep inference transformation
entries.description: Allows logical rules to apply at any depth within a formula, not just root. Collapses sequent calculus hierarchy.
entries.complexity: Depends on system; polynomial for some fragments

entries.name: Negative translation (general)
entries.description: Embeds classical logic into intuitionistic by inserting double negations. Proves relative consistency: if intuitionistic logic is consistent, so is classical.
entries.preserved: Validity (classical valid iff translated intuitionistically valid), relative consistency

entries.name: Double-negation translation
entries.description: Specific form of negative translation mapping φ to ¬¬φ. Most direct embedding.
entries.preserved: Classical validity iff intuitionistic validity of ¬¬φ

entries.name: Glivenko's translation
entries.description: Maps classical propositional φ to ¬¬φ. Proves: φ classically valid iff ¬¬φ intuitionistically valid (propositional only).

entries.name: Gödel-Gentzen translation
entries.description: Inductive negative translation for first-order logic. Places negations before atoms, disjunctions, and existential quantifiers.

entries.name: Kolmogorov translation
entries.description: Prefixes every subformula with double negation. Most uniform negative translation.

entries.name: Kuroda translation
entries.description: Places ¬¬ only before the body of each universal quantifier. Structural minimization of Kolmogorov.

entries.name: Krivine translation
entries.description: Alternative structural minimization of negative translation. Optimizes for classical realizability.

entries.name: Friedman's A-translation
entries.description: Replaces absurdity ⊥ with arbitrary formula A in negative translation. Enables direct extraction of computational bounds from classical proofs. Crucial for reverse mathematics.

entries.name: Peirce translation
entries.description: Validates Peirce's law ((P→Q)→P)→P in translated system. Maps to call/cc control operator in programming.
entries.preserved: Peirce's law validity, control operator semantics

entries.name: Standard translation (Modal to FOL)
entries.description: Makes possible-worlds semantics explicit: introduces accessibility relation R, maps □φ to ∀w'(Rww'→φ(w')), ◇φ to ∃w'(Rww'∧φ(w')).
entries.output: First-order formula with explicit world variables and R
entries.preserved: Modal validity = FOL validity in frame class

entries.name: Dialectica interpretation (Gödel)
entries.description: Transforms intuitionistic arithmetic (HA) formulas into quantifier-free System T. Extracts realizing functionals rendering constructive content explicit.
entries.output: Quantifier-free formula in System T + witnessing terms
entries.complexity: Extracted functional complexity depends on proof

entries.name: Diller-Nahm interpretation
entries.description: Variant of Dialectica using finite sets instead of precise witnesses. Bypasses decidable equality requirement.
entries.output: Modified Dialectica extraction with finite-set witnesses

entries.name: Kreisel modified realizability
entries.description: Alternative to Dialectica: separates computational and non-computational content of proofs.

entries.name: Bounded functional interpretation
entries.description: Extends Dialectica to extract polynomial/exponential bounds from proofs in analysis. Key tool for proof mining.
entries.output: Explicit numerical bounds on existential witnesses

entries.name: Uniform functional interpretation
entries.description: Variant of functional interpretation with uniformity conditions on extracted functionals.

entries.name: Parametrized functional interpretation
entries.description: Functional interpretation parametrized over choice of witnessing strategy.

entries.name: CPS (Continuation-Passing Style) translation
entries.description: Transforms direct-style program/proof into continuation-passing form. Makes evaluation order and control flow explicit. Under Curry-Howard: classical proof -> constructive proof with continuations.
entries.output: CPS-transformed term (every function takes explicit continuation)

entries.name: Curry-Howard isomorphism mapping
entries.description: Structural correspondence: proofs = programs, propositions = types, normalization = computation. Not a single transformation but a translation principle.

entries.name: Henkin construction
entries.description: Expands theory's signature with Henkin witness constants for every existential formula. Builds canonical term model proving Completeness Theorem.
entries.output: Term model M with M ⊨ T
entries.broken: Specific model structure (canonical, may be non-standard)

entries.name: Skolemization
entries.description: Eliminates existential quantifiers by introducing Skolem function symbols. Produces universal (∀-only) theory. Preserves satisfiability but not equivalence.
entries.broken: Existential quantifiers (replaced by functions), logical equivalence

entries.name: Morleyization
entries.description: Introduces new predicate for every formula. Renders theory quantifier-free in expanded language. Used in stability theory.
entries.output: Quantifier-free theory T^M in expanded language

entries.name: Ultraproduct construction
entries.description: Takes direct product of model family, quotients by ultrafilter. Los's theorem: satisfies exactly the sentences true in 'majority' of factors.
entries.input: Family of structures {M_i}_{i∈I} + ultrafilter U on I

formal.note: Los's theorem: the ultraproduct satisfies a sentence iff U-almost every factor does.

entries.name: Ultrapower construction
entries.description: Ultraproduct where all factors are identical. Generates elementary extensions with non-standard elements.
entries.input: Structure M + ultrafilter U on I

entries.name: Fraïssé limit construction
entries.description: From countable class with amalgamation property, constructs unique countably categorical structure (e.g., random graph, rational linear order).
entries.input: Countable class of finite structures with HP, JEP, AP
entries.broken: Finite structure specifics (unified into single infinite)

entries.name: Vaughtian pair construction
entries.description: Constructs a pair (M, M') where M' is elementary submodel of M with a definable set having different cardinality in the two models.

entries.name: Ehrenfeucht-Mostowski indiscernible extraction
entries.description: Generates models containing long indiscernible sequences (elements that look identical to first-order logic). Projects linear orders/trees into models of unstable theories.
entries.output: Model M(I) with indiscernible sequence indexed by I

entries.name: Saturated model construction
entries.description: Constructs model realizing every type consistent with the theory (maximal richness).
entries.complexity: Requires κ^+ steps; existence requires GCH or large cardinals in general

entries.name: Prime model construction
entries.description: Constructs model omitting all non-isolated types (minimal realization). Exists iff all types over ∅ are isolated.
entries.input: Complete theory T with all types isolated
entries.output: Prime model M (unique up to iso for countable T)

entries.name: Algebraic closure transformation
entries.description: Extends structure by all elements satisfying algebraic formulas with parameters. Generalizes algebraically closed fields to arbitrary theories.

entries.name: Kripke model transformation
entries.description: Constructs Kripke model (partially ordered set of classical worlds) for intuitionistic or modal logic.
entries.output: Kripke structure (W, ≤, V) or (W, R, V)

entries.name: Topological model transformation
entries.description: Models logic using topological spaces: truth = interior of open sets (for intuitionistic), neighborhoods (for modal).

entries.name: Forcing extension (general)
entries.description: Expands ground model M to M[G] by adjoining generic filter G from a poset of forcing conditions. Controls combinatorial/cardinal properties of new universe.
entries.input: Ground model M + forcing poset P
entries.output: Extended model M[G] with G P-generic over M
entries.preserved: ZFC axioms (preserved), ground model M ⊆ M[G]

entries.name: Cohen forcing
entries.description: Adds generic reals via finite partial functions ω -> 2. Proves independence of Continuum Hypothesis from ZFC.
entries.input: Ground model M + Cohen poset (finite partial functions)

entries.name: Random forcing
entries.description: Adds reals avoiding all ground-model null sets (Borel measure zero). Alters measure-theoretic properties without adding Cohen reals.
entries.input: Ground model M + random poset (positive-measure Borel sets)
entries.preserved: ZFC, measure-theoretic properties of new real

entries.name: Sacks forcing
entries.description: Uses perfect trees as conditions. Adds minimal generic reals (minimal degree over ground model).
entries.input: Ground model M + Sacks poset (perfect binary trees)
entries.broken: Turing degree structure (new minimal element added)

entries.name: Namba forcing
entries.description: Changes cofinality of ω_2 to ω without collapsing ω_1. Manipulates cardinal cofinality structure.

entries.name: Prikry forcing
entries.description: Singularizes a measurable cardinal without adding bounded subsets. Requires large cardinal hypothesis.
entries.input: Ground model M + measurable cardinal κ + normal measure
entries.output: M[G] with cf(κ) = ω, κ still cardinal
entries.preserved: ZFC, bounded subsets of κ, κ remains cardinal

entries.name: Radin forcing
entries.description: Generalization of Prikry using measure sequences. Singularizes cardinals with fine control.
entries.input: Ground model M + measure sequence on κ

entries.name: Silver forcing
entries.description: Transforms universe to manipulate Borel conjecture properties.

entries.name: Laver forcing
entries.description: Manipulates ultrafilter structure. Used for Borel conjecture consistency.
entries.input: Ground model M + Laver poset (Laver trees)

entries.name: Mathias forcing
entries.description: Adds real dominating all ground-model reals. Manipulates cardinal invariants (dominating number).
entries.input: Ground model M + Mathias poset (infinite subsets of ω)

entries.name: Amoeba forcing
entries.description: Adds measure-one set containing specific structure. Manipulates covering properties.

entries.name: Hechler forcing
entries.description: Adds dominating real. Directly increases dominating number.

entries.name: Levy collapse
entries.description: Collapses large cardinal to smaller cardinal (e.g., inaccessible -> ω_1). Key for descriptive set theory consistency.
entries.input: Ground model M + Levy collapse poset Col(ω, <κ)
entries.broken: Original cardinal structure (κ no longer large)

entries.name: Grigorieff forcing
entries.description: Generalization of Cohen forcing using functions on arbitrary sets.

entries.name: Jockusch-Soare forcing
entries.description: Computability-theoretic forcing to construct sets with specific Turing degree properties.
entries.input: Ground model + requirements on Turing degrees

entries.name: Easton forcing
entries.description: Product forcing to set the continuum function 2^κ for all regular κ simultaneously, subject to König's theorem constraints.
entries.output: M[G] with 2^κ = E(κ) for all regular κ

entries.name: Vopěnka forcing
entries.description: Forces over HOD (hereditarily ordinal definable sets) to recover the full universe. Connects forcing to definability.

entries.name: Iterated forcing (finite support)
entries.description: Sequentially composes forcing notions with finite support limit. Preserves ccc (countable chain condition). Used for Martin's Axiom.
entries.input: Ground model + sequence of forcing notions + finite support
entries.output: M[G_α: α < κ] with sequential generics

entries.name: Iterated forcing (countable support)
entries.description: Iterated forcing with countable support limit. Preserves properness. Used for PFA.
entries.input: Ground model + proper forcing sequence + countable support

entries.name: Iterated forcing (revised countable support)
entries.description: Hybrid iteration with mixed support. Handles both ccc and proper forcings.
entries.input: Ground model + mixed forcing sequence + RCS

entries.name: Boolean-valued model transformation
entries.description: Algebraic view of forcing: evaluates set-theoretic statements in complete Boolean algebra instead of {0,1}.
entries.input: Ground model M + complete Boolean algebra B

entries.name: Shooting a fast club
entries.description: Forces existence of a club set growing faster than any ground-model function.
entries.output: M[G] with fast club through κ

entries.name: Shooting a club with countable conditions
entries.description: Forces club set using countable approximations.

entries.name: Shooting a club with finite conditions
entries.description: Forces club set using finite approximations.

entries.name: Constructible universe (L) generation
entries.description: Restricts universe to sets definable from below by first-order logic. Proves Con(ZFC) -> Con(ZFC + GCH + AC).

entries.name: Core model construction (general)
entries.description: Extracts maximal inner model not containing specific large cardinals. Calibrates consistency strength.
entries.preserved: ZFC, covering property, weak large cardinal properties

entries.name: Dodd-Jensen core model
entries.description: Core model below one measurable cardinal. K^DJ.

entries.name: Steel core model
entries.description: Core model at level of Woodin cardinals.

entries.name: Core model induction
entries.description: Lifts inner model constructions to higher determinacy axioms using descriptive set theory.
entries.input: Inner model iteration + descriptive set theory

entries.name: Inner model restriction
entries.description: General: restricts universe to sub-universe satisfying specific axioms.

entries.name: Turing reduction
entries.description: Problem A reduces to B if algorithm solves A given oracle for B. Establishes Turing degrees.
entries.input: Decision problem A + oracle for B

entries.name: Many-one reduction
entries.description: Maps instances of A to instances of B via single computable function. A ≤_m B.
entries.output: f mapping A-instances to B-instances with x∈A ↔ f(x)∈B

entries.name: One-one reduction
entries.description: Injective many-one reduction. A ≤_1 B.
entries.input: Decision problem A + injective computable f

entries.name: Truth-table reduction
entries.description: All oracle queries and Boolean evaluation table determined before any oracle call. Total computation regardless of oracle answers.
entries.input: Decision problem A + computable query generator + truth table
entries.output: Algorithm solving A with predetermined B-queries

entries.name: Weak truth-table reduction
entries.description: Bounds maximum value of oracle queries without predetermined truth table.
entries.input: Decision problem A + use-bounded oracle computation
entries.broken: Full adaptivity (queries bounded but table not fixed)

entries.name: Enumeration reduction
entries.description: Maps enumeration of one set to enumeration of another. Operates on positive information only.
entries.output: Enumeration of B from enumeration of A

entries.name: Positive reduction
entries.description: Reduction using only positive information (monotone operator on sets).

entries.name: Disjunctive reduction
entries.description: Oracle queries combined by disjunction only.
entries.output: Algorithm using OR of oracle answers

entries.name: Conjunctive reduction
entries.description: Oracle queries combined by conjunction only.
entries.output: Algorithm using AND of oracle answers

entries.name: Linear reduction
entries.description: Reduction with single non-adaptive oracle query followed by computable postprocessing.

entries.name: Arithmetical reduction
entries.description: Maps definability in arithmetical hierarchy. Evaluates definability over standard model of PA.

entries.name: Hyperarithmetical reduction
entries.description: Extends to analytical hierarchy. Maps definability using quantification over sets of naturals.

entries.name: Relative constructibility reduction
entries.description: Set-theoretic: evaluates whether one set is constructible from another (lies in L[other]).

entries.name: Weihrauch reduction
entries.description: Reduces multi-valued functions on represented spaces. Maps theorem strength analogously to reverse mathematics. Forward/backward computable operators transform instances and solutions.
entries.input: Multi-valued function f on represented space + computable operators
entries.output: f Weihrauch-reducible to g: computable pre/post-processing

entries.name: Strong Weihrauch reduction
entries.description: Weihrauch reduction where forward operator does not depend on the specific instance.
entries.input: Multi-valued function f + uniform forward operator

entries.name: Medvedev reduction
entries.description: Operates on mass problems (subsets of Baire space). A ≤_M B if finding any solution in B suffices to find some solution in A.
entries.output: Computable function mapping B-solutions to A-solutions

entries.name: Muchnik reduction
entries.description: Like Medvedev but non-uniform: for each b∈B there exists computable f with f(b)∈A. Function may depend on b.

entries.name: Polynomial-time reduction
entries.description: Karp (many-one) or Cook (Turing) reduction computable in polynomial time. Defines NP-completeness.
entries.input: Decision problem A + poly-time computable f
entries.output: f mapping A to B in polynomial time

entries.name: Logarithmic-space reduction
entries.description: Reduction using only O(log n) workspace. Defines P-completeness, NL-completeness.
entries.input: Decision problem A + log-space computable f
entries.output: f mapping A to B in log space

entries.name: Parsimonious reduction
entries.description: Preserves exact solution count. Crucial for #P-completeness.

entries.name: Gap-preserving reduction
entries.description: Preserves approximation ratio gap. Establishes PCP theorem / hardness of approximation.

entries.name: Approximation-preserving reduction
entries.description: Maps instances preserving approximation ratio for optimization.

entries.name: Randomized reduction
entries.description: Probabilistic transformation between problems.

entries.name: Fine-grained reduction
entries.description: Establishes exact polynomial lower bounds (e.g., proves Ω(n^2) conditional on SETH).

entries.name: Wadge reduction
entries.description: A ≤_W B via continuous preimage: f continuous with x∈A ↔ f(x)∈B. Topological complexity measure.
entries.input: Set A in Polish space + continuous f

entries.name: Borel reduction
entries.description: Equivalence relation E Borel-reducible to F: Borel f with xEy ↔ f(x)Ff(y). Measures classification complexity.
entries.input: Equivalence relation E on Polish space

entries.name: Lipschitz reduction
entries.description: Wadge reduction with Lipschitz constraint on mapping.

entries.name: Baire reduction
entries.description: Reduction via Baire-class functions (limits of continuous functions).

entries.name: Continuous reduction
entries.description: General continuous reduction on Polish spaces (broader context than Wadge).
entries.input: Equivalence relation or set + continuous f

entries.name: Superamenable reduction
entries.description: Reduction with superamenability constraint.

entries.name: Martin-Monk transformation
entries.description: Maps between determinacy and large cardinal principles.

entries.name: Lindenbaum-Tarski algebraization
entries.description: Quotients formulas by provable equivalence: classical -> Boolean algebra, intuitionistic -> Heyting algebra.
entries.complexity: Decidable for propositional; undecidable for first-order in general

entries.name: Cylindrification
entries.description: Algebraic analogue of existential quantification: maps element of cylindric algebra to its closure under a variable dimension.
entries.input: Element of cylindric algebra + dimension index

entries.name: Neat reduct transformation
entries.description: Restricts high-dimensional cylindric algebra to lower dimension while preserving algebraic operations.
entries.input: Cylindric algebra of dimension α + target dimension β < α

entries.name: Monadic closure
entries.description: Restricts cylindric algebra to monadic (one-variable) fragment.

entries.name: Existential quantification operator mapping
entries.description: Maps existential quantifier to left adjoint of substitution functor in categorical logic.

entries.name: Universal quantification operator mapping
entries.description: Maps universal quantifier to right adjoint of substitution functor.

entries.name: Polyadic substitution transformation
entries.description: Algebraic variable renaming/substitution in polyadic algebra framework.
entries.input: Element of polyadic algebra + substitution map

entries.name: Adjoint functor transformation (logic)
entries.description: Models logical operations (quantifiers, connectives) as adjoint pairs in categorical semantics.

entries.name: Grothendieck topology mapping
entries.description: Generalizes open covers to sites. Maps intuitionistic logic onto sheaf structure.

entries.name: Lawvere-Tierney topology mapping
entries.description: Internal topology on topos: j: Ω -> Ω satisfying idempotence, monotonicity, compatibility with ∧.

entries.name: Yoneda embedding
entries.description: Embeds category C into presheaf category [C^op, Set] via y(A) = Hom(-,A). Objects determined entirely by their morphisms.
entries.output: Full and faithful embedding C -> [C^op, Set]
entries.broken: Small category size (embedded in larger presheaf category)

entries.name: Pullback construction (logic)
entries.description: Categorical pullback in logical context: fiber product interpreting substitution.
entries.input: Morphisms f: A->C, g: B->C in logical category

entries.name: Sheafification
entries.description: Transforms presheaf into sheaf by forcing the gluing axiom. Left adjoint to inclusion of sheaves into presheaves.

formal.note: Sheafification is left adjoint to the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves, given that sheafification exists for the coefficient category (HasWeakSheafify), a hypothesis the entry leaves implicit.

entries.conditions: Sheafification must exist for the coefficient category (Mathlib's HasWeakSheafify): it does for sets and for many concrete categories, and then it is left adjoint to the inclusion of sheaves.

entries.name: Clausification
entries.description: Full pipeline: formula -> Prenex -> Skolemize -> CNF. Prepares for resolution-based ATP.
entries.complexity: Exponential worst case (CNF); linear via Tseitin

entries.name: Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF) transformation
entries.description: Converts propositional/first-order matrix to conjunction of disjunctive clauses.

entries.name: Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) transformation
entries.description: Converts formula to disjunction of conjunctive clauses.

entries.name: Prenex Normal Form transformation
entries.description: Extracts all quantifiers to front: Q_1x_1...Q_nx_n.ψ (prefix + matrix).
entries.output: Prenex form with quantifier prefix and quantifier-free matrix

entries.name: Literal Normal Form transformation
entries.description: De Morgan + negation pushing: negations only on atoms.
entries.output: Formula with negation only at atomic level

entries.name: Miniscoping
entries.description: Pushes quantifiers inward to minimize scope, reducing arity of eventual Skolem functions.

entries.name: De Morgan rule transformation
entries.description: Pushes negation through conjunction/disjunction: ¬(A∧B) -> ¬A∨¬B, etc.
entries.output: Formula with negation at literal level

entries.name: Quantifier shifting
entries.description: Moves quantifiers past connectives when variable is not free in other operand: (∀x.P)∧Q -> ∀x.(P∧Q) when x not free in Q.

entries.name: Tseitin transformation
entries.description: Introduces auxiliary variables to convert formula to CNF in linear size. Avoids exponential blowup of standard distribution.
entries.output: CNF formula φ' with auxiliary variables (equisatisfiable)
entries.broken: Logical equivalence (only equisatisfiable), original variables only

entries.name: Herbrandization
entries.description: Dual of Skolemization: eliminates universal quantifiers. Tests validity rather than satisfiability.

entries.name: Unification
entries.description: Finds most general substitution making two terms identical.
entries.output: Most general unifier σ with σ(t_1) = σ(t_2), or failure
entries.preserved: Most generality (mgu is unique up to renaming)

entries.name: Resolvent generation
entries.description: Produces resolvent clause from two clauses with complementary literals via resolution rule.
entries.input: Clauses C_1, C_2 with complementary literal pair

entries.name: Subsumption reduction
entries.description: Deletes clauses strictly subsumed by (less general than) existing clauses. Optimizes resolution search.
entries.output: Reduced set S' with subsumed clauses removed
entries.complexity: NP-complete for general subsumption check; efficient heuristics exist

entries.name: Tableau branch extension
entries.description: Extends analytic tableau by applying rules to formulas on branches. Systematic search for counterexamples.
entries.input: Tableau with open branches + applicable formula

entries.name: Relational selection
entries.description: Filters tuples satisfying predicate: σ_θ(R).

entries.name: Relational projection
entries.description: Extracts specified attributes: π_{A_1,...,A_k}(R).

entries.name: Relational join (theta join)
entries.description: Merges relations on predicate: R ⋈_θ S.
entries.input: Relations R, S + join predicate θ
entries.output: Joined relation with matching tuple pairs
entries.complexity: O(|R| * |S|) worst case; much better with indexes

entries.name: Left outer join
entries.description: Join preserving all left tuples; nulls for non-matching right.

entries.name: Right outer join
entries.description: Join preserving all right tuples.

entries.name: Full outer join
entries.description: Join preserving all tuples from both sides.

entries.name: Relational aggregation
entries.description: Groups tuples and applies aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, etc.).
entries.input: Relation R + grouping attributes + aggregate function

entries.name: Relational transitive closure
entries.description: Recursively computes reachability in relation (graph closure).

entries.name: Relational renaming
entries.description: Changes attribute names: ρ_{a/b}(R).

entries.name: Cartesian product expansion
entries.description: Computes all tuple combinations: R × S.
entries.output: Product relation R × S with |R|*|S| tuples

entries.name: Bisimulation contraction
entries.description: Merges states with identical observable behavior in transition system. Minimal quotient.
entries.broken: Individual state identity within equivalence classes

entries.name: Hopcroft automaton minimization
entries.description: Computes minimal DFA equivalent to given DFA.

entries.name: Paige-Tarjan algorithmic reduction
entries.description: Computes coarsest partition refinement for relational structures. Foundation of bisimulation algorithms.
entries.preserved: Stability (each block either fully in or fully out of preimage)

entries.name: Quotient interpretation
entries.description: Interprets logical formulas in quotient structure obtained by collapsing equivalent states.

entries.name: Vector semantics embedding
entries.description: Maps words/entities to high-dimensional vectors. NLP transformation.

entries.name: Translation-based entity alignment mapping
entries.description: Models logical relationships as geometric translations (TransE, BetaE, etc.) in continuous vector space.
entries.output: Geometric embedding with h + r ≈ t

entries.name: Arithmetization of syntax (Gödel numbering)
entries.description: Maps logical symbols, formulas, and proofs to natural numbers. Enables formal systems to reason about their own provability.

entries.name: Fourier cosine transform
entries.description: Real symmetric variant: F_c{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)cos(ut)dt. For even functions on [0,inf).

entries.name: Fourier sine transform
entries.description: Antisymmetric variant: F_s{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)sin(ut)dt.

entries.name: Fractional Fourier transform
entries.description: F^alpha: continuous rotation by angle alpha in time-frequency plane. alpha=pi/2 gives standard Fourier.

entries.name: Short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Fourier-Bros-Iagolnitzer transform
entries.description: Phase-space transform for microlocal analysis. Gaussian-windowed Fourier detects wavefront sets.

entries.name: Gabor transform
entries.description: STFT with Gaussian window. Achieves minimum Heisenberg uncertainty product.

entries.name: Hankel transform
entries.description: Kernel: t J_nu(ut) (Bessel function). For cylindrically symmetric functions. Diagonalizes radial Laplacian.

entries.name: Hartley transform
entries.description: Kernel: cas(ut) = cos(ut)+sin(ut). Real-valued, self-inverse.

entries.name: Hermite transform
entries.description: Expansion in Hermite functions H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}. Optimal for Gaussian-weighted L^2.
entries.preserved: Orthogonality in Gaussian-weighted space, quantum oscillator eigenstates

entries.name: Hilbert transform
entries.description: Kernel: 1/(pi(u-t)). Principal value integral. 90-degree phase shift. Constructs analytic signal.
entries.output: Hilbert transform Hf (imaginary part of analytic signal)
entries.preserved: L^2 norm, analytic signal construction, power spectrum

entries.name: Jacobi transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Laguerre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: Laplace transform
entries.description: Kernel: e^{-st}. Maps time domain to complex s-plane. Reduces ODEs to algebraic. F(s) = int_0^inf f(t)e^{-st}dt.
entries.input: Function f(t) on [0,inf) with exponential growth bound

entries.name: Inverse Laplace transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.

entries.name: Two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: The bilateral Laplace transform F(s) = integral over R of f(t) e^{-s t} dt, converging in a vertical strip; contains the Fourier transform on the imaginary axis and the moment generating function.
entries.output: Analytic function F(s) on a strip
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information (invertible within the strip)
entries.broken: Causality information unless the strip is specified

entries.name: Inverse two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: Recovers f from its bilateral Laplace transform by a Bromwich integral along a vertical line inside the strip of convergence.
entries.input: Analytic F(s) and its strip of convergence
entries.broken: Nothing, given the strip; without it the inverse is ambiguous

entries.name: Linear canonical transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Mellin transform
entries.description: Kernel: t^{s-1}. Maps multiplicative to additive: M{f}(s) = int_0^inf f(t)t^{s-1}dt. Scale invariance.
entries.output: M{f}(s) in vertical strip of convergence

entries.name: Inverse Mellin transform
entries.description: f(x) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)x^{-s}ds.

entries.name: Poisson-Mellin-Newton cycle
entries.description: The triangle of correspondences between Poisson generating functions, Mellin transforms and Newton (finite difference) series used in the analysis of algorithms (Flajolet and coauthors): a sequence's asymptotics read from the poles of a Mellin transform via Rice's integrals.
entries.reading: Recorded from memory of the analytic-combinatorics literature.

entries.name: Binomial transform
entries.description: Transforms sequence {a_n} via binomial coefficients: b_n = sum C(n,k)(-1)^k a_k. Self-inverse.

entries.name: Discrete Fourier transform
entries.description: DFT: X_k = sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x_n e^{-2pi ikn/N}. N-point. Assumes periodicity.

entries.name: Fast Fourier transform
entries.description: Cooley-Tukey: divide-and-conquer factorization of DFT matrix into sparse factors. Reduces O(N^2) to O(N log N).
entries.input: Sequence of length N (preferably power of 2)
entries.preserved: Same as DFT (implementation, not mathematically distinct)

entries.name: Discrete cosine transform
entries.description: Expresses a finite real sequence as a sum of cosines at discrete frequencies (DCT-II in common use); concentrates the energy of smooth signals in few coefficients (JPEG).
entries.output: Real coefficient sequence of length N

entries.name: Modified discrete cosine transform
entries.description: A lapped transform on overlapping blocks (2N inputs to N outputs) whose aliasing cancels between neighbors (Princen-Bradley); used in audio codecs.
entries.preserved: Perfect reconstruction with overlap-add (time-domain aliasing cancellation)

entries.name: Discrete Hartley transform
entries.description: Real-valued DFT alternative using cas(x)=cos(x)+sin(x).

entries.name: Discrete sine transform
entries.description: Sine-kernel DFT variant for odd-extension data.

entries.name: Discrete wavelet transform
entries.description: Filter-bank implementation of wavelet analysis. Pyramid algorithm via conjugate mirror filters.

entries.name: Hadamard transform
entries.description: H_N = (1/sqrt(N)) [[H_{N/2}, H_{N/2}],[H_{N/2},-H_{N/2}]]. Recursive +/-1 matrix. = Walsh-Hadamard.
entries.preserved: Parseval, self-inverse (up to scaling), only +/- operations

entries.name: Fast wavelet transform
entries.description: Mallat's algorithm: cascaded low/high-pass filtering + downsampling. O(N) implementation of DWT.

entries.name: Discrete Chebyshev transform
entries.description: Expansion in discrete Chebyshev polynomials on finite set.

entries.name: Finite Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Legendre polynomials P_n on [-1,1].

entries.name: Irrational base discrete weighted transform
entries.description: Specialized number-theoretic transform in irrational base for crypto.

entries.name: Mojette transform
entries.description: Discrete exact Radon on rectangular grid. Redundant projections for fault tolerance.
entries.output: Set of discrete projections along rational slopes

entries.name: Number-theoretic transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Stirling transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence a_k to b_n = sum S(n, k) a_k with Stirling numbers of the second kind; the inverse uses the signed first kind. On exponential generating functions it is composition with e^x - 1.

entries.name: Translation
entries.description: Domain 4 is HOME. Slides figure by displacement vector.

entries.name: Reflection
entries.description: See Domain 4 home entry.

entries.name: Rotation
entries.description: Domain 4 is HOME.

entries.name: Dilation
entries.description: Scaling transformation. Domain 4 is HOME.

entries.name: 0-handle attachment
entries.description: Attaches a 0-handle (n-disk D^n) to begin a handlebody decomposition. Creates a connected component.

entries.name: 0-surgery
entries.description: Surgery on 0-dimensional sphere S^0 x D^n in n-manifold. Connects two components or creates handle.
entries.input: n-manifold M with embedded S^0 x D^n

entries.name: 1-handle attachment
entries.description: Attaches D^1 x D^{n-1} along boundary. Adds a 'tunnel' connecting parts of the boundary.

entries.name: 1-surgery
entries.description: Surgery on S^1 x D^{n-1}. Kills elements of π_1(M).
entries.input: n-manifold M with embedded S^1 x D^{n-1}
entries.output: Surgered manifold M' with simplified π_1

entries.name: 2-handle attachment
entries.description: Attaches D^2 x D^{n-2} along boundary. Adds a 'cap' killing boundary loops.

entries.name: 2-surgery
entries.description: Surgery on S^2 x D^{n-2}. Kills elements of π_2(M).
entries.input: n-manifold M with embedded S^2 x D^{n-2}
entries.output: Surgered manifold M' with simplified π_2

entries.name: k-handle attachment
entries.description: General: attaches D^k x D^{n-k} along S^{k-1} x D^{n-k} in boundary.

entries.name: p-surgery
entries.description: General spherical modification: excise S^p x D^q, glue D^{p+1} x S^{q-1}. Kills π_p elements.
entries.input: n-manifold M with embedded S^p x D^q (p+q=n)

entries.name: n-surgery
entries.description: Surgery in dimension n (general dimension parameter).

entries.name: Abelianization
entries.description: Maps group G to G/[G,G]. Kills commutator subgroup.

entries.name: Aboodh transform
entries.description: Scaled Laplace variant: A{f}(v) = (1/v)int_0^inf f(t)e^{-vt}dt. Simplifies boundary conditions for fractional ODEs.

entries.name: Absolute neighborhood retract construction
entries.description: Space that is retract of every open set of every space it's embedded in.

entries.name: Adams operation
entries.description: Operations ψ^k on K-theory. Ring homomorphisms detecting vector bundle structure.
entries.preserved: Ring homomorphism property, ψ^k ψ^l = ψ^{kl}

entries.name: Adams resolution
entries.description: Tower of fibrations in stable homotopy computing Adams spectral sequence.

entries.name: Adjunction space construction
entries.description: Pushout: glues space Y to X via attaching map f: A -> X. Basis of CW-complex construction.
entries.input: Spaces X, Y + map f: A -> X (A ⊆ Y)

entries.name: Affine transformation
entries.description: See Domain 4 is HOME for geometric transforms.

entries.name: Alexandrov compactification
entries.description: Appends single point at infinity to non-compact space. Minimal compactification.
entries.input: Non-compact locally compact Hausdorff space X
entries.preserved: Local topology of X, compactness achieved

entries.name: Alpha complex construction
entries.description: Simplicial complex from point cloud using Delaunay triangulation restricted by radius parameter.
entries.input: Point cloud P ⊂ R^d + radius α
entries.preserved: Homotopy type of union of balls (nerve theorem)

entries.name: Amalgam construction
entries.description: Amalgamated free product of groups G_1 *_H G_2.
entries.input: Groups G_1, G_2 + common subgroup H

entries.name: Ambient isotopy
entries.description: Continuous deformation of 3-space carrying knot along. Equivalence relation for knots.
entries.output: Equivalent knot K' with ambient isotopy H_t

entries.name: Analytic continuation
entries.description: Extends holomorphic function beyond original domain along paths.
entries.input: Holomorphic function on domain U + path

entries.name: Annulus twist
entries.description: Dehn twist along annulus in knot complement. Local modification of knot.

entries.name: Approximate fibration
entries.description: Map with approximate homotopy lifting. Weaker than fibration.
entries.input: Map p: E -> B with approximate HLP

entries.name: Automorphism
entries.description: Structure-preserving bijection from object to itself.

entries.name: Bäcklund transform
entries.description: Generates new solutions of PDEs from known solutions.
entries.input: Solution u of PDE + Bäcklund equations
entries.output: New solution u' of same (or related) PDE

entries.name: Barycentric subdivision
entries.description: Subdivides simplicial complex by starring at barycenters. Refines triangulation. Preserves homeomorphism type.
entries.output: Subdivided complex K' (same homeomorphism type, finer mesh)
entries.complexity: O(n! per n-simplex) in worst case

entries.name: Basepoint suspension
entries.description: Suspension that preserves basepoint structure.

entries.name: Bateman transform
entries.description: Integral transform solution technique for wave equations.

entries.name: Betti number computation

entries.broken: Specific form values (rotated in form space)

entries.name: Hofer-Zehnder capacity construction
entries.description: Symplectic capacity measuring 'symplectic size' of subsets.

entries.name: Holomorphic coordinate mapping
entries.description: Coordinate change between holomorphic charts on complex manifold.

entries.name: Homeomorphism
entries.description: Continuous bijection with continuous inverse. Isomorphism of topological spaces.

entries.name: Homological algebra spectral sequence
entries.description: General spectral sequence from filtered complex. See also Serre (D4-340).

entries.name: Homotopy coherent nerve
entries.description: Nerve construction for simplicial/∞-categories. Extends ordinary nerve.

entries.name: Homotopy equivalence
entries.description: Map f: X -> Y with homotopy inverse g: Y -> X (fg ≃ id_Y, gf ≃ id_X). Weaker than homeomorphism, stronger than homology equivalence.
entries.preserved: All homotopy groups, homology, cohomology ring

entries.name: Homotopy lifting
entries.description: Lifts homotopy from base to total space of fibration. HLP defines fibrations.
entries.input: Fibration p: E -> B + homotopy H: X×I -> B + initial lift
entries.output: Lifted homotopy H̃: X×I -> E with p∘H̃ = H
entries.broken: Specific lifting choice (not unique in general)

entries.name: Hopf fibration
entries.description: S^1 -> S^3 -> S^2. Fundamental example of non-trivial fiber bundle. Generalizes to S^3 -> S^7 -> S^4 and S^7 -> S^15 -> S^8.
entries.output: Fibration S^{2n+1} -> CP^n with fiber S^1

entries.name: Hough transform
entries.description: Detects geometric shapes in images by mapping points to parameter space.

entries.name: Hurewicz homomorphism
entries.description: h: π_n(X) -> H_n(X). Connects homotopy to homology. Isomorphism in lowest nontrivial dimension (Hurewicz theorem).
entries.preserved: Abelianization for n=1; isomorphism for (n-1)-connected X in degree n

entries.name: Identity morphism
entries.description: id_X: X -> X. Trivial transformation.

entries.name: Immersion
entries.description: Locally injective smooth map with injective differential at every point.
entries.input: Smooth manifold M + ambient N + map f

entries.name: Indiscrete topology construction
entries.description: Trivial topology: only ∅ and X are open.
entries.broken: All separation axioms above T_0, distinguishability

entries.name: Inductive tensor product
entries.description: Locally convex tensor product using inductive limit topology. Largest reasonable tensor topology.
entries.preserved: Bilinear maps to arbitrary locally convex spaces

entries.name: Injective tensor product
entries.description: Tensor product using ε-topology. Smallest reasonable tensor topology.

entries.name: Inner product
entries.description: Positive-definite symmetric bilinear form on vector space. Defines Hilbert/Euclidean structure.

entries.name: Interior operation
entries.description: Maps set to its interior (largest open set contained in it). Dual of closure.
entries.input: Subset A of topological space X

entries.name: Intersection form computation
entries.description: Computes bilinear form on H_2 of 4-manifold from algebraic intersection numbers.
entries.preserved: Unimodular symmetric bilinear form, signature, type

entries.name: Inverse Laplace transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.

entries.name: Inverse mean curvature flow
entries.description: Hypersurface moves outward at speed 1/H (H = mean curvature). Exponential area growth. Proves Riemannian Penrose inequality.
entries.output: Evolved surface Σ(t) with monotone Hawking mass
entries.preserved: Monotonicity of Hawking mass, exponential area growth

entries.name: Inverse Mellin transform
entries.description: f(x) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)x^{-s}ds.

entries.name: Inverse scattering transform
entries.description: Solves nonlinear PDEs (KdV, NLS) by mapping to linear spectral problem.

entries.name: Inversion
entries.description: Map x -> 1/x or geometric inversion in sphere. Conformal in R^n.

entries.name: Irrational base discrete weighted transform
entries.description: Specialized number-theoretic transform in irrational base for crypto.

entries.name: Isometry
entries.description: Distance-preserving bijection. Isomorphism of metric/Riemannian spaces.

entries.name: Isomorphism
entries.description: Structure-preserving bijection. Identity on invariants.

entries.name: J-holomorphic curve evaluation
entries.description: Maps Riemann surface into symplectic manifold via almost-complex structure J. Gromov's non-squeezing theorem.
entries.input: Riemann surface Σ + almost-complex symplectic manifold (M, ω, J)

entries.name: JSJ torus decomposition
entries.description: Cuts irreducible 3-manifold along incompressible tori into atoroidal and Seifert-fibered pieces. Canonical.

entries.name: Jacobi transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Join persistent homology
entries.description: Uses topological join to capture features from varying perspectives.

entries.name: K-theory functor
entries.description: Topological K-theory: K(X) = Grothendieck group of vector bundles. K^0 and K^1. Bott periodicity.
entries.output: K(X) = K^0(X) ring (with K^1 by suspension)
entries.preserved: Ring structure, Bott periodicity, Chern character

entries.name: Koszul duality
entries.description: Exchanges quadratic algebra with dual operad.

entries.name: Krull-Remak-Schmidt-Azumaya decomposition
entries.description: Unique decomposition of module into indecomposables (when applicable).

entries.name: Kuratowski closure axioms
entries.description: Axiomatization of closure operator. Equivalent to specifying a topology.

entries.name: Künneth formula application
entries.description: H_*(X×Y) ≅ H_*(X) ⊗ H_*(Y) (when torsion-free). Computes product space homology.
entries.input: Spaces X, Y with known homology
entries.output: H_*(X×Y) via tensor product + Tor correction

entries.name: L-infinity algebra mapping
entries.description: Homotopy transfer of L∞-algebra structure along chain homotopy equivalence.
entries.input: Chain complex with L∞ structure + homotopy equivalence

entries.name: Laguerre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: Laplace transform
entries.description: Kernel: e^{-st}. Maps time domain to complex s-plane. Reduces ODEs to algebraic. F(s) = int_0^inf f(t)e^{-st}dt.
entries.input: Function f(t) on [0,inf) with exponential growth bound

entries.name: Laplace-Beltrami operator
entries.description: Δ_g = div(grad f) on Riemannian manifold. Generalization of Laplacian. Eigenvalues encode geometry (hear the shape of a drum).
entries.input: Smooth function f on Riemannian manifold (M, g)

entries.name: Laplace-Carson transform
entries.description: Variant of Laplace with modified kernel.

entries.name: Laplace-Stieltjes transform
entries.description: Laplace transform with Stieltjes integral.
entries.input: Cumulative distribution function F (not necessarily differentiable)

entries.name: Lawson topology construction
entries.description: Topology on continuous lattice combining Scott topology and co-Scott topology.

entries.name: Lefschetz fibration
entries.description: Fibration of 4-manifold over surface with isolated singular fibers (Lefschetz singularities). Symplectic structure.

entries.name: Legendre transformation
entries.description: Maps points to hyperplanes and curves to duals. Contact transformation bridging configuration and momentum spaces.
entries.output: Dual contact structure / Legendre dual f*

entries.name: Lens space construction
entries.description: L(p,q) = S^3 / Z_p with specific action. Important family of 3-manifolds.

entries.name: Levelset persistence
entries.description: Persistent homology tracking levelsets {f = c} as c varies.

entries.name: Lie derivative
entries.description: L_X T: derivative of tensor T along flow of vector field X. Measures how tensor changes under flow.
entries.input: Tensor field T + vector field X on manifold
entries.preserved: Leibniz rule, compatibility with exterior derivative

entries.name: Limit and colimit functors
entries.description: Universal construction: limit = generalized intersection, colimit = generalized union in categories.
entries.output: lim D or colim D (universal object)

entries.name: Linear canonical transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Liouville transversal construction
entries.description: Constructs transversal section in Liouville domain for contact/symplectic surgery.

entries.name: Local homeomorphism
entries.description: Map that is a homeomorphism on some neighborhood of each point.
entries.input: Topological spaces X, Y + map f

entries.name: Localization of a space
entries.description: Localizes topological space at a prime p or set of primes. p-local homotopy theory.

entries.name: Localized Jones polynomial
entries.description: Computes Jones polynomial using local skein evaluations.

entries.name: Locally compact space construction
entries.description: Identifies/constructs spaces where every point has compact neighborhood.

entries.name: Long exact sequence derivation
entries.description: From short exact sequence of chain complexes, derives connecting homomorphism and long exact sequence.
entries.input: Short exact sequence 0 -> A_* -> B_* -> C_* -> 0

entries.name: Loop space construction
entries.description: ΩX = Map_*(S^1, X). Points are loops, topology is compact-open. Shifts homotopy: π_n(ΩX) = π_{n+1}(X).

entries.name: Lorentz transformation
entries.description: Linear transformation preserving Minkowski metric η = diag(-1,1,1,1). Isometry group = Lorentz group O(1,3).
entries.preserved: Spacetime interval, causality, speed of light

entries.name: MacLane space formulation
entries.description: Same as Eilenberg-MacLane (D4-116) in different notation.

entries.name: Manifold approximate fibration
entries.description: Map with approximate lifting property between manifolds.

entries.name: Mapper algorithm
entries.description: Applies filter function, covers range, clusters preimages, outputs simplicial complex skeleton.
entries.input: Point cloud X + filter function f + cover of f(X)
entries.preserved: Topological skeleton of data, multi-scale features
entries.complexity: O(n log n) for clustering step

entries.name: Mapping cone construction
entries.description: From chain map f, builds Cone(f) detecting quasi-isomorphism.
entries.landedAs: See Domain 2 (D2-091). Cone(f) from chain map f. Detects quasi-isomorphisms.

entries.name: Mapping cylinder construction
entries.description: Replaces chain map with homotopy-equivalent inclusion.
entries.landedAs: See Domain 2 (D2-092). Replaces map with homotopy-equivalent inclusion.

entries.name: Mapping space construction
entries.description: Constructs space Map(X,Y) of continuous maps with appropriate topology (typically compact-open).
entries.preserved: Continuity of evaluation, exponential adjunction (locally compact X)

entries.name: Marching Cubes algorithm
entries.description: Extracts isosurface from 3D scalar field by processing voxel cubes.

entries.name: Markov conjugation
entries.description: Conjugates braid word: b -> aba^{-1}. Preserves knot type of braid closure.

entries.name: Markov stabilization
entries.description: Adds/removes strand with crossing: β -> βσ_n^{±1}. Preserves knot type of closure.
entries.input: Braid word β on n strands

entries.name: Massey product
entries.description: Higher-order cohomology operation generalizing cup product when cup products vanish. Detects non-formal spaces.
entries.input: Cohomology classes with vanishing pairwise cup products

entries.name: Mathai-Quillen formalism
entries.description: Constructs Thom class representative using Gaussian-shaped forms. Applications in topological field theory.
entries.preserved: Thom class, Euler class via pullback

entries.name: Mayer-Vietoris sequence
entries.description: Long exact sequence from X = A ∪ B: ... -> H_n(A∩B) -> H_n(A) ⊕ H_n(B) -> H_n(X) -> H_{n-1}(A∩B) -> ...
entries.input: Space X = A ∪ B with inclusion maps
entries.preserved: Homology of X from homology of pieces

entries.name: Mean curvature flow
entries.description: Each point of hypersurface moves proportionally to mean curvature vector. Minimizes area. Convex surfaces collapse to spherical point.

entries.name: Metric topology construction
entries.description: Topology generated by open balls of a metric. Metrizable spaces.

entries.name: Metrization
entries.description: Determines whether topological space admits a compatible metric. Urysohn/Nagata-Smirnov theorems.
entries.input: Topological space X satisfying metrization conditions

entries.name: Mixed volume computation
entries.description: Computes mixed volume of convex bodies. Bernstein's theorem: counts mixed volume = solution count for polynomial systems.
entries.input: Convex bodies K_1, ..., K_n in R^n

entries.name: Mod-2 intersection theory
entries.description: Intersection theory with Z/2 coefficients. Avoids orientation issues.

entries.name: Modular operad transformation
entries.description: Transforms modular operad (operad with genus-labeled operations).

entries.name: Mojette transform
entries.description: Discrete exact Radon on rectangular grid. Redundant projections for fault tolerance.
entries.output: Set of discrete projections along rational slopes

entries.name: Monodromy
entries.description: Parallel transport around loop. Measures holonomy/non-triviality of connection/covering.
entries.input: Fiber bundle + connection + loop γ in base
entries.preserved: Group structure of monodromy, topological obstruction

entries.name: Monomorphism
entries.description: Injective morphism (left-cancellative).
entries.input: Objects A, B + injective f: A -> B

entries.name: Moore space construction
entries.description: M(G,n): space with H_n = G and H_k = 0 for k ≠ n. Dual of Eilenberg-MacLane.

entries.name: Morava K-theory
entries.description: Generalized cohomology theory K(n) detecting chromatic level n phenomena.

entries.name: Morse function perturbation
entries.description: Perturbs smooth function to Morse (all critical points non-degenerate). Generic functions are Morse.
entries.output: Morse function f': M -> R (non-degenerate critical points)

entries.name: Multidimensional persistence
entries.description: Persistent homology with multiple filtration parameters simultaneously.
entries.broken: Single-parameter features, complete invariant (no barcode for d>1)

entries.name: Multiscale Gauss linking integral
entries.description: Computes linking number at multiple scales for data analysis.

entries.name: Multiscale Jones polynomial
entries.description: Jones polynomial computed at multiple scales for topological data analysis.

entries.name: N-transform
entries.description: Variant integral transform.

entries.name: Natural transformation
entries.description: Maps between functors: η_X: F(X) -> G(X) commuting with morphisms. Morphisms of functors.
entries.output: Family of morphisms {η_X}_{X ∈ C} with naturality squares

entries.name: Nerve functor
entries.description: Maps category C to simplicial set N(C): n-simplices are composable n-tuples of morphisms.
entries.preserved: Category structure: the nerve functor is fully faithful, so functors between small categories are exactly the maps of their nerves
entries.broken: Nothing: composition is recorded by the 2-simplices. Not every simplicial set is a nerve; the nerves are those satisfying the Segal conditions.

landed.preserved: Category structure (recoverable up to equivalence for nerves of groupoids)

corrected.reason: Preserved graded imprecise (the recovery holds for all small categories, not only groupoids); broken graded wrong (nothing is lost).

receipts.quote: nerveFunctor.fullyfaithful : nerveFunctor.FullyFaithful
does not erase or otherwise disregard morphisms obtained by composition
A simplicial set is the nerve of a category if and only if it satisfies the Segal conditions.

formal.note: The nerve functor from categories to simplicial sets.
The nerve functor is fully faithful on all small categories, so functors between categories are exactly maps of their nerves. The entry's restriction to groupoids is unnecessary.

entries.name: Newton polygon construction
entries.description: Convex hull of exponent points of polynomial. Encodes leading terms, tropicalization.

entries.name: Nielsen transformation
entries.description: Elementary operations on generating sets of groups: swap, invert, multiply generators.

entries.name: Nijenhuis tensor calculation
entries.description: Computes obstruction to integrability of almost-complex structure J.

entries.name: Normal generation
entries.description: Group-theoretic: normal closure of subset generates normal subgroup.

entries.name: Normal map surgery
entries.description: Surgery on normal map (degree-1 map with bundle data). Framework for surgery obstruction theory.

entries.name: Normalized Ricci flow
entries.description: Ricci flow with volume-fixing term: ∂g/∂t = -2Ric + (2r/n)g. Prevents collapse/expansion.
entries.output: Evolved metric g(t) with constant volume

entries.name: Number-theoretic transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Obstruction theory derivation
entries.description: Computes obstructions to extending maps/sections from k-skeleton to (k+1)-skeleton.
entries.input: Partial map on k-skeleton + extension problem

entries.name: One-point compactification
entries.description: Appends single point at infinity to non-compact space. Minimal compactification.
entries.input: Non-compact locally compact Hausdorff space X
entries.preserved: Local topology of X, compactness achieved

entries.name: Open book decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes closed 3-manifold into binding (link) and pages (Seifert-like surfaces). Every closed oriented 3-manifold has one (Giroux correspondence with contact structures).
entries.output: Open book (B, π) with binding and page fibration

entries.name: Operadic bar construction
entries.description: Bar construction B(P) for operad P. Produces cooperad. Koszul duality via B.

entries.name: Order topology construction
entries.description: Topology on totally ordered set generated by open intervals.
entries.preserved: Order structure, connectedness for complete orders

entries.name: Ordinary nerve
entries.description: Simplicial set from category: n-simplices = composable n-tuples. Same as D4-264.
entries.preserved: Category structure (recoverable up to equivalence for nerves of groupoids)

entries.name: Orientation-preserving homeomorphism
entries.description: Homeomorphism preserving local orientation. Mapping class group element.

entries.name: Orthogonal group periodicity
entries.description: Bott periodicity for orthogonal group: π_k(O) repeats with period 8.

entries.name: Outer automorphism group operation
entries.description: Out(G) = Aut(G)/Inn(G). Quotient of automorphisms by inner automorphisms.

entries.name: Paracompact space construction
