entries.description: Verifies/constructs paracompact refinement: every open cover has locally finite open refinement.

entries.name: Parallel transport
entries.description: Moves vectors along curve preserving connection. Path-dependent (curvature measures failure of path-independence).
entries.input: Tangent vector v ∈ T_p M + curve γ from p to q + connection ∇

entries.name: Parameterized knot modeling
entries.description: Models knot as parametric curve in R^3.
entries.output: Smooth parametric curve γ(t) in R^3

entries.name: Pass move
entries.description: Reidemeister Type II move. See D4-324.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local two-strand region

entries.name: Path space construction
entries.description: PX = Map([0,1], X). Total path space. Path fibration PX -> X (evaluation at endpoint) is a fibration with fiber ΩX.
entries.output: Path space PX with fibration PX -> X

entries.name: Path space fibration
entries.description: The fibration PX -> X evaluating paths at endpoint. Fiber is ΩX. Key for loop space theory.
entries.output: Fibration PX -> X with fiber ΩX

entries.name: Perko move
entries.description: Specific transformation proving two knot-table entries are the same knot. Historical correction.

entries.name: Persistence barcode generation
entries.description: Transforms persistence module to barcode: multiset of intervals [birth, death).

entries.name: Persistence diagram formulation
entries.description: Same data as barcode, plotted as multiset of points (birth, death) in R^2.

entries.name: Persistence landscape formulation
entries.description: Functional summary of persistence: sequence of piecewise-linear functions. Allows statistical analysis.
entries.preserved: Statistical properties, L^p norms, functional structure

entries.name: Persistence module derivation
entries.description: Transforms filtered complex to algebraic persistence module via homology functor.

entries.name: Persistence with torsion
entries.description: Persistent homology tracking torsion subgroups, not just free part.
entries.complexity: O(n^3) (Smith normal form at each step)

entries.name: Persistent Betti number computation
entries.description: β_k^{i,j} = rank(H_k(K_i) -> H_k(K_j)). Two-parameter Betti number.
entries.input: Filtered complex + two filtration values i ≤ j

entries.name: Persistent Dirac operator
entries.description: Spectral operator on filtered complex combining boundary and coboundary. Captures both homological and homotopic features.
entries.output: Spectral data from persistent Dirac operator

entries.name: Persistent Hodge Laplacian
entries.description: Discrete Hodge Laplacian applied to persistence framework. Spectral invariants for TDA.
entries.preserved: Spectral topological invariants, Betti numbers (from zero eigenvalue multiplicity)

entries.name: Persistent Khovanov homology
entries.description: Applies Khovanov homology (knot invariant) in persistent setting.

entries.name: Ping-pong lemma construction
entries.description: Criterion for free product decomposition of group action. Uses ping-pong between domains.
entries.input: Group G acting on set X + ping-pong subsets
entries.output: Free product decomposition G ≅ G_1 * G_2

entries.name: Plus construction
entries.description: Quillen: kills perfect subgroup of π_1 preserving homology. See Domain 2 (D2-146).
entries.output: X+ with simplified π_1, same homology

entries.name: Poincaré duality
entries.description: For closed oriented n-manifold: H_k(M) ≅ H^{n-k}(M). Fundamental class [M] mediates via cap product.

entries.name: Pointwise convergence
entries.description: Topology on function space: f_n -> f iff f_n(x) -> f(x) for all x.

entries.name: Poisson bracket
entries.description: {f,g} = ω(X_f, X_g). Lie bracket on smooth functions via symplectic form. Encodes Hamiltonian dynamics.
entries.input: Smooth functions f, g on symplectic manifold (M, ω)
entries.preserved: Lie algebra structure, Jacobi identity, Leibniz rule

entries.name: Poisson surface reconstruction
entries.description: Reconstructs smooth surface from oriented point cloud by solving Poisson equation.

entries.name: Poisson-Mellin-Newton cycle
entries.description: The triangle of correspondences between Poisson generating functions, Mellin transforms and Newton (finite difference) series used in the analysis of algorithms (Flajolet and coauthors): a sequence's asymptotics read from the poles of a Mellin transform via Rice's integrals.
entries.reading: Recorded from memory of the analytic-combinatorics literature.

entries.name: Poke move
entries.description: Reidemeister Type II move variant. See D4-324.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local two-strand region

entries.name: Pontryagin class computation
entries.description: p_i(E) ∈ H^{4i}(X;Z) for real vector bundle. Uses complexification.
entries.preserved: Naturality, cobordism invariant, Hirzebruch signature formula

entries.name: Pontryagin square
entries.description: Secondary operation in cohomology: H^{2n}(X;Z/2) -> H^{4n}(X;Z/4). Refines cup product square.

entries.name: Postnikov square
entries.description: Secondary cohomology operation detecting non-trivial extension in Postnikov tower.

entries.name: Postnikov tower construction
entries.description: Iterative: X -> ... -> X_2 -> X_1 -> X_0 where X_n has π_k = 0 for k > n. Reconstructs X from homotopy groups + k-invariants.

entries.name: Pretzel link formation
entries.description: Constructs pretzel link P(p_1,...,p_n) from twist parameters.

entries.name: Prime decomposition
entries.description: Cuts 3-manifold along essential 2-spheres into prime summands. Unique (Kneser-Milnor).

entries.name: Principal bundle construction
entries.description: Constructs P -> B with structure group G acting freely and transitively on fibers.
entries.input: Base B + group G + transition functions

entries.name: Product topology construction
entries.description: Standard product topology: generated by finite intersections of cylinder sets. Tychonoff theorem holds.
entries.output: Product space ΠX_i with product topology
entries.preserved: Tychonoff theorem (product of compact = compact), projection continuity

entries.name: Projection mapping
entries.description: General: π: X -> Y mapping to quotient/factor/component.

entries.name: Projective transformation
entries.description: Collinearity-preserving map of projective space. See also Domain 1 context.

entries.name: Pullback
entries.landedAs: See Domain 2 (D2-101). f^*G for morphism f.

entries.name: Pushforward
entries.description: f_*F(U) = F(f^{-1}(U)). Pushes sheaf forward along morphism.
entries.landedAs: See Domain 2 (D2-099). f_*F for morphism f.

entries.name: Quasi-isometry
entries.description: Map f: X -> Y with C^{-1}d(x,y)-C ≤ d(f(x),f(y)) ≤ Cd(x,y)+C and f quasi-surjective. Coarse equivalence.

entries.name: Quotient topology construction
entries.description: Identifies points via equivalence relation. Finest topology making quotient map continuous. Universal for gluing.
entries.broken: Individual point identity (equivalenced), separation (may lose Hausdorff)

entries.name: Radon transform
entries.description: Integrates f over hyperplanes: Rf(omega,s) = int_{x.omega=s} f(x)dx. Tomographic reconstruction core.
entries.preserved: Injectivity (for suitable classes), inversion formula, slice theorem

entries.name: Reeb transversal construction
entries.description: Constructs Reeb graph from function on manifold, tracking connected components of level sets.
entries.preserved: Topological type of level set components

entries.name: Reflection
entries.description: See Domain 4 is HOME.

entries.name: Regular homotopy
entries.description: Isotopy through immersions. Classified by Whitney-Graustein theorem (for plane curves) and Smale's theorem (for spheres).

entries.name: Reidemeister Type I move
entries.description: Twist/untwist: add or remove a simple loop (kink) in one strand.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local kink region

entries.name: Reidemeister Type II move
entries.description: Poke/pass: push one strand over/under another creating/removing two crossings.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local two-strand region

entries.name: Reidemeister Type III move
entries.description: Slide: move strand across a crossing of two other strands.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local three-strand region

entries.name: Relative homology functor
entries.description: H_*(X, A) = homology of chain complex C_*(X)/C_*(A). Measures topology of X modulo A.
entries.preserved: Long exact sequence of pair, excision

entries.name: Retraction
entries.description: Map r: X -> A with r∘i = id_A (i: A ↪ X). A is retract of X.
entries.input: Space X + subspace A + retraction r
entries.output: Retract A with r: X -> A
entries.preserved: A as retract, H_*(A) summand of H_*(X)

entries.name: Ricci flow
entries.description: ∂g/∂t = -2Ric(g). Smooths metric by shrinking positive-curvature regions and expanding negative. Perelman: resolves Poincaré conjecture via Ricci flow with surgery.
entries.output: Evolved metric g(t), converging to constant curvature (or developing singularities)

entries.name: Ribbon surgery
entries.description: Surgery along ribbon disk. Preserves fundamental group in specific ways.

entries.name: Riemannian metric tensor mapping
entries.description: Assigns smooth inner product to each tangent space. Defines distances, angles, curvature.

entries.name: Rotation
entries.description: Domain 4 is HOME.

entries.name: Rounding corners
entries.description: Smooths corners of manifold with corners. Converts manifold with corners to smooth manifold.

entries.name: Satellite knot formation
entries.description: Replaces tubular neighborhood of companion knot with pattern link. Constructs satellite knots (e.g., Whitehead doubling).
entries.input: Companion knot K + pattern link L in solid torus

entries.name: Scott topology construction
entries.description: Topology on directed-complete partial order: open sets are upper sets closed under directed suprema.
entries.preserved: Domain-theoretic structure, continuity in domain sense

entries.name: Sectional curvature tracing
entries.description: Computes sectional curvature K(σ) for each 2-plane σ in tangent space.

entries.name: Seifert surface bounding
entries.description: Constructs oriented surface in S^3 bounded by knot. Seifert's algorithm from diagram.

entries.name: Seifert-van Kampen theorem application
entries.description: Computes π_1 of union from π_1 of pieces: π_1(A∪B) = π_1(A) *_{π_1(A∩B)} π_1(B).
entries.input: Space X = A ∪ B with path-connected A, B, A∩B
entries.output: Fundamental group as amalgamated free product

entries.name: Sequence transform
entries.description: General transform on sequences. Umbrella for binomial, Euler, etc.

entries.name: Sequential space construction
entries.description: Topology determined by convergent sequences: set is closed iff sequentially closed.

entries.name: Serre spectral sequence
entries.description: For fibration F -> E -> B: E_2^{p,q} = H^p(B; H^q(F)) => H^{p+q}(E). Computes total space cohomology from base and fiber.
entries.preserved: Convergence to total cohomology, multiplicative structure

entries.name: Shape analysis formulation
entries.description: TDA technique: characterizes topological shape of data.

entries.name: Sheaf cohomology computation
entries.description: Computes derived functor of global sections: H^i(X, F) = R^iΓ(X, F).
entries.preserved: Functoriality, long exact sequences, agrees with Cech for good covers

entries.name: Shear mapping
entries.description: Displaces each point in proportion to its distance from a line. Preserves area in 2D.

entries.name: Shehu transform
entries.description: Generalized Laplace-type: combines Laplace and Sumudu properties.

entries.name: Short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Similarity transformation
entries.description: Distance-preserving up to scale: d(f(x),f(y)) = k*d(x,y). Isometry composed with dilation.

entries.name: Simplicial approximation
entries.description: Approximates continuous map between polyhedra by simplicial map after subdivision.
entries.output: Simplicial g: K' -> L with |g| ≃ f

entries.name: Singular homology functor
entries.description: H_*: Top -> GrAb. Maps space to graded abelian groups via singular simplices. The standard homology theory.

entries.name: Skein transformation (L+)
entries.description: Positive crossing resolution in skein relation. Part of recursive knot polynomial computation.

entries.name: Skein transformation (L-)
entries.description: Negative crossing resolution.

entries.name: Skein transformation (L0)
entries.description: Smoothing resolution: eliminate crossing entirely.

entries.name: Slide move
entries.description: Reidemeister Type III move. See D4-325.
entries.input: Knot diagram with local three-strand region

entries.name: Smash product
entries.description: X ∧ Y = (X × Y)/(X ∨ Y). Pointed tensor product. S^m ∧ S^n = S^{m+n}.

entries.name: Smooth structure assignment
entries.description: Assigns smooth (C^∞) atlas to topological manifold. May not exist or be unique (exotic structures).
entries.broken: Specific smooth structure (non-unique in dim ≥ 7, exotic R^4)

entries.name: Snake lemma derivation
entries.description: From commutative diagram with exact rows, derives connecting map δ and six-term exact sequence.
entries.input: Commutative diagram with exact rows and vertical maps
entries.output: Snake exact sequence with connecting δ

entries.name: Space-filling curve mapping
entries.description: Continuous surjection from [0,1] onto [0,1]^n (Peano, Hilbert). Dimension-increasing continuous map.

entries.name: Spectral sequence
entries.description: General: multi-page algebraic approximation converging to homological invariant. See Serre (D4-340), Adams, Leray, etc.
entries.output: Spectral sequence {E_r, d_r} converging to target

entries.name: Spectrum construction
entries.description: Sequence of spaces {E_n} with ΣE_n -> E_{n+1}. Represents generalized cohomology theories.
entries.input: Sequence of pointed spaces + structure maps

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Spherical modification
entries.description: General term for p-surgery. Excise S^p x D^q, glue D^{p+1} x S^{q-1}.
entries.input: n-manifold M with embedded S^p x D^q (p+q=n)

entries.name: Spin structure formulation
entries.description: Lift of SO(n) frame bundle to Spin(n). Exists iff w_2 = 0. Required for spinor fields.

entries.name: Split interval bounding
entries.description: Technique bounding intervals in TDA or analysis.

entries.name: Splitting lemma derivation
entries.description: Identifies when short exact sequence splits: 0 -> A -> B -> C -> 0 with B ≅ A ⊕ C.
entries.input: Short exact sequence + section or retraction
entries.output: Direct sum decomposition B ≅ A ⊕ C

entries.name: Stable homotopy mapping
entries.description: Maps in stable homotopy category: colim [Σ^n X, Σ^n Y]. Stabilization of homotopy theory.

entries.name: Standard contact structure construction
entries.description: Constructs canonical contact structure ξ_std = ker(dz - y dx) on R^{2n+1}.
entries.preserved: Contact structure, Darboux theorem (locally all contact = standard)

entries.name: Standard symplectic structure construction
entries.description: ω_std = Σ dx_i ∧ dy_i on R^{2n}.

entries.name: Stanley-Reisner ring construction
entries.description: Simplicial complex Δ -> graded ring k[Δ]. Encodes combinatorial topology algebraically.

entries.name: Steenrod power
entries.description: Cohomology operation for odd primes: P^i: H^n(X;Z/p) -> H^{n+2i(p-1)}(X;Z/p). Generates Steenrod algebra at p.
entries.preserved: Steenrod algebra structure, Adem relations, Cartan formula

entries.name: Steenrod square
entries.description: Sq^i: H^n(X;Z/2) -> H^{n+i}(X;Z/2). p=2 case. Sq^0 = id, Sq^n on H^n = cup square.

entries.name: Stereographic projection
entries.description: Projects S^n \ {pt} to R^n conformally. Conformal bijection.

entries.name: Stiefel-Whitney class computation
entries.description: w_i(E) ∈ H^i(X;Z/2) for real vector bundle. Detects orientability (w_1), spin structure (w_2).
entries.preserved: Naturality, Whitney formula, characteristic number formulas

entries.name: Stieltjes transformation
entries.description: S{dmu}(z) = int dmu(t)/(z-t). Cauchy-type transform of measure. Analytic in C \ support(mu).
entries.output: Analytic function S(z) on C \ supp(mu)
entries.preserved: Analyticity, measure recovery via Stieltjes inversion

entries.name: Stone-Cech compactification
entries.description: Universal compactification of completely regular space. Every continuous map to compact Hausdorff extends.
entries.output: Compact Hausdorff βX with X dense

entries.name: Submanifold immersion
entries.description: Immersion whose image is a submanifold. Combines immersion and embedding properties.

entries.name: Submersion
entries.description: Smooth map with surjective differential at every point. Fibers are submanifolds.
entries.input: Smooth map f: M -> N with surjective df_p

entries.name: Subspace topology construction
entries.description: Intersects open sets of ambient space with subset. Induced topology.
entries.broken: Global properties of X outside A

entries.name: Sumudu transform
entries.description: S{f}(u) = (1/u) int_0^inf f(t)e^{-t/u}dt. Laplace variant preserving units and scale.

entries.name: Surface tension flow
entries.description: Evolution driven by surface tension (mean curvature of interfaces in multi-phase systems).
entries.preserved: Volume of each phase (conservation), energy decrease

entries.name: Surgery on a normal map
entries.description: Same context as D4-269 in general surgery obstruction framework.
entries.output: Modified manifold via surgery on normal map

entries.name: Suspension
entries.description: ΣX = X × [0,1] / (X×{0} ∪ X×{1}). Double cone. Shifts homology: H̃_n(ΣX) ≅ H̃_{n-1}(X).
entries.preserved: Reduced homology shifted by 1, Freudenthal theorem

entries.name: Suspension functor
entries.description: Σ as endofunctor on pointed spaces. Iterating gives stable homotopy.

entries.name: Symplectic reduction
entries.description: Marsden-Weinstein: quotients symplectic manifold by Lie group action at level set of moment map. Reduces dimension preserving symplectic structure.
entries.input: Symplectic manifold (M, ω) + Lie group G action + moment map μ
entries.output: Reduced space μ^{-1}(c)/G with induced symplectic form
entries.preserved: Symplectic structure (on quotient), dimension reduced by 2·dim(G)

entries.name: Symplectic round handle attachment
entries.description: Handle attachment compatible with symplectic structure.
entries.input: Symplectic manifold with boundary + round handle data

entries.name: Symplectization
entries.description: Transforms contact manifold to exact symplectic manifold by multiplying by R: (M×R, d(e^t α)).
entries.output: Exact symplectic manifold (M × R, d(e^t α))

entries.name: Symplectomorphism
entries.description: Diffeomorphism preserving symplectic form: φ*ω = ω. = Area-preserving in dim 2.
entries.preserved: Symplectic form, phase volume (Liouville), Hamiltonian structure

entries.name: Tangent bundle construction
entries.description: TM = ⊔_p T_pM. Constructs 2n-dimensional manifold from n-manifold.
entries.preserved: Smooth structure, vector bundle structure, Euler class

entries.name: Tautological one-form mapping
entries.description: θ on T*M: θ_ξ(v) = ξ(dπ(v)). Canonical 1-form on cotangent bundle. dθ = ω (canonical symplectic form).

entries.name: Tensor product
entries.description: M ⊗_R N. Universal property for bilinear maps.
entries.output: Tensor product E ⊗ F (with specified topology)
entries.landedAs: See Domain 2 (D2-103) for algebraic context. Topological tensor products for locally convex spaces.

entries.name: Thom space construction
entries.description: Th(E) = D(E)/S(E). One-point compactification of total space of vector bundle. Thom isomorphism: H̃^*(Th(E)) ≅ H^{*-n}(B).

entries.name: Tietze transformation
entries.description: Elementary operations on group presentations preserving presented group: add/remove generators/relators.

entries.name: Todd class computation
entries.description: td(E) = Π x_i/(1-e^{-x_i}). Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch ingredient.

entries.name: Topologist's sine curve mapping
entries.description: Standard counterexample: connected but not path-connected space.
entries.input: R^2 with graph of sin(1/x) for x>0 and {0}×[-1,1]

entries.name: Topological realization
entries.description: Maps abstract simplicial/combinatorial data to topological space. See also geometric realization (D4-155).

entries.name: Topological tensor product
entries.description: Tensor product of topological vector spaces with specified topology (π, ε, etc.).

entries.name: Tor functor application
entries.description: L_n(A⊗-)(B). Measures tensor non-exactness.

entries.name: Torsion calculation
entries.description: Computes torsion subgroup of homology. Tor_*(H_{n-1}(X), G) appears in universal coefficients.

entries.name: Total singular complex functor
entries.description: Maps space X to simplicial set Sing(X): n-simplices are continuous maps Δ^n -> X. Right adjoint to geometric realization.

entries.name: Trace of a surgery
entries.description: The cobordism W explicitly constructed by a surgery: ∂W = M ⊔ M'.
entries.output: Cobordism W between M and M'

entries.name: Transformation matrix operation
entries.description: Represents linear transformation as matrix and applies it. Standard linear algebra.

entries.name: Translation
entries.description: Domain 4 is HOME. Slides figure by displacement vector.

entries.name: Transversality perturbation
entries.description: Perturbs smooth map to achieve transversality (images cross cleanly). Generic maps are transversal.
entries.input: Smooth map f: M -> N + submanifold W ⊂ N

entries.name: Triangulation
entries.description: Homeomorphism between manifold and simplicial complex. Exists for dim ≤ 3 (Moise); fails for dim ≥ 4 (Casson).

entries.name: Trigenus decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes 3-manifold using trigenus invariant (minimal genus of Heegaard splitting of connected sum with S^1×S^2's).

entries.name: Trivial topology construction
entries.description: Same as indiscrete: only ∅ and X open.

entries.name: Tucker's lemma application
entries.description: Combinatorial analogue of Borsuk-Ulam. Antipodal labeling of triangulated sphere has complementary edge.
entries.input: Antipodally symmetric triangulation of S^n + labeling

entries.name: Twist move
entries.description: Adds full twists to a tangle within knot diagram.

entries.name: Twisting map
entries.description: Modifies fiber bundle by twisting structure group action.

entries.name: Tychonoff topology construction
entries.description: Product topology (same as D4-312). Named for Tychonoff theorem.

entries.name: Ultraproduct
entries.description: Takes direct product of model family, quotients by ultrafilter. Los's theorem: satisfies exactly the sentences true in 'majority' of factors.

entries.name: Universal coefficient theorem mapping
entries.description: Relates H_n(X;G) to H_n(X;Z)⊗G and Tor(H_{n-1}(X;Z), G). Split exact.
entries.input: Homology with Z + coefficient group G

entries.name: Universal cover construction
entries.description: Simply connected covering space X̃ with p: X̃ -> X. π_1(X) acts on X̃.
entries.input: Connected, locally path-connected, semi-locally simply-connected X

entries.name: Upper topology construction
entries.description: Topology on partial order with upper sets as open sets.

entries.name: Vague topology construction
entries.description: Weak-* topology on space of measures.

entries.name: Vector bundle construction
entries.description: Constructs vector bundle from transition functions. See also Domain 2 (D2-184).

entries.name: Vector flow
entries.description: General flow along vector field: dx/dt = V(x). Generates one-parameter group of diffeomorphisms.
entries.preserved: Diffeomorphism (for each t), vector field preservation

entries.name: Vietoris-Rips complex construction
entries.description: Simplicial complex where k-simplex exists iff all pairwise distances ≤ ε. Computationally simpler than Cech.
entries.preserved: Approximates Cech (same homotopy type up to factor 2 in ε)

entries.name: Voronoi decomposition
entries.description: Partitions space into cells nearest to each point. Dual of Delaunay.
entries.complexity: O(n log n) for d=2; O(n^{d/2}) general

entries.name: Wasserstein distance computation
entries.description: L^p matching distance between persistence diagrams. Used in statistical TDA.

entries.name: Watershed transform
entries.description: Image segmentation by topographic analogy: basins of attraction of gradient flow.

entries.name: Wavelet transform
entries.description: = D6-024 (CWT). Primary entry. See also DWT (D6-035).
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Weak Whitney embedding
entries.description: Immersion of n-manifold into R^{2n-1}. Weaker than full embedding.

entries.name: Wedge sum
entries.description: X ∨ Y: union identifying basepoints. Coproduct in pointed category. H̃_n(X ∨ Y) ≅ H̃_n(X) ⊕ H̃_n(Y).

entries.name: Weierstrass transform
entries.description: Gaussian convolution: W{f}(x) = (1/sqrt(4pi)) int f(t)e^{-(x-t)^2/4}dt. Heat equation propagator at t=1.
entries.output: Smoothed function Wf (heat diffusion at t=1)

entries.name: Weinstein's contact surgery
entries.description: Surgery in contact category using Weinstein handle attachments. Preserves Stein/Weinstein filling.

entries.name: Whitehead doubling
entries.description: Replaces tubular neighborhood of knot with Whitehead link pattern. Produces topologically slice knots.

entries.name: Whitehead torsion
entries.description: Algebraic invariant in K_1 detecting non-trivial h-cobordisms. τ(W) = 0 iff W is trivial (s-cobordism theorem).

entries.name: Whitney embedding
entries.description: Embeds n-manifold into R^{2n}. Whitney embedding theorem: every smooth n-manifold embeds in R^{2n}.

entries.name: Whitney trick
entries.description: Removes pairs of intersection points of complementary-dimensional submanifolds in dimension ≥ 5 by constructing Whitney disk.
entries.input: Two submanifolds with algebraically cancelling intersection pair (dim ≥ 5)

entries.name: Willmore flow
entries.description: L^2-gradient flow of Willmore energy ∫H^2 dA. Drives surface toward Willmore surface. Used in sphere eversion.
entries.output: Evolved surface Σ(t), converging to Willmore surface

entries.name: Winding number computation
entries.description: Computes algebraic intersection number of curve with point. Integer-valued topological invariant.
entries.preserved: Topological invariant, homotopy class in π_1(R^2\{p})

entries.name: Wirtinger inequality operation
entries.description: Relates arc length to enclosed area for curves. Variational characterization.

entries.name: X-ray transform
entries.description: Line integrals of function: Xf(L) = int_L f. 1D Radon. Basis of X-ray tomography.
entries.preserved: Line integrability, inversion via filtered backprojection

entries.name: Y-Δ transform
entries.description: Replaces a star subgraph (Y-configuration, K_{1,3}) with a triangle subgraph (Δ-configuration, K_3), preserving electrical resistance and network flow properties. The internal central node is eliminated; the three peripheral nodes become mutually adjacent.
entries.input: Graph G containing a degree-3 vertex v with neighbors {a,b,c}
entries.output: Graph G' with v removed and edges {ab, bc, ac} added (with appropriate resistance weights)
entries.preserved: Electrical resistance between external terminals, network flow properties, external terminal behavior
entries.broken: Internal node structure, vertex count (reduced by 1), edge count (may change), planarity (may be broken)
entries.landedAs: See Domain 1 (D1-012). Graph/network transform. Clone in topological context.

entries.name: Yamabe flow
entries.description: ∂g/∂t = -(R-r)g. Deforms metric toward constant scalar curvature within conformal class.
entries.output: Evolved metric g(t) with constant scalar curvature

entries.name: Yoneda embedding
entries.description: Embeds category C into presheaf category [C^op, Set] via y(A) = Hom(-,A). Objects determined entirely by their morphisms.

entries.name: Zariski topology construction
entries.description: Topology on algebraic variety/scheme where closed sets = zero sets of polynomials. Extremely coarse.

entries.name: Zigzag persistence
entries.description: Persistent homology for sequences with both inclusions and restrictions (forward and backward maps).

entries.name: Abel transform
entries.description: Projects axisymmetric 2D density to 1D line profile via line-of-sight integration. Inverse is Abel inversion.

entries.name: Aboodh transform
entries.description: Scaled Laplace variant: A{f}(v) = (1/v)int_0^inf f(t)e^{-vt}dt. Simplifies boundary conditions for fractional ODEs.

entries.name: Affine transformation
entries.description: See Domain 4 home entry.

entries.name: Algorithmic reduction
entries.description: Maps computational problems via logical derivations in AIT. Formalizes Occam's razor.

entries.name: Anscombe transform
entries.description: Variance-stabilizing for Poisson: Y = 2sqrt(X+3/8). Maps Poisson to approx N(2sqrt(lambda),1).

entries.name: Approximate Message Passing decoding
entries.description: Transforms belief propagation on dense graphs into low-complexity state evolution.

entries.name: Arcsine square root transformation
entries.description: Maps proportions p to arcsin(sqrt(p)). Variance stabilization for binomial near 0,1.

entries.name: Associated Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in associated Legendre functions P_n^m. Spherical domains.

entries.name: Auxiliary receiver approach
entries.description: Genie receiver: provides narrowed codeword list for capacity bounds.

entries.name: Basic extension
entries.description: Extends conjugacy graphs for group theory/crypto.

entries.name: Bateman transform
entries.description: Integral transform for wave equation solutions.

entries.name: Bilinear transform
entries.description: s = (2/T)(z-1)/(z+1). Maps continuous s-plane to discrete z-plane preserving stability boundary. Tustin's method.
entries.preserved: Stability (left half s-plane -> unit disk), frequency warping

entries.name: Bogoliubov transformation
entries.description: Affine transform on creation/annihilation operators producing quasiparticle modes. Diagonalizes quadratic Hamiltonians.

entries.name: Box-Cox transformation
entries.description: Parametric power: y(lam) = (x^lam-1)/lam. MLE for lambda. Maps skewed to Gaussian.

entries.name: Box-Muller transform
entries.description: Exact normal generation: Z0=sqrt(-2ln U1)cos(2pi U2), Z1=sqrt(-2ln U1)sin(2pi U2).

entries.name: Burrows-Wheeler transform
entries.description: Reversible block sorting clustering similar characters. Preprocessing for entropy coding.

entries.name: Backlund transform
entries.description: Generates new solutions of integrable PDEs (KdV, sine-Gordon) from known solutions.
entries.input: Solution u of integrable PDE + Backlund equations
entries.output: New solution u' of same/related PDE

entries.name: Cameron-Martin transformation
entries.description: Quasi-invariance of Wiener measure under Cameron-Martin space translations.
entries.input: Wiener measure + h in CM space

entries.name: Cameron-Martin-Girsanov-Meyer transformation
entries.description: Full Girsanov: changes semimartingale drift via stochastic exponential.

entries.name: Canonical transformation
entries.description: Preserves Hamiltonian and symplectic form. Probabilistic phase space context.

entries.name: Change of variables
entries.description: g(X) with Jacobian: f_Y(y) = f_X(g^{-1}(y))|det J|.
entries.output: Y = g(X) with density via Jacobian

entries.name: Chirplet transform
entries.description: Time-frequency using chirp atoms (frequency-varying).

entries.name: Choi-Jamiolkowski isomorphism
entries.description: Channel <-> state: CPTP map to bipartite density matrix.

entries.name: CPTP map
entries.description: Most general quantum operation. Trace-preserving, completely positive.

entries.name: Conformal transformation
entries.description: Preserves angles but not distances. Includes Möbius transformations on S^n.

entries.name: CNOT gate
entries.description: Two-qubit: flips target iff control=|1>. CNOT|x,y> = |x,x xor y>.

entries.name: Coordinate transformation
entries.description: Change of coordinates on manifold. Transition functions between charts.

entries.name: Cramer's transform
entries.description: Exponential tilting -> rate function via Legendre of cumulant generating function.

entries.name: Cubic transformation
entries.description: x -> x^3 for left-skewed data.

entries.name: Diffeomorphism
entries.description: Smooth bijection with smooth inverse. Isomorphism of smooth manifolds.

entries.name: Discrete Hartley transform
entries.description: Real-valued DFT alternative using cas(x)=cos(x)+sin(x).

entries.name: DsiHT
entries.description: Generates unitaries for quantum circuits, reducing CNOT count.

entries.name: Discrete sine transform
entries.description: Sine-kernel DFT variant for odd-extension data.

entries.name: Discrete wavelet transform
entries.description: Filter-bank implementation of wavelet analysis. Pyramid algorithm via conjugate mirror filters.

entries.name: Displacement transformation
entries.description: Shifts coherent state: D(alpha)|0>=|alpha>. Unitary.

entries.name: Distance transform
entries.description: For each point, computes distance to nearest feature/boundary. Shape analysis.

entries.name: Doob h-transform
entries.description: Conditions Markov process on future via positive harmonic h. p^h(x,y)=h(y)p(x,y)/h(x).

entries.name: Duality transformation
entries.description: High-T <-> low-T in stat mech. Kramers-Wannier for Ising.

entries.name: Equiareal transformation
entries.description: Area-preserving map. In 2D, equivalent to symplectomorphism.

entries.name: Equivalent martingale measure
entries.description: Risk-neutral Q: discounted price is Q-martingale. Derivative pricing foundation.

entries.name: e-connection transform
entries.description: Exponential connection on statistical manifold. Dual to m-connection.

entries.name: Fast Fourier Transform
entries.description: Cooley-Tukey: divide-and-conquer factorization of DFT matrix into sparse factors. Reduces O(N^2) to O(N log N).
entries.input: Sequence of length N (preferably power of 2)
entries.preserved: Same as DFT (implementation, not mathematically distinct)

entries.name: Fast wavelet transform
entries.description: Mallat's algorithm: cascaded low/high-pass filtering + downsampling. O(N) implementation of DWT.

entries.name: Finite Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Legendre polynomials P_n on [-1,1].

entries.name: Fisher transformation
entries.description: r -> z=arctanh(r). Normalizes correlation coefficient.

entries.name: Fourier transform
entries.description: = D6-022 (Continuous Fourier transform). Primary entry.
entries.input: Function f in L^1(R) or L^2(R)
entries.output: Fourier transform f-hat in frequency domain

entries.name: Fourier cosine transform
entries.description: Real symmetric variant: F_c{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)cos(ut)dt. For even functions on [0,inf).

entries.name: Fourier sine transform
entries.description: Antisymmetric variant: F_s{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)sin(ut)dt.

entries.name: Fourier-Bros-Iagolnitzer transform
entries.description: Phase-space transform for microlocal analysis. Gaussian-windowed Fourier detects wavefront sets.

entries.name: Fractional Fourier transform
entries.description: F^alpha: continuous rotation by angle alpha in time-frequency plane. alpha=pi/2 gives standard Fourier.

entries.name: Fractal transform
entries.description: IFS contractions -> self-similar attractor.

entries.name: Gabor transform
entries.description: STFT with Gaussian window. Achieves minimum Heisenberg uncertainty product.

entries.name: Gelfand transform
entries.description: Maps commutative Banach algebra to algebra of continuous functions on maximal ideal space: a -> a-hat.
entries.input: Element a of commutative Banach algebra A

entries.name: Girsanov transformation
entries.description: Changes drift via Radon-Nikodym (stochastic exponential). Paths same, probabilities rescaled.

entries.name: Hadamard transform
entries.description: H_N = (1/sqrt(N)) [[H_{N/2}, H_{N/2}],[H_{N/2},-H_{N/2}]]. Recursive +/-1 matrix. = Walsh-Hadamard.
entries.preserved: Parseval, self-inverse (up to scaling), only +/- operations

entries.name: Hankel transform
entries.description: Kernel: t J_nu(ut) (Bessel function). For cylindrically symmetric functions. Diagonalizes radial Laplacian.

entries.name: Hartley transform
entries.description: Kernel: cas(ut) = cos(ut)+sin(ut). Real-valued, self-inverse.

entries.name: Hermite transform
entries.description: Expansion in Hermite functions H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}. Optimal for Gaussian-weighted L^2.
entries.preserved: Orthogonality in Gaussian-weighted space, quantum oscillator eigenstates

entries.name: Hilbert transform
entries.description: Kernel: 1/(pi(u-t)). Principal value integral. 90-degree phase shift. Constructs analytic signal.
entries.output: Hilbert transform Hf (imaginary part of analytic signal)
entries.preserved: L^2 norm, analytic signal construction, power spectrum

entries.name: Hilbert-Schmidt integral operator
entries.description: The integral operator (K f)(x) = integral k(x, y) f(y) dy with square-integrable kernel; compact, and the kernel's L^2 norm equals the Hilbert-Schmidt norm.
entries.input: Kernel k in L^2(X x Y), function f in L^2(Y)
entries.broken: Invertibility (compact operators on infinite-dimensional spaces are not invertible)

entries.name: Homeomorphism
entries.description: Continuous bijection with continuous inverse. Isomorphism of topological spaces.

entries.name: Hotelling transform
entries.description: = PCA/KLT. Decorrelates multivariate data.

entries.name: Hough transform
entries.description: Maps points to parameter space for detecting geometric shapes (lines, circles).

entries.name: Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation
entries.description: Gaussian integral identity decouples interacting multi-body into independent particles + mean field.

entries.name: Importance sampling
entries.description: E_P[f(X)] via proposal Q weighted by P/Q. Variance reduction.

entries.name: Inverse Laplace transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.

entries.name: Inverse Mellin transform
entries.description: f(x) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)x^{-s}ds.

entries.name: Inverse scattering transform
entries.description: Solves nonlinear integrable PDEs (KdV, NLS) by: (1) compute scattering data, (2) evolve linearly, (3) inverse scatter. Linearizes nonlinear evolution.
entries.output: Solution u(x,t) via linear scattering evolution
entries.preserved: Integrability, soliton structure, infinite conservation laws

entries.name: Inverse transform method
entries.description: F^{-1}(U) where U~Uniform. Exact sampling.

entries.name: Inverse two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: Recovers f from its bilateral Laplace transform by a Bromwich integral along a vertical line inside the strip of convergence.
entries.input: Analytic F(s) and its strip of convergence
entries.broken: Nothing, given the strip; without it the inverse is ambiguous

entries.name: Inversion transformation
entries.description: Inversion in a circle or sphere: x to r^2 (x - c)/|x - c|^2. Maps generalized circles to generalized circles.
entries.input: Point set in the plane or space

entries.name: Irrational base DWT
entries.description: The irrational-base discrete weighted transform (Crandall and Fagin): a weighted FFT that performs multiplication modulo 2^p - 1 without zero padding; used in Mersenne prime searches.

entries.name: Isometry transformation
entries.description: A distance-preserving map; in Euclidean space a composition of translation, rotation and reflection.

entries.name: Jacobi transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Jordan-Wigner transformation
entries.description: Spin-1/2 chain <-> spinless fermions via nonlocal string operators. Structural isomorphism.

entries.name: Karhunen-Loeve transform
entries.description: Data-dependent optimal orthogonal: basis=covariance eigenvectors. Minimum MSE truncation.

entries.name: Koszul connection transform
entries.description: Maps vector sections on statistical manifold to differential 1-forms.

entries.name: Kraus representation
entries.description: CPTP as operator sum: Phi(rho)=Sum A_k rho A_k_dag.

entries.name: Krichevsky-Trofimov compression
entries.description: Maps correlated adjacency matrices to approx i.i.d. submatrices via Dirichlet priors.

entries.name: Laguerre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: Lamperti transform
entries.description: Converts multiplicative SDE noise to additive: Y=integral dx/sigma(x).

entries.name: Laplace transform
entries.description: Kernel: e^{-st}. Maps time domain to complex s-plane. Reduces ODEs to algebraic. F(s) = int_0^inf f(t)e^{-st}dt.
entries.input: Function f(t) on [0,inf) with exponential growth bound

entries.name: Laplace-Carson transform
entries.description: sF(s) variant of Laplace. Historical operational calculus.

entries.name: Laplace-Stieltjes transform
entries.description: Laplace with Stieltjes integral: int e^{-st} dF(t). For CDFs without continuous density.
entries.input: Cumulative distribution function F (not necessarily differentiable)

entries.name: Laplace's method
entries.description: Asymptotic: integral e^{nf(x)}dx approx e^{nf(x0)}*sqrt(2pi/(-nf''(x0))). Isolates maximum.

entries.name: Legendre transform
entries.description: Convex conjugate: f*(p)=sup{px-f(x)}. Cumulant->rate function in probability.

entries.name: Legendre-Fenchel transformation
entries.description: Generalized Legendre for non-smooth: f*(y)=sup{<x,y>-f(x)}. Links large deviations, thermodynamics, convex optimization.

entries.name: Linear canonical transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Linear rescaling
entries.description: Y=aX+b. Shifts mean, scales variance.

entries.name: Logarithm transformation
entries.description: Y=log(X). Right-skew correction, linearizes growth.

entries.name: Mellin transform
entries.description: Kernel: t^{s-1}. Maps multiplicative to additive: M{f}(s) = int_0^inf f(t)t^{s-1}dt. Scale invariance.
entries.output: M{f}(s) in vertical strip of convergence

entries.name: Metropolis-Hastings
entries.description: MCMC: propose, accept/reject via detailed balance. Converges to target.

entries.name: Mixed-volume inequality transformation
entries.description: Maps Gaussian process supremum to packing numbers. Relay capacity bounds.

entries.name: Mojette transform
entries.description: Discrete exact Radon on rectangular grid. Redundant projections for fault tolerance.
entries.output: Set of discrete projections along rational slopes

entries.name: Multiplicative inverse transformation
entries.description: Y=1/X. Reciprocal.

entries.name: m-connection transform
entries.description: Mixture connection on statistical manifold. Dual to e-connection.

entries.name: Mobius transformation
entries.description: (az+b)/(cz+d), ad-bc != 0. Conformal auto of Riemann sphere. Preserves circles/lines.

entries.name: N-transform
entries.description: Variant integral transform.

entries.name: Number-theoretic transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Partial trace
entries.description: Reduces multipartite quantum state to marginal: rho_A=tr_B(rho_AB).

entries.name: Partial transpose
entries.description: Transposes one subsystem. Positivity failure=entanglement (Peres-Horodecki).

entries.name: Pauli X gate
entries.description: sigma_x: |0><->|1>. Quantum NOT. Discrete involution, not rotation.

entries.name: Pauli Y gate
entries.description: sigma_y: combined bit+phase flip.

entries.name: Pauli Z gate
entries.description: sigma_z: phase flip |0>->|0>, |1>->-|1>.

entries.name: Perspective transform
entries.description: Projective mapping of images/coordinates via homography matrix.

entries.name: Power transformation
entries.description: Y=X^alpha. General power family.

entries.name: Principal component transform
entries.description: Projects onto covariance eigenvectors. = KLT for discrete data.

entries.name: Projective transformation
entries.description: Collinearity-preserving map of projective space. See also Domain 1 context.

entries.name: Quantile-parameterized distribution
entries.description: Fits flexible distribution to empirical quantiles.

entries.name: Quantum Fourier Transform
entries.description: QFT on n qubits: computational -> frequency basis. Core of Shor's. Exponentially faster than FFT.

entries.name: R-extension
entries.description: Extends conjugacy graphs. Companion to D5-010.

entries.name: Radon transform
entries.description: Integrates f over hyperplanes: Rf(omega,s) = int_{x.omega=s} f(x)dx. Tomographic reconstruction core.
entries.preserved: Injectivity (for suitable classes), inversion formula, slice theorem

entries.name: Random binning
entries.description: Groups outputs into random bins for distributed hypothesis testing.

entries.name: Rectangular mask STFT
entries.description: Short-time Fourier transform with a rectangular (boxcar) window: the Fourier transform of each windowed segment.
entries.preserved: Energy up to window normalization; invertibility with sufficient overlap
entries.broken: Frequency resolution (sidelobe leakage from the sharp window)

entries.name: Rejection sampling
entries.description: Proposal g >= f/M, accept with prob f(x)/(Mg(x)). Exact.
entries.input: Target f + proposal g + bound M

entries.name: Reservoir sampling
entries.description: Uniform sample of size k from unknown-length stream.

entries.name: Rotation gate Rx
entries.description: e^{-i theta X/2}. Continuous x-axis Bloch rotation.

entries.name: Rotation gate Ry
entries.description: e^{-i theta Y/2}. y-axis rotation.

entries.name: Rotation gate Rz
entries.description: e^{-i theta Z/2}. z-axis phase rotation.

entries.name: Semilinear transformation
entries.description: Vector spaces over finite fields preserving algebraic topology. Public-key crypto.

entries.name: Sequence transform
entries.description: General: maps sequence {a_n} to {b_n}. Umbrella for binomial, Euler, Stirling, etc.

entries.name: Shehu transform
entries.description: Generalized Laplace-type: combines Laplace and Sumudu properties.

entries.name: Shift transformation
entries.description: Left-shift sigma({x_n})={x_{n+1}}. Stationarity = measure invariance.

entries.name: Short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Similarity transformation
entries.description: Distance-preserving up to scale: d(f(x),f(y)) = k*d(x,y). Isometry composed with dilation.

entries.name: Simple random sampling
entries.description: Equal selection probability. Foundation of survey sampling.

entries.name: Soft-max lower bounding
entries.description: Approximates convex set by bounded-vertex polytope.

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Square root transformation
entries.description: Y=sqrt(X). Variance stabilization for Poisson-like.

entries.name: Stallings' fold
entries.description: Merges redundant automaton edges preserving language.

entries.name: Stallings' procedure
entries.description: Iterates folds to core graph.

entries.name: Stieltjes transformation
entries.description: S{dmu}(z) = int dmu(t)/(z-t). Cauchy-type transform of measure. Analytic in C \ support(mu).
entries.output: Analytic function S(z) on C \ supp(mu)
entries.preserved: Analyticity, measure recovery via Stieltjes inversion

entries.name: Stinespring representation
entries.description: CPTP as unitary on enlarged space: Phi(rho)=tr_E(V rho V_dag). Irreversibility = ignorance of environment.
entries.output: Isometry V: H -> H x H_E

entries.name: Stirling transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence a_k to b_n = sum S(n, k) a_k with Stirling numbers of the second kind; the inverse uses the signed first kind. On exponential generating functions it is composition with e^x - 1.

entries.name: Sumudu transform
entries.description: S{f}(u) = (1/u) int_0^inf f(t)e^{-t/u}dt. Laplace variant preserving units and scale.

entries.name: SWAP gate
entries.description: Exchanges qubits: SWAP|a,b>=|b,a>. Three CNOTs.

entries.name: Systematic sampling
entries.description: Every k-th item from random start.

entries.name: Time-change transformation
entries.description: Replaces time with continuous stopping time. Any cont. local martingale = time-changed BM (DDS).

entries.name: Transformation of drift
entries.description: Girsanov applied: removes/modifies SDE drift.

entries.name: Two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: The bilateral Laplace transform F(s) = integral over R of f(t) e^{-s t} dt, converging in a vertical strip; contains the Fourier transform on the imaginary axis and the moment generating function.
entries.output: Analytic function F(s) on a strip
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information (invertible within the strip)
entries.broken: Causality information unless the strip is specified

entries.name: Unitary transformation
entries.description: U_dag U = I. Only reversible quantum op on isolated system.

entries.name: Walsh-Hadamard transform
entries.description: Recursive +1/-1 matrix. Sequency analysis. Only addition/subtraction needed.
entries.preserved: Sequency decomposition, O(N log N) with no multiplication

entries.name: Watershed transform
entries.description: Topographic segmentation by basin-of-attraction of gradient flow.

entries.name: Wavelet transform
entries.description: = D6-024 (CWT). Primary entry. See also DWT (D6-035).
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Weierstrass transform
entries.description: Gaussian convolution: W{f}(x) = (1/sqrt(4pi)) int f(t)e^{-(x-t)^2/4}dt. Heat equation propagator at t=1.
entries.output: Smoothed function Wf (heat diffusion at t=1)

entries.name: X-ray transform
entries.description: Line integrals of function: Xf(L) = int_L f. 1D Radon. Basis of X-ray tomography.
entries.preserved: Line integrability, inversion via filtered backprojection

entries.name: Y-Delta transform
entries.description: Replaces a three-terminal star (Y) network by an equivalent triangle (Delta) with the same behavior at the terminals; in graph theory, a Y-Delta exchange.
entries.input: Electrical network or graph with a degree-3 vertex
entries.output: Network with a triangle replacing it

entries.name: Z-transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence x_n to X(z) = sum x_n z^{-n}, converging in an annulus; the discrete analogue of the Laplace transform.
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information within the region of convergence
entries.broken: Causality information unless the region is specified

entries.name: Abel transform
entries.description: Projects axisymmetric 2D density to 1D line profile via line-of-sight integration. Inverse is Abel inversion.

entries.name: Aboodh transform
entries.description: Scaled Laplace variant: A{f}(v) = (1/v)int_0^inf f(t)e^{-vt}dt. Simplifies boundary conditions for fractional ODEs.

entries.name: Affine transformation
entries.description: See Domain 4 home.

entries.name: Aluthge transform
entries.description: tilde-T = |T|^{1/2} U |T|^{1/2} for T = U|T|. Moves operator toward normality. Preserves spectrum.
entries.input: Operator T with polar decomposition T=U|T|

entries.name: Associated Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in associated Legendre functions P_n^m. Spherical domains.

entries.name: Atangana-Baleanu fractional integral
entries.description: Non-singular, non-local kernel based on Mittag-Leffler function. Modern fractional calculus for dissipative systems.

entries.name: Backlund transform
entries.description: Generates new solutions of integrable PDEs (KdV, sine-Gordon) from known solutions.
entries.input: Solution u of integrable PDE + Backlund equations
entries.output: New solution u' of same/related PDE

entries.name: Baker's transformation
entries.description: Cuts unit square in half, stretches, restacks. Canonical model of deterministic chaos. Bernoulli system.
entries.preserved: Lebesgue measure, ergodicity, mixing, Bernoulli property

entries.name: Bandelet transform
entries.description: Adapts wavelet to image geometry by following edges. Optimal sparsity for C^2 edge curves.
entries.output: Bandelet coefficients adapted to edge flow
entries.preserved: Near-optimal approximation rate for edge images

entries.name: Bargmann transform
entries.description: Maps L^2(R^n, Gaussian) to Fock-Bargmann space of entire functions. Segal-Bargmann transform.
entries.output: Entire function in Fock space F^2

entries.name: Bateman transform
entries.description: Integral transform for wave equation solutions.

entries.name: Berezin transform
entries.description: Maps operator to function on complex domain via reproducing kernel: tilde-A(z) = <Ak_z, k_z>/<k_z,k_z>.

entries.name: Bilinear transform
entries.description: s = (2/T)(z-1)/(z+1). Maps continuous s-plane to discrete z-plane preserving stability boundary. Tustin's method.
entries.preserved: Stability (left half s-plane -> unit disk), frequency warping

entries.name: Borel functional calculus
entries.description: Maps bounded measurable function g to operator g(A) for normal A via spectral measure. Extends continuous functional calculus.
entries.input: Normal operator A + bounded Borel function g

entries.name: Box-Muller transform
entries.description: Exact normal generation: Z0=sqrt(-2ln U1)cos(2pi U2), Z1=sqrt(-2ln U1)sin(2pi U2).

entries.name: Brushlet transform
entries.description: Windowed Fourier basis adapted to tiling of frequency axis. For texture analysis.

entries.name: Burrows-Wheeler transform
entries.description: Burrows-Wheeler: reversible block sort clustering similar characters. HOME here for algorithmic implementation.
entries.output: Last column of sorted rotation matrix + index
entries.preserved: Reversibility, character clustering for entropy coding

entries.name: Cayley transform
entries.description: C(A) = (A-iI)(A+iI)^{-1}. Maps unbounded self-adjoint to unitary. Bijection between self-adjoint and unitary (minus I eigenspace).

entries.name: Chacon transformation
entries.description: Uniquely ergodic rank-one transformation. Weak mixing but NOT strong mixing.

entries.name: Chirplet transform
entries.description: Time-frequency using chirp atoms (frequency-varying).

entries.name: Choi's theorem on CP maps
entries.description: Characterizes completely positive maps via Choi matrix positivity.
entries.output: Choi matrix C_Phi = sum Phi(E_ij) x E_ij

entries.name: Continuous Fourier transform
entries.description: int f(t)e^{-2pi iut}dt. Kernel: complex exponential. Maps L^1/L^2 to spectral domain. Plancherel isometry on L^2.
entries.input: Function f in L^1(R) or L^2(R)
entries.output: Fourier transform f-hat in frequency domain
entries.complexity: O(n log n) via FFT for discrete; formal integral for continuous

entries.name: Continuous functional calculus
entries.description: Isometric *-isomorphism: C(sigma(A)) -> C*(A,I) for normal A. Maps continuous functions to operators.
entries.input: Normal operator A + continuous function g on spectrum

entries.name: Continuous wavelet transform
entries.description: Maps signal against scaled/translated mother wavelet psi: W_f(a,b) = int f(t) psi*((t-b)/a) dt/sqrt(a). Multiresolution: high freq -> short window, low freq -> long window.
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Contourlet transform
entries.description: Laplacian pyramid + directional filter bank. 2D sparse representation for contours/edges.

entries.name: Coordinate change transformation
entries.description: General change of coordinates. Jacobian formula.

entries.name: Curvelet transform
entries.description: Parabolic scaling (width ~ length^2). Optimal for curved singularities in 2D. Sparse where wavelets are not.
entries.preserved: Near-optimal approximation for C^2 curves, parabolic scaling

entries.name: Derivative operator
entries.description: d/dx: maps differentiable function to its derivative. Unbounded on L^2.

entries.name: Dilation transformation
entries.description: Scales about a center by a factor k: x to c + k (x - c).
entries.broken: Size (lengths scale by k, areas by k^2)

entries.name: Directional derivative
entries.description: D_v f(x) = lim_{t->0} (f(x+tv)-f(x))/t. Derivative along direction v.

entries.name: Directionlet transform
entries.description: Integer-lattice directional wavelet using affine shear instead of rotation. Preserves digital grid.

entries.name: Discrete Fourier transform
entries.description: DFT: X_k = sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x_n e^{-2pi ikn/N}. N-point. Assumes periodicity.
entries.complexity: O(N^2) direct; O(N log N) via FFT

entries.name: Discrete Hartley transform
entries.description: Real-valued DFT alternative using cas(x)=cos(x)+sin(x).

entries.name: Discrete sine transform
entries.description: Sine-kernel DFT variant for odd-extension data.

entries.name: Discrete wavelet transform
entries.description: Filter-bank implementation of wavelet analysis. Pyramid algorithm via conjugate mirror filters.

entries.name: Discrete-time Fourier transform
entries.description: DTFT: X(omega) = sum x_n e^{-i omega n}. Periodic in omega. For infinite discrete sequences.

entries.name: Distance transform
entries.description: For each point, computes distance to nearest feature/boundary. Shape analysis.

entries.name: Divergence operator
entries.description: div F = sum partial F_i/partial x_i. Measures source/sink density of vector field.

entries.name: Duggal transform
entries.description: Reversed polar: |T|U (vs Aluthge's |T|^{1/2}U|T|^{1/2}).

entries.name: Fast Fourier transform
entries.description: Cooley-Tukey: divide-and-conquer factorization of DFT matrix into sparse factors. Reduces O(N^2) to O(N log N).
entries.input: Sequence of length N (preferably power of 2)
entries.preserved: Same as DFT (implementation, not mathematically distinct)

entries.name: Fast wavelet transform
entries.description: Mallat's algorithm: cascaded low/high-pass filtering + downsampling. O(N) implementation of DWT.

entries.name: Finite Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Legendre polynomials P_n on [-1,1].

entries.name: Fourier transform
entries.description: = D6-022 (Continuous Fourier transform). Primary entry.
entries.input: Function f in L^1(R) or L^2(R)
entries.output: Fourier transform f-hat in frequency domain

entries.name: Fourier cosine transform
entries.description: Real symmetric variant: F_c{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)cos(ut)dt. For even functions on [0,inf).

entries.name: Fourier sine transform
entries.description: Antisymmetric variant: F_s{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)sin(ut)dt.

entries.name: Fourier-Bros-Iagolnitzer (FBI) transform
entries.description: Phase-space transform for microlocal analysis. Gaussian-windowed Fourier detects wavefront sets.

entries.name: Fractal transform
entries.description: Iterated function system encoding. Self-similar decomposition.

entries.name: Fractional Fourier transform
entries.description: F^alpha: continuous rotation by angle alpha in time-frequency plane. alpha=pi/2 gives standard Fourier.

entries.name: Fractional integral transform
entries.description: General framework for non-integer-order integration. Interpolates between function and antiderivatives.

entries.name: Framelet transform
entries.description: Wavelet frame (redundant, overcomplete) decomposition.

entries.name: Functional calculus for unbounded operators
entries.description: Extends functional calculus to unbounded self-adjoint operators via spectral theorem.
entries.input: Unbounded self-adjoint A + Borel function g

entries.name: Funk transform
entries.description: Integral transform on S^n: integrates function over great circles. Spherical Radon.
entries.output: Function on space of great circles

entries.name: Gabor transform
entries.description: STFT with Gaussian window. Achieves minimum Heisenberg uncertainty product.

entries.name: Gelfand transform
entries.description: Maps commutative Banach algebra to algebra of continuous functions on maximal ideal space: a -> a-hat.
entries.input: Element a of commutative Banach algebra A

entries.name: GNS construction
entries.description: State on C*-algebra -> cyclic representation on Hilbert space. Abstract algebra -> concrete operators.
entries.output: (H_phi, pi_phi, Omega_phi): Hilbert space + *-rep + cyclic vector

entries.name: Generalized Aluthge transform
entries.description: Lambda-Aluthge: |T|^lambda U |T|^{1-lambda}. Parameterized by lambda in [0,1].

entries.name: Gradient operator
entries.description: grad f = (partial f/partial x_1, ..., partial f/partial x_n). Direction of steepest ascent.
entries.preserved: Direction of steepest ascent, fundamental theorem of calculus

entries.name: Grouplet transform
entries.description: Adapts wavelet to geometric grouping of data. For images with complex geometry.

entries.name: Hadamard fractional integral
entries.description: Logarithmic kernel: (1/Gamma(alpha)) int_a^t (log t/tau)^{alpha-1} f(tau) dtau/tau. For ultra-slow diffusion.

entries.name: Hadamard transform
entries.description: H_N = (1/sqrt(N)) [[H_{N/2}, H_{N/2}],[H_{N/2},-H_{N/2}]]. Recursive +/-1 matrix. = Walsh-Hadamard.
entries.preserved: Parseval, self-inverse (up to scaling), only +/- operations

entries.name: Halpern iteration
entries.description: x_{n+1} = lambda_n u + (1-lambda_n)Tx_n. Anchor point u ensures strong convergence.
entries.preserved: Strong convergence, minimal norm fixed point

entries.name: Hankel transform
entries.description: Kernel: t J_nu(ut) (Bessel function). For cylindrically symmetric functions. Diagonalizes radial Laplacian.

entries.name: Hartley transform
entries.description: Kernel: cas(ut) = cos(ut)+sin(ut). Real-valued, self-inverse.

entries.name: Helffer-Sjostrand formula
entries.description: Functional calculus via almost-analytic extensions: f(A) = -(1/pi) int (del-bar tilde-f)(z)(z-A)^{-1} dz. Avoids spectral measures.
entries.input: Self-adjoint A + smooth function f + almost-analytic extension

entries.name: Hermite transform
entries.description: Expansion in Hermite functions H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}. Optimal for Gaussian-weighted L^2.
entries.preserved: Orthogonality in Gaussian-weighted space, quantum oscillator eigenstates

entries.name: Hessian transformation
entries.description: Matrix of second partial derivatives: H_ij = d^2f/dx_i dx_j. Characterizes curvature/convexity.

entries.name: Hilbert transform
entries.description: Kernel: 1/(pi(u-t)). Principal value integral. 90-degree phase shift. Constructs analytic signal.
entries.output: Hilbert transform Hf (imaginary part of analytic signal)
entries.preserved: L^2 norm, analytic signal construction, power spectrum

entries.name: Hitsuda-Skorokhod integral
entries.description: Extension of Ito integral to anticipating (non-adapted) integrands using Malliavin calculus.
entries.preserved: Extends Ito to non-adapted, adjoint of Malliavin derivative

entries.name: Holomorphic functional calculus
entries.description: Riesz-Dunford: f(A) = (1/2pi i) oint f(z)(zI-A)^{-1} dz. For non-normal operators in Banach algebras.
entries.input: Banach algebra element A + holomorphic f on neighborhood of spectrum

entries.name: Horizontal shift transformation
entries.description: g(x) = f(x+c). Function-level horizontal translation. See D5-006.

entries.name: Hough transform
entries.description: Maps points to parameter space for detecting geometric shapes (lines, circles).

entries.name: Inverse Fourier transform
entries.description: f(t) = int f-hat(u) e^{2pi iut} du. Recovery from spectral domain.

entries.name: Inverse Laplace transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.
entries.complexity: N/A analytical; O(N log N) numerical

entries.name: Inverse Mellin transform
entries.description: f(x) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)x^{-s}ds.

entries.name: Inverse scattering transform
entries.description: Solves nonlinear integrable PDEs (KdV, NLS) by: (1) compute scattering data, (2) evolve linearly, (3) inverse scatter. Linearizes nonlinear evolution.
entries.output: Solution u(x,t) via linear scattering evolution
entries.preserved: Integrability, soliton structure, infinite conservation laws

entries.name: Irrational base discrete weighted transform
entries.description: Specialized number-theoretic transform in irrational base for crypto.

entries.name: Ito integral
entries.description: int H dX for semimartingale X, predictable H. Left-endpoint evaluation. Preserves martingale property but breaks chain rule (requires Ito's lemma).
entries.broken: Classical chain rule (replaced by Ito's lemma)

entries.name: Jacobi transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Jacobian transformation
entries.description: Matrix of all first partial derivatives. Encodes local linear approximation.
entries.preserved: Local linear approximation, chain rule, change-of-variables determinant

entries.name: Joukowsky transformation
entries.description: Circle -> airfoil shape: w = z + 1/z. Conformal. Foundation of aerodynamic lift calculation.

entries.name: Kakutani skyscraper
entries.description: Induced transformation stacking subsets over base, tracking return times (Poincare recurrence).
entries.output: Induced transformation on A with return time function
entries.preserved: Measure-preserving property on A, Poincare recurrence

entries.name: Karman-Trefftz transformation
entries.description: Generalizes Joukowsky: non-zero trailing edge angle. More realistic airfoil.
entries.output: Airfoil with specified trailing edge angle

entries.name: Kontorovich-Lebedev transform
entries.description: Kernel: K_{i tau}(x) (Macdonald/modified Bessel of 2nd kind). For conical/hyperbolic geometries.
entries.preserved: Spectral decomposition for Helmholtz in conical geometry

entries.name: Krasnoselskii-Mann iteration
entries.description: x_{n+1} = (1-lambda)x_n + lambda T(x_n). Blends operator with identity for convergence of non-expansive maps.
entries.output: Sequence converging weakly to fixed point

entries.name: Laguerre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: Laplace transform
entries.description: Kernel: e^{-st}. Maps time domain to complex s-plane. Reduces ODEs to algebraic. F(s) = int_0^inf f(t)e^{-st}dt.
entries.input: Function f(t) on [0,inf) with exponential growth bound
entries.complexity: N/A analytical; O(N log N) numerical

entries.name: Laplace-Carson transform
entries.description: sF(s) variant of Laplace. Historical operational calculus.

entries.name: Laplace-Stieltjes transform
entries.description: Laplace with Stieltjes integral: int e^{-st} dF(t). For CDFs without continuous density.
entries.input: Cumulative distribution function F (not necessarily differentiable)

entries.name: Lebedev-Skalskaya transform
entries.description: Variant of Kontorovich-Lebedev for specific boundary conditions.

entries.name: Lebesgue decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes measure mu = mu_ac + mu_sc + mu_pp into absolutely continuous, singular continuous, and pure point parts.
entries.input: Measure mu relative to reference nu

entries.name: Legendre transform
entries.description: f*(p) = sup_x{px - f(x)}. Convex conjugate. Involution on convex functions.

entries.name: Lifting scheme transformation
entries.description: Factorization of wavelet into lifting steps. In-place computation, custom wavelet design.

entries.name: Linear canonical transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Malliavin derivative
entries.description: Directional derivative in Cameron-Martin space (RKHS of Gaussian measure). Foundation of stochastic calculus of variations.
entries.input: Random variable F in D^{1,2} (Malliavin Sobolev space)
entries.preserved: Chain rule, integration by parts (Malliavin IBP)
entries.broken: Pointwise derivative (no classical derivative for BM)

entries.name: Malliavin integral transform
entries.description: Combines Malliavin derivative with Skorokhod integral for stochastic sensitivity analysis.

entries.name: Marcinkiewicz interpolation
entries.description: Real method: sublinear operators bounded on weak L^{p_0} and L^{p_1} are bounded on L^p for p in (p_0,p_1).
entries.input: Sublinear operator T + weak-type bounds at endpoints

entries.name: Marcus integral
entries.description: Stochastic integral for jump processes preserving Wong-Zakai-type approximation by piecewise smooth paths.

entries.name: Mean transform
entries.description: Maps operator to (T+T*)/2 or similar averaging.

entries.name: Mehler-Fock transform
entries.description: Kernel: P_{-1/2+i tau}(x) (Legendre function of complex degree). Hyperbolic geometries.
entries.preserved: Spectral decomposition for Laplacian on hyperboloid

entries.name: Mellin transform
entries.description: Kernel: t^{s-1}. Maps multiplicative to additive: M{f}(s) = int_0^inf f(t)t^{s-1}dt. Scale invariance.
entries.output: M{f}(s) in vertical strip of convergence

entries.name: Mobius transformation
entries.description: (az+b)/(cz+d), ad-bc != 0. Conformal auto of Riemann sphere. Preserves circles/lines.

entries.name: Mojette transform
entries.description: Discrete exact Radon on rectangular grid. Redundant projections for fault tolerance.
entries.output: Set of discrete projections along rational slopes

entries.name: Moreau-Yosida regularization
entries.description: Smooths lower-semicontinuous convex f via inf-convolution with quadratic: M_lambda f(x) = inf_u{f(u) + (1/2lambda)||u-x||^2}.
entries.input: Proper lsc convex function f + parameter lambda
entries.output: Moreau envelope M_lambda f (smooth, Lipschitz gradient)

entries.name: N-transform
entries.description: Variant integral transform.

entries.name: Naimark's dilation
entries.description: Any POVM can be dilated to PVM on larger Hilbert space. Lifts unsharp measurements to sharp.
entries.output: PVM {P_i} on K with E_i = V*P_iV, V: H->K isometry

entries.name: Newland transform
entries.description: Harmonic wavelet with exact frequency-band localization.

entries.name: Number-theoretic transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Ogawa integral
entries.description: Non-causal stochastic integral allowing future-dependent integrands.

entries.name: Penrose transform
entries.description: Twistor theory: sheaf cohomology on twistor space -> solutions of massless field equations on Minkowski spacetime.
entries.input: Cohomology class on projective twistor space
entries.output: Solution of zero-rest-mass field equation on M^4

entries.name: Perspective transform
entries.description: Projective mapping of images/coordinates via homography matrix.

entries.name: Picard iteration
entries.description: x_{n+1} = T(x_n). Converges for strict contractions (Banach fixed-point theorem).

entries.name: Picard-Krasnoselskii hybrid
entries.description: Combines Picard and Krasnoselskii-Mann for non-linear Fredholm integral equations.

entries.name: Proximal mapping
entries.description: prox_f(x) = argmin_u{f(u) + (1/2)||u-x||^2}. Infinite-dim generalization of projection. Foundation of proximal algorithms.
entries.input: Proper lsc convex f + point x
entries.complexity: Depends on f; O(N) for many structured f

entries.name: Pullback of a distribution
entries.description: Maps distribution across diffeomorphism via duality: <phi*u, psi> = <u, |det Dphi| psi o phi^{-1}>.
entries.input: Distribution u in D'(V) + diffeomorphism phi: U->V
entries.preserved: Change of variables formula, distributional structure

entries.name: Pushforward of a distribution
entries.description: Dual: pushes distribution forward via phi_*u = (phi^{-1})*u for diffeomorphism phi.

entries.name: Radon transform
entries.description: Integrates f over hyperplanes: Rf(omega,s) = int_{x.omega=s} f(x)dx. Tomographic reconstruction core.
entries.preserved: Injectivity (for suitable classes), inversion formula, slice theorem

entries.name: Radon-Nikodym decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes measure mu = mu_ac + mu_s relative to reference nu. mu_ac has density (RN derivative), mu_s is singular.
entries.preserved: Measure decomposition, density existence for ac part

formal.note: mu = singular part + nu.withDensity (Radon-Nikodym derivative), given that a Lebesgue decomposition exists.
The singular part is mutually singular with nu.
The decomposition exists when mu is s-finite and nu is sigma-finite. The entry's input ("measures mu, nu") omits this hypothesis.

entries.conditions: The decomposition mu = mu_ac + mu_s with a density for mu_ac exists when mu is s-finite and nu is sigma-finite (in Mathlib, these hypotheses supply the Lebesgue decomposition instance). Without them it can fail.

entries.name: Reassignment method
entries.description: Non-linearly sharpens time-frequency representation by moving energy to center of gravity.

entries.name: Reflection transformation
entries.description: Reflects across a line or hyperplane: an involutive isometry reversing orientation.

entries.name: Regularization of a distribution
entries.description: Convolves singular distribution with smooth mollifier sequence: u_epsilon = u * phi_epsilon -> u in D'.
entries.output: Smooth functions u_epsilon converging weakly to u

entries.name: Ridgelet transform
entries.description: Maps lines to points: optimal for detecting straight singularities in R^n. Radon + 1D wavelet.
entries.preserved: Optimal for straight edges, Radon-wavelet factorization

entries.name: Riemann-Liouville fractional integral
entries.description: J^alpha f(t) = (1/Gamma(alpha)) int_a^t (t-tau)^{alpha-1} f(tau) dtau. Foundation of fractional calculus.
entries.broken: Integer initial conditions (problematic for RHS BVPs)

entries.name: Riesz-Dunford calculus
entries.description: = Holomorphic functional calculus (D6-069). Alternative name.
entries.input: Banach algebra element A + holomorphic f on neighborhood of spectrum

entries.name: Riesz-Thorin interpolation
entries.description: Complex method: operators bounded on L^{p_0} and L^{p_1} are bounded on all L^{p_theta} between.
entries.input: Linear operator T bounded on L^{p_0} and L^{p_1}
entries.output: Bound on L^{p_theta} for theta in [0,1]

entries.name: Rotation transformation
entries.description: Square transform: y = x^2.

entries.name: S-transform (Stockwell)
entries.description: Hybrid STFT-wavelet: frequency-dependent window scaling like CWT but absolute phase like STFT.
entries.complexity: O(N^2) direct; O(N log N) FFT-based

entries.name: Schwarz-Christoffel mapping
entries.description: Conformal map from upper half-plane/disk to polygon interior. Kernel encodes exterior angles.
entries.input: Upper half-plane or unit disk + polygon vertex angles

entries.name: Segal-Bargmann transform
entries.description: = Bargmann transform (D6-010). Explicit isometry L^2(R^n, Gaussian) -> holomorphic L^2(C^n, Gaussian).
entries.output: Entire function in Fock space F^2

entries.name: Sequence transform
entries.description: General: maps sequence {a_n} to {b_n}. Umbrella for binomial, Euler, Stirling, etc.

entries.name: Shearlet transform
entries.description: Anisotropic directional transform using shear instead of rotation. Preserves digital lattice. Optimal for edges.
entries.preserved: Anisotropy, optimal sparsity for edge singularities, digital lattice

entries.name: Shehu transform
entries.description: Generalized Laplace-type: combines Laplace and Sumudu properties.

entries.name: Short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Sinusoidal mapping
entries.description: z -> sin(z). Conformal where sin'(z) != 0.

entries.name: Skorokhod integral
entries.description: Adjoint of Malliavin derivative. Extends Ito integral to non-adapted integrands. delta(u) = int u dW - int D_t u dt.
entries.preserved: Adjointness with Malliavin derivative, extends Ito

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Spherical symmetrization
entries.description: Radial rearrangement: level sets become concentric spheres.
entries.output: Spherically symmetric rearrangement f* or K*

entries.name: Stationary wavelet transform
entries.description: Translation-invariant (undecimated) DWT. Redundant but shift-invariant.
entries.output: Undecimated wavelet coefficients at each level

entries.name: Steiner symmetrization
entries.description: Reflects compact set to be symmetric about hyperplane. Preserves volume, decreases perimeter. Iterated across orthogonal planes -> converges to ball.
entries.input: Compact set K in R^n + hyperplane

entries.name: Stieltjes transformation
entries.description: S{dmu}(z) = int dmu(t)/(z-t). Cauchy-type transform of measure. Analytic in C \ support(mu).
entries.output: Analytic function S(z) on C \ supp(mu)
entries.preserved: Analyticity, measure recovery via Stieltjes inversion

entries.name: Stinespring dilation
entries.description: Any CP map phi: A -> B(H) has form phi(a) = V*pi(a)V for *-homomorphism pi on larger K, isometry V: H->K. Linearizes CP maps.
entries.output: *-homomorphism pi on K + isometry V with phi(a)=V*pi(a)V
entries.broken: Irreversibility (shown to be compression of reversible)

entries.name: Stratonovich integral
