entries.description: Midpoint evaluation: int X circ dY = int X dY + (1/2)[X,Y]. Preserves classical chain rule. Preferred in physics/geometry.
entries.output: Stratonovich integral int X circ dY
entries.preserved: Classical chain rule, coordinate-free on manifolds

entries.name: Sumudu transform
entries.description: S{f}(u) = (1/u) int_0^inf f(t)e^{-t/u}dt. Laplace variant preserving units and scale.

entries.name: Synchrosqueezing transform
entries.description: Invertible sharpening of CWT: squeezes energy along frequency axis to extract instantaneous frequencies.

entries.name: Sz.-Nagy's dilation
entries.description: Every contraction T (||T||<=1) on Hilbert space dilates to unitary U on larger space: T^n = P_H U^n |_H.
entries.output: Unitary U on K with T^n = compression of U^n
entries.preserved: Contraction -> unitary dilation, von Neumann inequality

entries.name: Translation transformation
entries.description: Shifts every point by a fixed vector.

entries.name: Undecimated wavelet transform
entries.description: = Stationary wavelet transform (D6-137). Alternative name.
entries.output: Undecimated wavelet coefficients at each level

entries.name: Vertical shift transformation
entries.description: g(x) = f(x) + c. Vertical translation of function graph.

entries.name: Walsh-Hadamard transform
entries.description: Recursive +1/-1 matrix. Sequency analysis. Only addition/subtraction needed.
entries.preserved: Sequency decomposition, O(N log N) with no multiplication

entries.name: Watershed transform
entries.description: Topographic segmentation by basin-of-attraction of gradient flow.

entries.name: Wavelet packet decomposition
entries.description: Full binary tree decomposition: applies both low and high-pass at every level (not just approximation).
entries.output: Full wavelet packet tree of coefficients

entries.name: Wavelet transform
entries.description: = D6-024 (CWT). Primary entry. See also DWT (D6-035).
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Wedgelet transform
entries.description: Piecewise constant edge approximation on dyadic squares. Optimal for binary images with smooth boundaries.

entries.name: Weierstrass transform
entries.description: Gaussian convolution: W{f}(x) = (1/sqrt(4pi)) int f(t)e^{-(x-t)^2/4}dt. Heat equation propagator at t=1.
entries.output: Smoothed function Wf (heat diffusion at t=1)

entries.name: Weyl integral
entries.description: Fractional integral for periodic functions. Operates on Fourier series with zero constant coefficient.

entries.name: Weyl's functional calculus
entries.description: Functional calculus for tuples of non-commuting self-adjoint operators using Weyl quantization.

entries.name: Wigner distribution transform
entries.description: W(x,p) = (1/pi) int psi*(x+y) psi(x-y) e^{2ipy} dy. Phase-space quasi-probability. Can be negative.
entries.input: Quantum state psi or density matrix rho
entries.output: Wigner function W(x,p) on phase space
entries.broken: Positivity (Wigner function can be negative for quantum states)

entries.name: X-ray transform
entries.description: Line integrals of function: Xf(L) = int_L f. 1D Radon. Basis of X-ray tomography.
entries.preserved: Line integrability, inversion via filtered backprojection

entries.name: Y-Delta transform
entries.description: Replaces a three-terminal star (Y) network by an equivalent triangle (Delta) with the same behavior at the terminals; in graph theory, a Y-Delta exchange.
entries.input: Electrical network or graph with a degree-3 vertex
entries.output: Network with a triangle replacing it

entries.name: C*-algebra functional calculus
entries.description: Continuous functional calculus for normal elements of C*-algebra. Abstract version of D6-023.
entries.input: Normal element a of C*-algebra + continuous g on spectrum

entries.name: Functor Application
entries.description: Applies a functor F: C to D to an object or morphism of C. The basic structure-transporting move.
entries.input: Category C, functor F: C to D, object or morphism of C
entries.preserved: Composition and identities; commutative diagrams map to commutative diagrams
entries.broken: Injectivity on objects and morphisms (non-faithful or non-full functors lose distinctions)

entries.name: Natural Transformation
entries.description: A family of morphisms eta_X: F(X) to G(X), one per object, commuting with every F(f) and G(f). A morphism between functors.
entries.input: Parallel functors F, G: C to D
entries.preserved: Naturality: uniform across all objects and morphisms
entries.broken: Nothing at the component level; the identity of the two functors

entries.name: Left Adjoint Construction
entries.description: Builds F left adjoint to a given G: Hom(F X, Y) = Hom(X, G Y) naturally. The free, best-approximation-from-below construction.
entries.input: Functor G: D to C satisfying the solution-set condition
entries.output: Functor F: C to D with unit X to G F X
entries.broken: Limits in general; the extra structure is freely added, not determined by X

entries.name: Right Adjoint Construction
entries.description: Builds G right adjoint to a given F: Hom(F X, Y) = Hom(X, G Y). The cofree, best-approximation-from-above construction.
entries.input: Functor F: C to D satisfying the dual solution-set condition
entries.output: Functor G: D to C with counit F G Y to Y

entries.name: Left Kan Extension
entries.description: Extends F: C to E along K: C to D to Lan_K F: D to E, universal among functors with a transformation from F. Pointwise a colimit over the comma category K/d.
entries.input: Functors F: C to E, K: C to D; E cocomplete enough
entries.output: Functor Lan_K F: D to E with unit F to (Lan_K F) K
entries.preserved: Universal property; colimits of F when K is to the terminal category
entries.broken: Values off the image of K are forced (freely generated), not given

entries.name: Right Kan Extension
entries.description: Extends F: C to E along K: C to D to Ran_K F, universal among functors with a transformation to F. Pointwise a limit over d/K.
entries.input: Functors F: C to E, K: C to D; E complete enough
entries.output: Functor Ran_K F: D to E with counit (Ran_K F) K to F
entries.preserved: Universal property; limits of F when K is to the terminal category
entries.broken: Values off the image of K are forced (cofreely), not given

entries.name: Yoneda Embedding
entries.description: Sends each object c to its representable presheaf Hom(-, c). Fully faithful: an object is determined up to isomorphism by the morphisms into it.
entries.output: Presheaf category [C^op, Set] with embedding y
entries.preserved: Full faithfulness; limits of C; all morphism data
entries.broken: Colimits of C (y freely adds new ones); smallness of the ambient category

entries.name: Co-Yoneda Lemma Application
entries.description: Writes a presheaf as a canonical colimit of representables (the density formula, or the coend form of F = integral^c Hom(-, c) x F c).
entries.input: Presheaf or functor F: C^op to Set
entries.output: Canonical colimit presentation of F over its category of elements
entries.broken: Economy: the presentation uses every element, not a minimal set

entries.name: Grothendieck Construction
entries.description: Flattens an indexed category (a functor into Cat) into one total category fibered over the base. Objects are pairs (c, x in F c).
entries.input: Pseudofunctor F: C^op to Cat (or C to Cat)
entries.output: Fibration p: integral F to C (Cartesian or opCartesian)
entries.preserved: All data of F, recoverable as the fibers; equivalence of 2-categories between indexed categories and fibrations
entries.broken: The separation into levels (it becomes one category plus a projection)

entries.name: Limit Computation
entries.description: Computes the universal cone over a diagram: the object that best maps into every part compatibly.
entries.output: Limit object lim D with projections
entries.preserved: Every cone factors uniquely; right adjoints preserve it
entries.broken: Information not shared by all parts of the diagram

entries.name: Colimit Computation
entries.description: Computes the universal cocone under a diagram: the object that best receives every part, glued along the diagram's morphisms.
entries.output: Colimit object colim D with injections
entries.preserved: Every cocone factors uniquely; left adjoints preserve it

entries.name: Pullback Construction
entries.description: Forms the limit of X to Z from Y: the object of pairs agreeing in Z. Fiber products, intersections, inverse images.
entries.input: Cospan X to Z from Y
entries.output: Object X x_Z Y with projections
entries.preserved: Universal property; monomorphisms and many classes stable under pullback
entries.broken: Parts of X and Y not over a common point of Z

entries.name: Pushout Construction
entries.description: Forms the colimit of a span X from Z to Y: X and Y glued along Z. Amalgamations, attaching cells, unions along an overlap.
entries.input: Span X from Z to Y
entries.preserved: Universal property; epimorphisms stable under pushout
entries.broken: Distinctness of the images of Z

entries.name: Equalizer Construction
entries.description: Forms the universal morphism e: E to X with f e = g e: the subobject where two parallel maps agree.
entries.input: Parallel morphisms f, g: X to Y
entries.output: Object E with monomorphism e: E to X
entries.broken: Points of X where f and g differ

entries.name: Coequalizer Construction
entries.description: Forms the universal q: Y to Q with q f = q g: the quotient forcing two maps to agree.
entries.input: Parallel morphisms f, g: X to Y
entries.output: Object Q with epimorphism q: Y to Q
entries.broken: Distinctions between f(x) and g(x) in Y

entries.name: Product Formation
entries.description: Forms the limit of a discrete family: the object mapping to each factor, with morphisms into it determined componentwise.
entries.preserved: Each factor recoverable (when others are nonempty); componentwise structure
entries.broken: Independence is imposed: no relation between components survives

entries.name: Coproduct Formation
entries.description: Forms the colimit of a discrete family: the object receiving each summand, morphisms out of it determined summandwise.
entries.preserved: Each summand embeds (in extensive categories, disjointly)
entries.broken: Nothing is identified; relations between summands are absent

entries.name: Cartesian Closed Structure Evaluation
entries.description: Uses the product and exponential of a Cartesian closed category: currying Hom(A x B, C) = Hom(A, C^B) and evaluation C^B x B to C.
entries.input: Cartesian closed category, objects A, B, C
entries.preserved: The currying bijection, natural in all variables; models of simply typed lambda calculus
entries.broken: None; it is an isomorphism of hom-sets

entries.name: Exponential Object Construction
entries.description: Builds C^B, the internal object of morphisms from B to C, right adjoint to - x B.
entries.input: Objects B, C in a category with finite products
entries.preserved: Hom(A x B, C) = Hom(A, C^B); limits in C
entries.broken: Nothing; exists only when - x B has a right adjoint

entries.name: Subobject Classifier Evaluation
entries.description: Classifies a monomorphism m: S to X by its unique characteristic map chi: X to Omega pulling back true: 1 to Omega.
entries.input: Topos (or category with Omega), monomorphism m: S to X
entries.output: Characteristic map chi_m: X to Omega
entries.preserved: Sub(X) = Hom(X, Omega), naturally; internal logic (Heyting algebra structure)
entries.broken: Two-valuedness in general (Omega is Boolean only in Boolean toposes)

entries.name: Cauchy Completion
entries.description: Adds to a (possibly enriched) category all absolute colimits: splittings of idempotents (and finite biproducts in the additive case). For metric spaces as enriched categories, the classical Cauchy completion.
entries.output: Cauchy complete category C-bar with C to C-bar fully faithful
entries.preserved: Presheaf category: [C^op, V] = [C-bar^op, V]; Morita equivalence class
entries.broken: Nothing already present; adds objects only

entries.name: Karoubi Envelope Construction
entries.description: Forms Kar(C): objects are idempotents (X, e), morphisms f with f = e' f e. Splits every idempotent.
entries.output: Karoubi envelope Kar(C) with full embedding C to Kar(C)
entries.preserved: Presheaves on C; Morita class; full faithfulness of the embedding

entries.name: Idempotent Completion
entries.description: Closes a category under splitting of idempotents. The same construction as the Karoubi envelope, named by what it adds.
entries.output: Idempotent-complete category with fully faithful embedding

entries.name: Freyd's Adjoint Functor Construction
entries.description: Constructs a left adjoint to a continuous G from a small solution set, using limits in the domain (Freyd's General Adjoint Functor Theorem).
entries.input: Continuous functor G: D to C, D complete and locally small, with solution sets
entries.output: Left adjoint F: C to D
entries.preserved: G's limit preservation; the adjunction bijection
entries.broken: Constructivity: the adjoint is a large limit, not an explicit formula

entries.name: MacNeille Completion
entries.description: Embeds a poset in the smallest complete lattice containing it, via cuts (A, B) with A = lower bounds of B and B = upper bounds of A.
entries.output: Complete lattice DM(P) with order embedding
entries.preserved: All existing joins and meets; join-density and meet-density of P
entries.broken: Distributivity (the completion of a distributive lattice need not be distributive)

entries.name: Day Convolution
entries.description: Extends a monoidal structure on C to the presheaf category: (F * G)(c) = integral^{a,b} C(c, a (x) b) x F a x G b.
entries.preserved: Yoneda is strong monoidal; symmetry or braiding if present

entries.name: Isbell Duality Transformation
entries.description: The adjunction between presheaves and copresheaves on C, O(X)(c) = Nat(X, C(c, -)) and Spec(Y)(c) = Nat(C(-, c), Y). Generalizes algebra-geometry duality.
entries.input: Presheaf or copresheaf on small category C
entries.preserved: Representables are fixed; restricts to an equivalence on the Isbell-reflexive objects
entries.broken: Everything outside the reflexive fixed points (non-reflexive objects change)

entries.name: Opposite Category Dualization
entries.description: Reverses every morphism of C to get C^op. Every theorem about C gives a dual theorem.
entries.preserved: Objects, hom-sets as sets, composition (reversed); all categorical truths up to dualization
entries.broken: Direction: limits become colimits, monos become epis

entries.name: Eilenberg-Moore Category Construction
entries.description: Forms the category of algebras (A, a: T A to A) of a monad T. The terminal resolution of T into an adjunction.
entries.preserved: The monad (recovered from the adjunction); limits of C (created by the forgetful functor)
entries.broken: Colimits need not exist or be preserved

entries.name: Kleisli Category Construction
entries.description: Forms the category of free T-algebras: objects of C, morphisms X to T Y, composed with mu. The initial resolution of T.
entries.output: Category C_T with adjunction to C
entries.preserved: The monad; effects in programming semantics

entries.name: Monad Resolution
entries.description: Factors a monad T as G F for an adjunction F left of G. The resolutions form a category with Kleisli initial and Eilenberg-Moore terminal.
entries.broken: Uniqueness: many adjunctions resolve the same monad

entries.name: Comonad Resolution
entries.description: Factors a comonad as F G for an adjunction; the dual of monad resolution. Coalgebras and co-Kleisli categories are the extremes.

entries.name: Beck's Monadicity Theorem Application
entries.description: Decides whether a right adjoint G is monadic (D is equivalent to the Eilenberg-Moore category of G F): G reflects isomorphisms and creates coequalizers of G-split pairs.
entries.input: Adjunction F left of G: D to C
entries.output: Equivalence D = C^{GF}, or a failure witness
entries.preserved: Algebraic structure of D over C
entries.broken: Nothing when it holds; when it fails, the witness shows what D has beyond algebras

entries.name: Lawvere Theory Functorial Semantics
entries.description: Presents an algebraic theory as a category T with finite products generated by one object; models are product-preserving functors T to Set.
entries.input: Signature and equations, or a Lawvere theory T
entries.output: Category of models Mod(T) = FP(T, Set)
entries.preserved: The variety up to equivalence; interpretation in any category with finite products
entries.broken: Syntax: the particular presentation by generators and equations

entries.name: Localization of a Category
entries.description: Formally inverts a class W of morphisms, C to C[W^-1], universal among functors sending W to isomorphisms.
entries.input: Category C, class of morphisms W
entries.output: Localized category C[W^-1] with localization functor
entries.broken: Hom-set sizes and computability in general; distinctions made only by W-maps

entries.name: Calculus of Fractions Application
entries.description: When W admits a calculus of fractions (Ore-type conditions), writes morphisms of C[W^-1] as roofs X from W to X' to Y, with explicit equivalence.
entries.input: Category C, class W satisfying Ore and cancellation conditions
entries.preserved: Finite limits or colimits (left fractions preserve finite limits)

entries.name: Gabriel-Zisman Localization
entries.description: The general construction of C[W^-1] by zigzags of morphisms and formal inverses (Gabriel and Zisman, 1967).
entries.broken: Local smallness (hom-classes may be proper classes)

entries.name: Catamorphism
entries.description: The unique algebra map out of an initial algebra: a fold. Consumes a recursive structure by replacing constructors with an algebra.
entries.input: Initial algebra (mu F, in) and F-algebra (A, a)
entries.output: Unique morphism cata(a): mu F to A
entries.broken: The recursive structure itself (collapsed into A)

entries.name: Anamorphism
entries.description: The unique coalgebra map into a terminal coalgebra: an unfold. Generates a possibly infinite structure from a seed.
entries.input: Terminal coalgebra (nu F, out) and F-coalgebra (A, c)
entries.output: Unique morphism ana(c): A to nu F

entries.name: Hylomorphism
entries.description: An unfold followed by a fold, fused so the intermediate structure is never built: divide and conquer as a recursion scheme.
entries.output: Morphism A to B satisfying h = a F(h) c
entries.preserved: The composite result; no intermediate data structure
entries.broken: Termination is not guaranteed in general

entries.name: Paramorphism
entries.description: A fold whose algebra also sees the original substructures, not only their results: primitive recursion.
entries.input: Initial algebra mu F and algebra F(mu F x A) to A
entries.preserved: Access to both substructure and recursive result
entries.broken: Nothing relative to general recursion on mu F

entries.name: Apomorphism
entries.description: The dual of a paramorphism: an unfold that may stop early by returning a finished structure.
entries.input: Coalgebra A to F(nu F + A)

entries.name: Tensor Product of Categories
entries.description: Forms a tensor of categories: for plain categories the Cartesian product C x D; for linear or locally presentable categories a universal bilinear or cocontinuous-in-each-variable product (Deligne, Kelly).
entries.input: Categories C, D, possibly enriched or cocomplete
entries.broken: Individual structure of C and D is mixed

entries.name: Functor Category Construction
entries.description: Forms [C, D]: objects functors, morphisms natural transformations.
entries.preserved: Limits and colimits of D (computed pointwise)
entries.broken: Size control if C is large

entries.name: Comma Category Construction
entries.description: Forms (F / G): objects (a, b, h: F a to G b), morphisms commuting squares. Generalizes slices, arrow categories, categories of elements.
entries.input: Functors F: A to C, G: B to C
entries.output: Comma category (F / G) with projections to A and B
entries.preserved: Universal 2-cell; limits where F preserves them

entries.name: Slice Category Construction
entries.description: Forms C/X: objects morphisms into X, morphisms commuting triangles. Objects over a base.
entries.preserved: Topos structure (a slice of a topos is a topos); local Cartesian closure
entries.broken: Terminal object of C (replaced by id_X)

entries.name: Coslice Category Construction
entries.description: Forms X/C: objects morphisms out of X. Objects under X, such as pointed sets for X = 1.
entries.broken: Initial object of C (replaced by id_X)

entries.name: Quotient Category Construction
entries.description: Quotients hom-sets by a congruence (an equivalence on each hom-set compatible with composition), keeping objects.
entries.input: Category C, congruence ~ on its morphisms
entries.output: Category C/~ with full functor C to C/~

entries.name: Skeleton Category Reduction
entries.description: Chooses one object per isomorphism class, giving an equivalent category with no distinct isomorphic objects.
entries.preserved: All categorical properties invariant under equivalence

entries.name: Core Category Reduction
entries.description: Keeps all objects and only the isomorphisms: the maximal subgroupoid.
entries.preserved: Objects and isomorphism classes; automorphism groups

entries.name: Monoidal Product Application
entries.description: Combines objects and morphisms with a tensor (x): C x C to C, associative and unital up to coherent isomorphism.
entries.preserved: Associativity and unit up to coherence
entries.broken: Individual factors are not recoverable in general

entries.name: Braiding Isomorphism Application
entries.description: Swaps tensor factors via the braiding b: X (x) Y to Y (x) X, satisfying the hexagon identities.
entries.input: Braided monoidal category, objects X, Y
entries.output: Isomorphism X (x) Y to Y (x) X
entries.preserved: Everything (it is an isomorphism); hexagon coherence
entries.broken: Symmetry: b twice need not be the identity

entries.name: Symmetric Monoidal Transformation
entries.description: A monoidal natural transformation between symmetric monoidal functors, compatible with tensor, unit and symmetry.
entries.output: Monoidal natural transformation F to G
entries.broken: None beyond those of natural transformations

entries.name: Tensor-Hom Adjunction
entries.description: The adjunction - (x) B left of Hom(B, -): Hom(A (x) B, C) = Hom(A, Hom(B, C)). Currying for modules and closed monoidal categories.
entries.input: Closed monoidal category or modules over a ring
entries.preserved: Right exactness of the tensor; left exactness of Hom
entries.broken: Exactness in general (the source of Tor and Ext)

entries.name: Whiskering
entries.description: Composes a natural transformation with a functor on either side: (alpha H)_X = alpha_{H X} and (K alpha)_X = K(alpha_X).
entries.input: Natural transformation alpha: F to G and functor H or K
entries.output: Natural transformation alpha H or K alpha

entries.name: Vertical Composition of Natural Transformations
entries.description: Composes alpha: F to G and beta: G to H componentwise: (beta alpha)_X = beta_X alpha_X.
entries.input: Transformations F to G to H between the same categories

entries.name: Horizontal Composition of Natural Transformations
entries.description: Composes alpha: F to G (C to D) with beta: H to K (D to E) into beta * alpha: H F to K G.
entries.output: Transformation H F to K G
entries.preserved: Naturality; the two routes around the square agree

entries.name: Interchange Law Reduction
entries.description: Rewrites (beta' beta) * (alpha' alpha) as (beta' * alpha')(beta * alpha): vertical and horizontal composition commute.
entries.output: Equal composite in the other order

entries.name: Strictification of Monoidal Categories
entries.description: Replaces a monoidal category by a monoidally equivalent strict one (Mac Lane's coherence theorem).
entries.preserved: Monoidal equivalence class; all coherent diagrams
entries.broken: Objects-level identity (the strict model is larger or reorganized)

entries.name: String Diagram Evaluation
entries.description: Reads a planar or spatial diagram of boxes and wires as a morphism in a monoidal category; deformations of the diagram give equal morphisms (Joyal and Street).
entries.input: String diagram in a monoidal, braided or symmetric signature
entries.output: Morphism in the free (or a target) monoidal category
entries.preserved: Value under isotopy of the diagram
entries.broken: Syntax order (bracketing and sequencing are forgotten)

entries.name: Eckmann-Hilton Argument Reduction
entries.description: Two unital operations that distribute over each other coincide and are commutative. Forces higher homotopy groups abelian and monoids in monoids commutative.
entries.input: Set with two unital binary operations satisfying interchange
entries.broken: Apparent distinctness of the two operations; noncommutativity

entries.name: Pointwise Extension
entries.description: Extends a structure on a codomain to functions into it, componentwise: (f + g)(x) = f(x) + g(x). Pointwise Kan extensions compute values by (co)limits over comma categories.
entries.input: Operation or structure on D; functions or functors into D
entries.output: Same structure on the function space or functor category
entries.broken: Non-equational properties (for example total order, fields become rings)

entries.name: End Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the end integral_c P(c, c) of a functor P: C^op x C to D: the universal wedge. Natural transformations are ends: Nat(F, G) = integral_c D(F c, G c).
entries.input: Functor P: C^op x C to D

entries.name: Coend Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the coend integral^c P(c, c), the universal cowedge: a colimit gluing diagonal values along the variance.
entries.input: Functor P: C^op x C to D
entries.preserved: Universal cowedge; tensor products of functors
entries.broken: Off-diagonal information; distinctions identified by the gluing

entries.name: Profunctor Composition
entries.description: Composes profunctors P: A -/-> B and Q: B -/-> C by the coend (Q o P)(a, c) = integral^b Q(b, c) x P(a, b).
entries.preserved: Associativity and units up to isomorphism (a bicategory)

entries.name: Tambara Module Construction
entries.description: Equips a profunctor with a strength for a monoidal action: maps P(a, b) to P(m.a, m.b) compatibly. Profunctor optics are exactly transformations natural in Tambara modules.
entries.input: Profunctor P and monoidal action of M
entries.broken: Profunctors without compatible strength are excluded

entries.name: Essential Image Reduction
entries.description: Restricts a functor's codomain to the full subcategory of objects isomorphic to some F(c).
entries.preserved: Everything F reaches, up to isomorphism

entries.name: Reflective Subcategory Localization
entries.description: Given a full subcategory with a left adjoint to its inclusion, replaces each object by its best approximation inside (sheafification, completion, abelianization).
entries.input: Category C, reflective full subcategory R
entries.output: Reflector L: C to R with unit X to L X
entries.preserved: Limits in R (computed in C); objects already in R
entries.broken: Structure outside R (the unit kills or adds it)

formal.note: A reflective subcategory: a fully faithful functor with a left adjoint.
A reflective inclusion is monadic, and monadic functors create limits (monadicCreatesLimits): limits in R are computed in C.
With monadicOfReflective, the inclusion creates limits.

entries.conditions: A localization in the sense needed for subtoposes and levels requires the reflector to preserve finite limits (an exact reflection; between toposes, a geometric embedding). A bare reflective subcategory need not.

conditionReceipts.quote: in addition preserves [[finite limits]], then the embedding is called _exact_. If the categories are [[topos]]es then such embeddings are called [[geometric embedding]]s.

entries.name: Coreflective Subcategory Localization
entries.description: Dual: replaces an object by the best approximation from inside a coreflective subcategory (for example the torsion part, or the underlying compactly generated space).
entries.output: Coreflector R: C to S with counit R X to X
entries.preserved: Colimits in S; objects already in S

entries.name: Factorization System Application
entries.description: Factors every morphism uniquely (up to iso) as an E-map followed by an M-map, with E left orthogonal to M (for example epi then mono).
entries.input: Category with orthogonal factorization system (E, M), morphism f
entries.preserved: Uniqueness of the factorization; lifting properties

entries.name: Weak Factorization System Application
entries.description: Factors every morphism as a left-class map followed by a right-class map with the lifting property, but without uniqueness. The backbone of model categories.
entries.input: Category with weak factorization system (L, R), morphism f

entries.name: Exact Completion
entries.description: Freely adds quotients of equivalence relations to a category with finite limits (or a regular category), producing an exact (Barr-exact) category.
entries.input: Category with finite limits (or regular category)
entries.output: Exact category C_ex/lex or C_ex/reg with embedding
entries.preserved: Finite limits; regular epis already present
entries.broken: Nothing present; adds coequalizers of equivalence relations

entries.name: Regular Completion
entries.description: Freely adds images (coequalizers of kernel pairs, pullback-stable) to a category with finite limits.

entries.name: Free Category Generation
entries.description: Generates the category of paths of a directed graph, composition being concatenation.
entries.preserved: Vertices and edges; functors out are determined by graph maps
entries.broken: Relations: no two distinct paths are identified

entries.name: Ind-Completion
entries.description: Freely adds filtered colimits: Ind(C) is the full subcategory of presheaves that are filtered colimits of representables.
entries.preserved: Finite colimits of C; compactness of objects of C
entries.broken: Nothing present; adds formal filtered colimits

entries.name: Pro-Completion
entries.description: Freely adds cofiltered limits: Pro(C) = Ind(C^op)^op. Profinite groups are Pro(finite groups).
entries.preserved: Finite limits of C; cocompactness of objects of C
entries.broken: Nothing present; adds formal cofiltered limits

entries.name: Filtered Colimit Construction
entries.description: Computes a colimit over a filtered diagram. In Set it commutes with finite limits; it builds directed unions and stalks.
entries.preserved: Finite limits (commute with it in Set and locally finitely presentable categories); finitely presentable structure
entries.broken: Elements identified eventually along the diagram

entries.name: Cofiltered Limit Construction
entries.description: Computes a limit over a cofiltered diagram: inverse limits, profinite completions, formal neighborhoods.
entries.preserved: Compatible families; compactness in topological settings
entries.broken: Nonemptiness can fail in Set without compactness

entries.name: Sifted Colimit Construction
entries.description: Computes a colimit over a sifted diagram (diagonal is final): filtered colimits and reflexive coequalizers. They commute with finite products in Set.
entries.preserved: Finite products; algebraic theories (models are closed under sifted colimits)

entries.name: Initial Object Evaluation
entries.description: Identifies the object with a unique morphism to every object: the empty colimit.
entries.output: Initial object 0 and the unique maps out of it
entries.broken: Nothing; it is a universal property

entries.name: Terminal Object Evaluation
entries.description: Identifies the object with a unique morphism from every object: the empty limit. Global elements are maps from it.
entries.output: Terminal object 1 and the unique maps into it

entries.name: Zero Object Reduction
entries.description: Uses an object both initial and terminal to define zero morphisms, kernels and cokernels.

entries.name: Biproduct Construction
entries.description: Forms an object that is both product and coproduct with compatible maps: the direct sum in additive categories.
entries.input: Objects X, Y in a preadditive category
entries.output: Biproduct X (+) Y with injections and projections
entries.preserved: Both universal properties; matrix calculus for morphisms

entries.name: Additive Category Completion
entries.description: Freely adds finite biproducts to a preadditive category (the matrix category Mat(C)).

entries.name: Preadditive Enrichment
entries.description: Enriches hom-sets in abelian groups with bilinear composition (Ab-enrichment), or passes to the free such category Z[C].
entries.broken: Set-level morphisms are replaced by formal Z-combinations in the free case

entries.name: Abelianization of a Category
entries.description: Embeds an additive or exact category in an abelian one (Freyd's abelian envelope, or the Freyd-Mitchell embedding for small abelian categories).
entries.preserved: Exact sequences of C (for exact embeddings); full faithfulness
entries.broken: Nothing present; adds kernels and cokernels freely

entries.name: Krull-Schmidt Decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes an object into a finite direct sum of indecomposables with local endomorphism rings, unique up to isomorphism and permutation.
entries.input: Object in a Krull-Schmidt category (for example finite-length module)
entries.preserved: Isomorphism class; the multiset of summands

entries.name: Split Epimorphism Reduction
entries.description: Uses a section s with p s = id to split an epimorphism: the codomain is a retract of the domain.
entries.input: Split epimorphism p: X to Y with section s
entries.output: Retract data; in additive categories X = Y (+) ker p
entries.preserved: Y as a retract; absolute preservation (every functor preserves splittings)

entries.name: Retract Construction
entries.description: Exhibits Y as a retract of X via i: Y to X and r: X to Y with r i = id_Y, equivalently a split idempotent i r on X.
entries.input: Object X with idempotent e, or maps i, r
entries.preserved: Every property closed under retracts (projectivity, injectivity, finiteness of many kinds)
entries.broken: The part of X killed by r

entries.name: Groupoidification
entries.description: Replaces a category by its free groupoid by formally inverting all morphisms (fundamental groupoid of the nerve); or, in Baez's sense, lifts linear algebra to spans of groupoids.
entries.preserved: Connected components; homotopy type of the nerve at the level of pi_1

entries.name: Free Algebra Generation
entries.description: Builds the most general algebra of a variety on a generating set: terms modulo the equations. Left adjoint to the forgetful functor.
entries.input: Generator set X, variety V (signature and equations)
entries.output: Free algebra F_V(X) with insertion of generators
entries.preserved: Universal property: every map of generators extends uniquely to a homomorphism
entries.broken: Any relation not forced by the equations

entries.name: Term Algebra Construction
entries.description: Forms the algebra of all well-formed terms over a signature and variables, with no equations: the absolutely free algebra.
entries.preserved: Syntax exactly; initiality among Sigma-algebras (X empty)

entries.name: Signature Morphism Application
entries.description: Translates symbols of one signature into terms of another, inducing a translation of theories and a reduct functor on models (institution theory).
entries.input: Signature morphism sigma: Sigma to Sigma'
entries.output: Translation of sentences; reduct functor Mod(Sigma') to Mod(Sigma)
entries.preserved: Satisfaction condition: M' satisfies sigma(phi) iff reduct satisfies phi
entries.broken: Operations of Sigma' outside the image

entries.name: Equational Class Reduction
entries.description: Replaces a class of algebras by the equational class (variety) it generates, or a set of equations by an equivalent smaller one.
entries.input: Class K of algebras or equation set E
entries.output: Variety HSP(K) or reduced basis of E
entries.broken: Non-equational properties of K (for example being a field)

entries.name: Variety Generation
entries.description: Closes a class under homomorphic images, subalgebras and products: V(K) = HSP(K) (Birkhoff). A class is equationally definable iff so closed.
entries.input: Class K of algebras of one signature

entries.name: Quasivariety Generation
entries.description: Closes a class under isomorphisms, subalgebras, products and ultraproducts: ISPP_U(K). Exactly the classes defined by quasi-identities (Horn clauses).
entries.broken: Closure under homomorphic images is not guaranteed

entries.name: Homomorphic Image Construction
entries.description: Forms the image of an algebra under a surjective homomorphism, equivalently a quotient by its kernel congruence.
entries.input: Algebra A, surjective homomorphism h: A to B

entries.name: Subalgebra Generation
entries.description: Forms the smallest subalgebra containing a subset: closure under all operations.
entries.broken: Elements of A not reachable from S

entries.name: Direct Product Construction
entries.description: Forms the Cartesian product with componentwise operations.
entries.broken: Many first-order properties: fields are not closed under product; no zero divisors fails

entries.name: Subdirect Product Construction
entries.description: Forms a subalgebra of a product whose projections onto every factor are surjective.
entries.input: Family (A_i) and subalgebra B of prod A_i

entries.name: Subdirect Decomposition
entries.description: Represents an algebra as a subdirect product of subdirectly irreducible algebras (Birkhoff's subdirect representation theorem). The prime factorization of universal algebra.
entries.output: Subdirect embedding of A into a product of subdirectly irreducible algebras
entries.preserved: A up to isomorphism; its identities
entries.broken: Uniqueness: the decomposition is generally not unique

entries.name: Reduced Product Construction
entries.description: Quotients a product by a filter on the index set: two tuples are equal if they agree on a set in the filter.
entries.input: Family (A_i), filter F on the index set
entries.preserved: Horn sentences true in almost all factors
entries.broken: First-order sentences in general (without an ultrafilter)

entries.name: Ultraproduct Construction
entries.description: Reduced product by an ultrafilter. Los's theorem: a first-order sentence holds in the ultraproduct iff it holds in U-almost all factors.
entries.preserved: Every first-order sentence true U-almost everywhere

entries.name: Boolean Power Construction
entries.description: Forms A[B]: continuous functions from the Stone space of a Boolean algebra B to discrete A (Foster's Boolean power).
entries.preserved: Identities and many universal Horn properties of A

entries.name: Bounded Boolean Power Construction
entries.description: Boolean power restricted to functions of finite range, the version used for arbitrary (non-finite) A.
entries.preserved: Identities of A; A embeds diagonally

entries.name: Congruence Generation
entries.description: Forms the smallest congruence containing a set of pairs: closure under equivalence and compatibility with operations.
entries.input: Algebra A, set of pairs R
entries.broken: Pairs of R are identified with everything forced by them

entries.name: Principal Congruence Construction
entries.description: Forms the congruence generated by a single pair (a, b).
entries.preserved: Compatibility; compact element of the congruence lattice

entries.name: Congruence Lattice Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the lattice Con(A) of all congruences, which is algebraic and encodes the quotient structure of A.
entries.preserved: Quotient structure; modularity or distributivity for Mal'cev varieties

entries.name: Quotient Algebra Formation
entries.description: Forms A/theta for a congruence theta, operations acting on classes.

entries.name: Mal'cev Condition Application
entries.description: Characterizes a property of varieties by existence of terms with equations (for example a term p with p(x,x,y) = y = p(y,x,x) iff congruences permute).
entries.output: Presence or absence of the property (via terms)

entries.name: Commutator Construction
entries.description: Forms the commutator [alpha, beta] of congruences (Smith, Hagemann-Herrmann), generalizing group commutators and ring ideal products.
entries.input: Algebra A in a congruence-modular variety, congruences alpha, beta

entries.name: Center Construction
entries.description: Forms the center: the largest congruence (or subgroup, subring) commuting with everything.
entries.output: Center Z(A) or central congruence zeta_A

entries.name: Abelianization of an Algebra
entries.description: Quotients by the commutator [1_A, 1_A] to get the largest abelian quotient (for groups G/[G,G]).
entries.input: Algebra A in a modular variety (group G)
entries.preserved: Maps into abelian algebras factor uniquely

entries.name: Nilpotent Reduction
entries.description: Passes to a nilpotent quotient (by a term of the lower central series) or tests nilpotence of a group, ring or algebra.
entries.input: Group, ring or algebra A, class c
entries.preserved: Nilpotent structure up to class c

entries.name: Solvable Reduction
entries.description: Passes to a solvable quotient via the derived series, or tests solvability.
entries.input: Group, ring or algebra A, length n

entries.name: Clone Generation
entries.description: Forms the smallest clone (set of finitary operations closed under composition and containing projections) containing given operations.

entries.name: Polymorphism Extraction
entries.description: Computes the operations preserving every relation of a structure: Pol(Gamma). Central to the algebraic approach to constraint satisfaction.
entries.preserved: Galois duality: Inv(Pol(Gamma)) is the pp-definable closure of Gamma

entries.name: Invariant Relation Extraction
entries.description: Computes the relations preserved by every operation of a clone: Inv(F), the other side of the Pol-Inv Galois connection.

entries.name: Galois Connection Formulation
entries.description: Establishes an antitone (or monotone adjoint) pair between two posets, f(a) <= b iff a <= g(b), giving closure operators on each side and a bijection of closed elements.
entries.input: Posets P, Q, relation or maps f, g

entries.name: Birkhoff Representation
entries.description: Represents a finite distributive lattice as the lattice of down-sets of its poset of join-irreducibles.
entries.output: Poset J(L) and isomorphism L = Down(J(L))
entries.broken: Nothing; it is a duality (finite case)

entries.name: J\u00f3nsson Lemma Application
entries.description: In a congruence-distributive variety generated by K, every subdirectly irreducible member lies in HSP_U(K).
entries.broken: Nothing; it restricts where irreducibles can be

entries.name: Taylor Term Evaluation
entries.description: Tests for an idempotent Taylor term (satisfying a nontrivial system of linear identities). Its presence marks tractability in CSP.

entries.name: Siggers Term Evaluation
entries.description: Tests for a 6-ary (or 4-ary) Siggers term s(x,y,x,z,y,z) = s(y,x,z,x,z,y), equivalent to having a Taylor term. The tractability criterion of the CSP dichotomy (Bulatov, Zhuk).
entries.input: Finite idempotent algebra or polymorphism clone

entries.name: Absorption Law Reduction
entries.description: Simplifies lattice expressions by a v (a ^ b) = a and a ^ (a v b) = a.

entries.name: Idempotent Reduction
entries.description: Simplifies using f(x, ..., x) = x (or e e = e), or restricts to the idempotent reduct of an algebra.
entries.input: Term or algebra with idempotent operations

entries.name: Arity Reduction
entries.description: Expresses higher-arity operations by lower-arity ones (for example every clone on a two-element set is generated by operations of bounded arity, Post), or currying.
entries.broken: Minimal presentation may fail to exist in general

entries.name: Nullary Operation Insertion
entries.description: Adds a constant symbol (nullary operation) to a signature, naming a distinguished element (identity, zero, basepoint).
entries.broken: Homomorphisms must now preserve the constant; empty algebras excluded

entries.name: Unary Operation Composition
entries.description: Composes unary operations, giving the monoid of unary term functions (the transformation monoid).
entries.input: Unary operations f, g on A

entries.name: Binary Operation Distribution
entries.description: Applies a distributive law x (y + z) = x y + x z, expanding or factoring terms.
entries.input: Term in a structure with distributive law

entries.name: Ring Commutator Evaluation
entries.description: Computes [a, b] = a b - b a, measuring noncommutativity; turns an associative algebra into a Lie algebra.
entries.input: Associative ring or algebra, elements a, b

entries.name: Field of Fractions Construction
entries.description: Forms fractions a/b of an integral domain, the smallest field containing it.

entries.name: Ring Localization
entries.description: Inverts a multiplicative set S: S^-1 R, fractions r/s. Localizing at a prime focuses on a point of Spec R.
entries.input: Commutative ring R, multiplicative set S
entries.output: Ring S^-1 R with map R to S^-1 R
entries.preserved: Exactness (localization is exact); primes disjoint from S

entries.name: Ore Condition Application
entries.description: Localizes a noncommutative ring at S when S satisfies the (right) Ore condition, so right fractions r s^-1 exist.
entries.input: Noncommutative ring R, Ore set S
entries.preserved: Flatness of R S^-1 over R

entries.name: Integral Closure Transformation
entries.description: Adds all elements of an extension that satisfy monic polynomials over the ring.
entries.output: Integral closure of A in B

entries.name: Ring Completion
entries.description: Completes a ring with respect to an ideal-adic topology: R-hat = lim R/I^n.
entries.preserved: Associated graded ring; flatness for Noetherian R
entries.broken: Global information (only infinitesimal neighborhood of V(I) remains)

entries.name: Krull Dimension Reduction
entries.description: Lowers dimension by quotienting by a parameter or localizing, or computes dim R as the supremum of lengths of prime chains.
entries.output: Ring of smaller dimension, or dim R

entries.name: Nilradical Extraction
entries.description: Computes the ideal of nilpotent elements, the intersection of all primes.
entries.preserved: Spec R as a topological space

entries.name: Jacobson Radical Extraction
entries.description: Computes the intersection of all maximal (left) ideals; Nakayama's lemma lives here.
entries.output: Jacobson radical J(R); semiprimitive quotient R/J

entries.name: Prime Spectrum Construction
entries.description: Forms Spec R, the space of prime ideals with the Zariski topology and structure sheaf. Contravariant equivalence of rings and affine schemes.

entries.name: Maximal Spectrum Construction
entries.description: Forms the space of maximal ideals (the classical points), as in the Nullstellensatz or Gelfand spectrum.
entries.preserved: Points of finite-type algebras over a field; for C*-algebras, everything (Gelfand)

entries.name: Module Tensor Product
entries.description: Forms M (x)_R N, universal for R-bilinear maps.
entries.input: Right R-module M, left R-module N
entries.broken: Left exactness (measured by Tor); torsion can vanish

entries.name: Exterior Algebra Generation
entries.description: Forms Lambda(V): the tensor algebra modulo v (x) v = 0. Alternating multilinear algebra; determinants and differential forms.

entries.name: Symmetric Algebra Generation
entries.description: Forms Sym(V): the tensor algebra modulo commutators; polynomial functions on V*.
entries.preserved: Functoriality; universal for maps to commutative algebras

entries.name: Clifford Algebra Generation
entries.description: Forms Cl(V, q): the tensor algebra modulo v v = q(v). Deforms the exterior algebra by a quadratic form; spinors live here.
entries.input: Vector space V with quadratic form q
entries.preserved: Z/2 grading; orthogonal group action; dimension 2^n

entries.name: Universal Enveloping Algebra Construction
entries.description: Forms U(g): the associative algebra whose modules are g-modules, T(g) modulo x y - y x = [x, y].
entries.preserved: Representation theory of g; PBW basis (associated graded is Sym g)
entries.broken: Nothing of g (it embeds, by PBW)

entries.name: Group Ring Construction
entries.description: Forms R[G]: formal R-linear combinations of group elements with convolution product. Modules over it are representations.
entries.broken: Group structure is linearized (G is recoverable only in special cases)

entries.name: Monoid Ring Construction
entries.description: Forms R[M] for a monoid M; polynomial rings are monoid rings of N^n.

entries.name: Matrix Ring Construction
entries.description: Forms M_n(R). Morita equivalent to R: same module category.
entries.preserved: Module category up to equivalence (Morita); ideals correspond

entries.name: Opposite Ring Dualization
entries.description: Reverses multiplication: a *op b = b a. Left modules over R are right modules over R^op.

entries.name: Polynomial Ring Extension
entries.description: Adjoins a free commuting variable: R[x].
entries.preserved: Noetherianity (Hilbert basis theorem); domain property; UFD property
entries.broken: Dimension increases by one; field property

entries.name: Formal Power Series Extension
entries.description: Adjoins a variable allowing infinite sums: R[[x]], the x-adic completion of R[x].
entries.preserved: Noetherianity; domain property; locality over a field

entries.name: Algebraic Closure Construction
entries.description: Builds a field extension in which every polynomial splits, algebraic over the base; unique up to non-unique isomorphism.

entries.name: Separable Closure Construction
entries.description: Adjoins all roots of separable polynomials; its automorphism group is the absolute Galois group.

entries.name: Splitting Field Construction
entries.description: Adjoins exactly the roots of a polynomial: the smallest extension where it factors into linear factors.
entries.output: Splitting field of f over K

entries.name: Galois Group Extraction
entries.description: Computes the group of automorphisms of an extension fixing the base; for Galois extensions subgroups correspond to intermediate fields.

entries.name: Sylow Subgroup Extraction
entries.description: Finds maximal p-subgroups of a finite group; they exist, are conjugate, and their number is 1 mod p and divides the index.

entries.name: Normal Closure Construction
entries.description: Forms the smallest normal subgroup containing a subset (or the smallest normal extension containing a field extension).
entries.input: Group G and subset S (or field extension)
entries.broken: Distinction between S and its conjugates

formal.note: The normal closure is normal.
It is the smallest normal subgroup containing the set. The field-extension reading is a separate construction (IntermediateField.normalClosure), not linked here.
Defined as the subgroup generated by all conjugates of the set.

entries.name: Centralizer Construction
entries.description: Forms the set of elements commuting with a subset.

entries.name: Normalizer Construction
entries.description: Forms the largest subgroup in which H is normal.
entries.preserved: H is normal in it; count of conjugates equals the index

entries.name: Derived Subgroup Evaluation
entries.description: Computes [G, G], generated by commutators; the quotient is the abelianization.

entries.name: Group Extension
entries.description: Builds G from a normal subgroup N and quotient Q: 1 to N to G to Q to 1. Classified by cohomology when N is abelian (H^2(Q, N)).
entries.input: Groups N, Q, action and cocycle data
entries.output: Group G fitting in the extension
entries.broken: Splitting; uniqueness (extensions differ by cohomology classes)

entries.name: Semidirect Product Construction
entries.description: Forms N x| H using an action H to Aut(N): the split extensions.
entries.input: Groups N, H, homomorphism H to Aut(N)

entries.name: Wreath Product Construction
entries.description: Forms A wr H = A^X x| H for H acting on X; the symmetry group of hierarchical structures, universal for imprimitive actions (Krasner-Kaloujnine).
entries.preserved: Every extension of A by H embeds (Kaloujnine-Krasner)

entries.name: Zassenhaus Lemma Reduction
entries.description: The butterfly lemma: for subgroups A' normal in A, B' normal in B, gives an isomorphism of two quotients. The key step of Schreier refinement.

entries.name: Schreier Refinement
entries.description: Any two subnormal series have equivalent refinements.
entries.input: Two subnormal series of a group

entries.name: Jordan-H\u00f6lder Decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes a finite-length object into a composition series; the simple factors are unique up to permutation.
entries.input: Group, module or object of finite length
entries.broken: Extension data: how the factors are glued

entries.name: Term Rewriting Step
entries.description: Applies a rewrite rule l to r at a position of a term matching l under a substitution.
entries.input: Term t, rule l to r
entries.preserved: Equational class of t (under the equations of the rules)

entries.name: Abstract Reduction
entries.description: Studies a binary relation of one-step reductions on a set: termination, confluence, normal forms (Newman's lemma).
entries.broken: Distinct paths to the same normal form

entries.name: Knuth-Bendix Completion
entries.description: Turns a set of equations into a confluent, terminating rewriting system by orienting equations and adding rules for critical pairs.
entries.output: Convergent rewriting system R (or failure or divergence)
entries.preserved: Equational theory of E; decides the word problem when it succeeds
entries.broken: Termination of the procedure (may run forever)

entries.name: Buchberger Algorithm Application
entries.description: Computes a Groebner basis by adding reduced S-polynomials until all reduce to zero.
entries.input: Generating set of a polynomial ideal, monomial order

entries.name: Gr\u00f6bner Basis Computation
entries.description: Finds a generating set of a polynomial ideal whose leading terms generate the leading-term ideal, making division remainders unique.
entries.preserved: The ideal; membership decidable by reduction
entries.broken: Choice of generators; complexity can be doubly exponential

entries.name: Critical Pair Resolution
entries.description: Finds overlaps of rule left-hand sides and checks both reducts join; unjoinable pairs become new rules.

entries.name: Diamond Lemma Application
entries.description: Local confluence plus termination implies confluence (Newman); Bergman's version gives normal-form bases for associative algebras.
entries.output: Confluence; unique normal forms (or a basis)

entries.name: Squier's Theorem Homotopy Construction
entries.description: From a finite convergent rewriting system of a monoid builds a resolution showing the monoid has finite derivation type and satisfies FP_3; hence some monoids with decidable word problem have no finite convergent presentation.
entries.input: Finite convergent rewriting system for a monoid M
entries.broken: Nothing; it is an obstruction theory

entries.name: Supremum Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the least upper bound (join) of a subset of a poset.

entries.name: Infimum Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the greatest lower bound (meet) of a subset.

entries.name: Order Dualization
entries.description: Reverses the order: P^op. Joins become meets; every order theorem has a dual.

entries.name: Hasse Diagram Construction
entries.description: Draws the covering relation of a finite poset: the transitive reduction.

entries.name: Dedekind-MacNeille Completion
entries.description: Embeds a poset in the smallest complete lattice by normal cuts; the reals are the completion of the rationals (with endpoints added).
entries.preserved: Existing joins and meets; density of P

entries.name: Ideal Completion
entries.description: Forms the poset of ideals (directed down-sets): the free directed-complete poset (dcpo) on P; algebraic domains in denotational semantics.
entries.preserved: Order; compact elements correspond to P
entries.broken: Existing directed joins are not preserved (they are added freely)

entries.name: Filter Completion
entries.description: Forms the poset of filters (directed up-sets), the order dual of the ideal completion.

entries.name: Principal Ideal Generation
entries.description: Forms the down-set of a single element, or the ideal a R of a ring.

entries.name: Principal Filter Generation
entries.description: Forms the up-set of a single element.

entries.name: Ultrafilter Extension
entries.description: Extends a structure to its ultrafilters: the Stone-Cech compactification of a discrete set, or the ultrafilter extension of a modal frame.
entries.input: Set, Boolean algebra or Kripke frame

entries.name: Prime Ideal Extraction
entries.description: Finds prime ideals (of a ring or distributive lattice), existence by the prime ideal theorem.
entries.input: Ring or distributive lattice, ideal disjoint from a filter

entries.name: Maximal Ideal Extraction
entries.description: Finds a maximal ideal containing a given proper ideal (Krull, via Zorn).
entries.input: Ring with identity, proper ideal I
entries.output: Maximal ideal m containing I; field R/m

entries.name: Boolean Algebra Orthogonalization
entries.description: Rewrites elements as joins of pairwise disjoint (orthogonal) elements, as in disjunctive normal form or atoms of a finite Boolean algebra.
entries.input: Boolean algebra, finite family of elements
entries.output: Pairwise disjoint family with the same join
entries.reading: Nonstandard name. Read as disjointification in a Boolean algebra (the Boolean analogue of Gram-Schmidt).

entries.name: Heyting Algebra Implication Operation
entries.description: Computes a => b, the largest c with c ^ a <= b: the right adjoint to meet, intuitionistic implication.
entries.broken: Excluded middle (not a => b = not a v b in general)

entries.name: Pseudo-Complement Evaluation
entries.description: Computes the largest element disjoint from a: not a = a => 0.
entries.broken: Double negation law (not not a need not equal a)

entries.name: Relative Complement Evaluation
entries.description: Computes a complement of a within an interval [x, y] (or a \ b in a Boolean algebra).
entries.input: Lattice, element a in interval [x, y]

entries.name: Stone Space Topologization
entries.description: Turns a Boolean algebra into its Stone space of ultrafilters (compact, Hausdorff, totally disconnected). Stone duality.

entries.name: Priestley Space Topologization
entries.description: Turns a bounded distributive lattice into its ordered Stone space of prime filters (Priestley duality).

entries.name: Closure Operator Application
entries.description: Applies an extensive, monotone, idempotent operator: topological closure, subalgebra generation, deductive closure.
entries.input: Poset or power set, closure operator c
entries.preserved: Order; closed elements form a complete lattice (on complete lattices)

entries.name: Interior Operator Application
entries.description: Applies a contractive, monotone, idempotent operator: topological interior, modal necessity (S4).
entries.input: Poset or power set, interior operator
entries.preserved: Order; open elements form a lattice

entries.name: Down-Set Generation
entries.description: Forms the set of all elements below some element of S.
entries.broken: Distinction of S from its lower closure

entries.name: Up-Set Generation
entries.description: Forms the set of all elements above some element of S.
entries.broken: Distinction of S from its upper closure

entries.name: Antichain Extraction
entries.description: Finds a set of pairwise incomparable elements; by Dilworth, the maximum antichain size equals the minimum number of chains covering a finite poset.

entries.name: Chain Evaluation
entries.description: Finds totally ordered subsets; the height of P is the length of a longest chain (Mirsky dual).

entries.name: Zorn's Lemma Maximization
entries.description: If every chain has an upper bound, a maximal element exists. Produces bases, maximal ideals, algebraic closures.
entries.input: Nonempty poset where chains are bounded

entries.name: Well-Ordering Transformation
entries.description: Equips a set with a well-order (every nonempty subset has a least element), by the well-ordering theorem, enabling transfinite induction.
entries.output: Well-order on X, order type an ordinal
entries.broken: Canonicity (the order is chosen); any prior structure

entries.name: Ordinal Arithmetic Operation
entries.description: Adds, multiplies or exponentiates ordinals by concatenation, lexicographic products and limits; non-commutative (1 + omega = omega, omega + 1 > omega).

entries.name: Cardinal Arithmetic Operation
entries.description: Computes sums, products and powers of cardinalities; kappa + lambda = kappa x lambda = max for infinite cardinals; exponentiation is independent of ZFC in general.

entries.name: Lexicographical Product Construction
entries.description: Orders pairs by first coordinate, ties broken by the second.

entries.name: Interval Algebra Construction
entries.description: Builds the Boolean algebra generated by half-open intervals of a linear order; every countable Boolean algebra is one. (Also Allen's interval algebra of relations in temporal reasoning.)
entries.preserved: Order information of L up to the algebra's reach
entries.reading: Two standard meanings; the Boolean-algebra one is taken as primary for D7.

entries.name: Continuous Lattice Retraction
entries.description: Continuous lattices are exactly the retracts of powers of [0,1] (or of algebraic lattices) by Scott-continuous maps; a retraction realizes one.
entries.output: Retraction from a power of [0,1] or algebraic lattice onto L
entries.preserved: Scott-continuous structure; injectivity in T0 spaces

entries.name: Algebraic Lattice Compactification
entries.description: Represents a lattice through its compact elements: an algebraic lattice is the ideal completion of its join-semilattice of compact elements.
entries.output: Algebraic lattice Idl(K), or its compact elements K
entries.reading: Nonstandard name. Read as the correspondence between algebraic lattices and their compact elements.

entries.name: Scott Topology Construction
entries.description: Topologizes a dcpo: open sets are up-sets inaccessible by directed joins. Continuous maps are exactly Scott-continuous functions.

entries.name: Lawson Topology Construction
entries.description: Refines the Scott topology with the lower topology; compact Hausdorff on continuous lattices.
entries.broken: Only the Scott-continuous maps remain order-significant

entries.name: Modular Law Reduction
entries.description: Uses x <= z implies x v (y ^ z) = (x v y) ^ z.

entries.name: Distributive Law Reduction
entries.description: Uses x ^ (y v z) = (x ^ y) v (x ^ z) to normalize lattice terms.

entries.name: Semimodularity Transformation
entries.description: Tests or uses (upper) semimodularity: if a and b both cover a ^ b then a v b covers both. Geometric lattices are the semimodular atomistic ones, the lattices of flats of matroids.
entries.reading: Nonstandard name. Read as the semimodular structure (and the matroid correspondence it enables).

entries.name: Jordan-Dedekind Chain Reduction
entries.description: In lattices satisfying the Jordan-Dedekind condition all maximal chains between two elements have the same length, giving a rank function.
entries.input: Lattice of finite length with the condition

entries.name: M\u00f6bius Inversion
entries.description: Inverts summation over a locally finite poset: g(x) = sum_{y<=x} f(y) iff f(x) = sum mu(y, x) g(y).
entries.output: Function f and Moebius function mu

entries.name: Incidence Algebra Construction
entries.description: Forms the algebra of functions on intervals of a locally finite poset with convolution; zeta and Moebius are inverse.
entries.input: Locally finite poset P, ring R
entries.preserved: P up to isomorphism (it determines P)

entries.name: Chain Complex Construction
entries.description: Assembles objects C_n with boundary maps d: C_n to C_{n-1} satisfying d d = 0.

entries.name: Cochain Complex Construction
entries.description: Assembles objects C^n with coboundaries d: C^n to C^{n+1}, d d = 0.

entries.name: Boundary Operator Application
entries.description: Applies d to a chain: the formal boundary; cycles are its kernel, boundaries its image.

entries.name: Coboundary Operator Application
entries.description: Applies the coboundary d to a cochain (for de Rham, exterior derivative).

entries.name: Homology Group Extraction
entries.description: Computes H_n = ker d / im d: cycles modulo boundaries.
entries.broken: Chain-level detail; extension data between degrees

entries.name: Cohomology Group Extraction
entries.description: Computes H^n = ker d / im d for a cochain complex; often a ring under cup product.
entries.output: Cohomology groups H^n (often a graded ring)
entries.broken: Cochain detail; Massey products unless tracked

entries.name: Projective Resolution Construction
entries.description: Replaces a module by an exact complex of projectives ending in it.
entries.input: Module (object) M in a category with enough projectives
entries.preserved: M up to quasi-isomorphism; unique up to homotopy
entries.broken: Simplicity: one object becomes a complex

entries.name: Injective Resolution Construction
entries.description: Replaces an object by an exact complex of injectives starting from it.
entries.input: Object M in a category with enough injectives
entries.preserved: M up to quasi-isomorphism; unique up to homotopy

entries.name: Flat Resolution Construction
entries.description: Resolves a module by flat modules; suffices to compute Tor.
entries.broken: Uniqueness up to homotopy (only up to quasi-isomorphism)

entries.name: Cartan-Eilenberg Resolution
entries.description: Resolves a complex by a double complex of projectives (or injectives) whose rows resolve the terms, cycles, boundaries and homology. Used for hyperderived functors.
entries.input: Chain complex in an abelian category with enough projectives
entries.preserved: Homology of the complex; hypertor and hyperext

entries.name: Horseshoe Lemma Construction
entries.description: Given resolutions of the ends of a short exact sequence, builds a compatible resolution of the middle.
entries.input: Short exact sequence 0 to A to B to C to 0, resolutions of A and C
entries.output: Resolution of B fitting in a short exact sequence of resolutions
entries.preserved: Exactness; long exact sequences of derived functors

entries.name: Snake Lemma Connecting Homomorphism
entries.description: From a map of short exact sequences, produces a six-term exact sequence of kernels and cokernels with a connecting map ker c to coker a.
entries.input: Commutative diagram of two short exact sequences
entries.output: Exact sequence ker a to ker b to ker c to coker a to coker b to coker c

entries.name: Zig-Zag Lemma Application
entries.description: A short exact sequence of chain complexes gives a long exact sequence in homology with connecting maps.

entries.name: Nine Lemma Reduction
entries.description: In a 3x3 diagram with exact columns, exactness of two rows implies the third.

entries.name: Five Lemma Reduction
entries.description: In a map between five-term exact rows, if the outer four maps are isomorphisms so is the middle.
entries.output: Isomorphism verdict on the middle map

entries.name: Left Derived Functor Computation
entries.description: Computes L_n F(A) = H_n(F(P)) for a projective resolution P of A: the correction for F's failure of left exactness.
entries.input: Right exact functor F, object A
entries.preserved: L_0 F = F; long exact sequences

entries.name: Right Derived Functor Computation
entries.description: Computes R^n F(A) = H^n(F(I)) for an injective resolution I.
entries.input: Left exact functor F, object A
entries.preserved: R^0 F = F; long exact sequences

entries.name: Tor Functor Evaluation
entries.description: Computes Tor_n(M, N), the left derived functors of the tensor product; Tor_1 measures torsion and non-flatness.

entries.name: Ext Functor Evaluation
entries.description: Computes Ext^n(M, N), the right derived functors of Hom; Ext^1 classifies extensions.

entries.name: Mapping Cone Construction
entries.description: Forms the complex C(f) = Y (+) X[1] with a twisted differential; f is a quasi-isomorphism iff C(f) is acyclic. Gives distinguished triangles.
entries.input: Chain map f: X to Y
entries.preserved: Long exact sequence relating X, Y, C(f)
entries.broken: Uniqueness up to non-unique isomorphism in the derived category

entries.name: Mapping Cylinder Construction
entries.description: Replaces f: X to Y by an inclusion into a homotopy equivalent object Cyl(f).
entries.output: Cylinder Cyl(f) with X to Cyl(f), Cyl(f) to Y a homotopy equivalence

entries.name: Chain Homotopy Equivalence
entries.description: Maps f, g with g f and f g chain homotopic to identities.

entries.name: Quasi-Isomorphism Reduction
entries.description: Treats a chain map inducing isomorphisms on homology as an equivalence; the derived category inverts them.

entries.name: Euler Characteristic Computation
entries.description: Computes the alternating sum of ranks (of chain groups or homology); additive on exact sequences.

entries.name: Betti Number Extraction
entries.description: Computes ranks of homology groups.

entries.name: Hilbert-Poincar\u00e9 Series Expansion
entries.description: Packages the dimensions of the graded pieces of a graded module or ring as the power series sum dim(M_n) t^n; rational for finitely generated modules over polynomial rings (Hilbert-Serre).

entries.name: Koszul Complex Construction
entries.description: Builds the complex of exterior powers of R^n with differential contracting with a sequence (x_1, ..., x_n); a resolution when the sequence is regular.
entries.preserved: Depth detection; resolution of R/(x) for regular sequences

entries.name: Koszul Cohomology Evaluation
entries.description: Computes homology or cohomology of Koszul complexes; for graded modules, syzygy data (Green's Koszul cohomology of line bundles).
entries.input: Graded module or line bundle data

entries.name: Bar Construction
entries.description: Resolves an algebra or builds a classifying space: B(A) with tensor powers of A and alternating face maps; B G for a group.

entries.name: Cobar Construction
entries.description: Dual of the bar construction for coalgebras; Omega B A is a resolution of A (Koszul duality).

entries.name: Hochschild Homology Computation
entries.description: Computes HH_*(A) = Tor over A (x) A^op of (A, A); the algebraic analogue of differential forms (HKR).

entries.name: Hochschild Cohomology Computation
entries.description: Computes HH^*(A) = Ext of (A, A) over A (x) A^op; classifies derivations and deformations; a Gerstenhaber algebra.
entries.output: HH^n(A) with cup product and Gerstenhaber bracket

entries.name: Cyclic Homology Computation
entries.description: Computes HC_*(A), the homology of cyclic invariants; the noncommutative de Rham cohomology (Connes, Tsygan).
entries.preserved: Morita invariance; Connes SBI sequence with HH

entries.name: Factorization Homology Computation
entries.description: Integrates an E_n-algebra over an n-manifold: a homology theory for manifolds (Ayala, Francis; Lurie).
entries.preserved: Excision; for M = circle, Hochschild homology

entries.name: Topological Hochschild Homology Transformation
entries.description: Hochschild homology over the sphere spectrum instead of Z: THH(R) for ring spectra (Boekstedt).
entries.preserved: Trace methods; approximates algebraic K-theory via TC

entries.name: Group Homology Construction
entries.description: Computes H_n(G, M) = Tor over Z[G] of (Z, M); topologically the homology of B G.
entries.preserved: Group structure up to homological information

entries.name: Group Cohomology Construction
entries.description: Computes H^n(G, M) = Ext over Z[G] of (Z, M); H^2 classifies extensions, H^1 crossed homomorphisms.

entries.name: Galois Cohomology Transformation
entries.description: Group cohomology of the absolute Galois group with coefficients in Galois modules; H^1 classifies torsors and forms.

entries.name: \u010cech Cohomology Computation
entries.description: Computes cohomology from an open cover via cochains on finite intersections; agrees with sheaf cohomology for good covers.

entries.name: Sheaf Cohomology Computation
entries.description: Computes right derived functors of global sections.

entries.name: Crystalline Cohomology Transformation
entries.description: A p-adic cohomology for varieties in characteristic p via divided-power thickenings (Berthelot, Grothendieck).
entries.input: Smooth proper variety over a perfect field of characteristic p

entries.name: Motif Extraction
entries.description: Assigns to a variety its motive, the universal cohomology theory from which Betti, de Rham, etale and crystalline realizations factor (Grothendieck; Voevodsky).
entries.reading: Motif read as motive in Grothendieck's sense.

entries.name: Spectral Sequence Initialization
entries.description: Sets up the first page E_1 or E_2 from a filtered complex, double complex or exact couple.
entries.input: Filtered complex, double complex or exact couple
entries.preserved: Information to converge to total homology
entries.broken: Extension problems remain at the end

entries.name: Spectral Sequence Page Differential Application
entries.description: Applies d_r of bidegree (-r, r - 1) (or (r, 1 - r)) and passes to E_{r+1} = H(E_r, d_r).

entries.name: Spectral Sequence Convergence Limit
entries.description: Reads the associated graded of the target from E_infinity.
entries.output: E_infinity and a filtration on the target

entries.name: Serre Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = H_p(B; H_q(F)) converges to H_{p+q}(E) for a fibration F to E to B.
entries.output: Spectral sequence converging to homology of the total space

entries.name: Grothendieck Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = R^p G(R^q F(A)) converges to R^{p+q}(G F)(A) when F sends injectives to G-acyclics.
entries.input: Composable left exact functors F, G

entries.name: Leray Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = H^p(Y, R^q f_* F) converges to H^{p+q}(X, F) for f: X to Y.

entries.name: Eilenberg-Moore Spectral Sequence
entries.description: Computes the cohomology of a pullback (or loop space) as Tor over the cohomology of the base.
entries.input: Fibration and a map into its base

entries.name: K\u00fcnneth Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = Tor(H(X), H(Y)) converges to H(X (x) Y) (or for products of spaces over general coefficients).
entries.output: Spectral sequence to homology of the tensor product

entries.name: Adams Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = Ext over the Steenrod algebra of (H^*(Y), H^*(X)) converges to p-completed stable homotopy classes [X, Y].

entries.name: Atiyah-Hirzebruch Spectral Sequence
entries.description: E_2 = H^p(X; h^q(pt)) converges to h^{p+q}(X) for a generalized cohomology theory h.
entries.input: CW complex X, cohomology theory h

entries.name: Bockstein Spectral Sequence
entries.description: Starts at mod-p homology and detects higher p-torsion through Bockstein differentials.
entries.output: Spectral sequence converging to (free part) mod p

entries.name: Connes Spectral Sequence
entries.description: The spectral sequence from Hochschild to cyclic homology associated with the (b, B) bicomplex.

entries.name: Hyperhomology Spectral Sequence
entries.description: The two spectral sequences of a double complex computing hyperderived functors of a complex.

entries.name: Gersten-Witt Spectral Sequence
entries.description: A coniveau spectral sequence for Witt groups of schemes (Balmer and Walter), yielding a Gersten complex for Witt groups of regular local rings.
entries.output: Spectral sequence to derived Witt groups

entries.name: Green's Spectral Sequence
entries.description: Unidentified as a standard named spectral sequence. Candidate readings: the Green-Lazarsfeld type spectral sequences for Koszul cohomology, or Green's work on spectral sequences for stable module categories.
entries.reading: Could not identify this name with confidence. Fields left as Unknown rather than invented.

entries.name: Exact Couple Construction
entries.description: Packages maps D to D to E to D forming an exact triangle; deriving it repeatedly yields a spectral sequence (Massey).
entries.input: Long exact sequences (for example from a filtration)
entries.output: Exact couple (D, E, i, j, k)

entries.name: Derived Category Construction
entries.description: Localizes complexes at quasi-isomorphisms: D(A) = K(A)[qis^-1].
entries.preserved: Homology; derived functors become ordinary functors

entries.name: Triangulated Category Shift Functor
entries.description: Applies the suspension [1], an autoequivalence part of triangulated structure.

entries.name: Distinguished Triangle Formation
entries.description: Completes a morphism X to Y to a triangle X to Y to Z to X[1]; the cone is unique up to non-unique isomorphism.
entries.preserved: Long exact sequences under homological functors

entries.name: T-Structure Truncation
entries.description: Truncates an object by a t-structure into tau_{<=0} and tau_{>=1} parts; the heart is abelian.
entries.input: Triangulated category with t-structure, object X

entries.name: Transgression Map Application
entries.description: Relates cohomology of the fiber to that of the base in a fibration via the partially defined map on the Serre spectral sequence edge.

entries.name: Dold-Kan Correspondence Transformation
entries.description: Equivalence between simplicial abelian groups and nonnegatively graded chain complexes.

entries.name: Topos Internalization
entries.description: Reinterprets a mathematical construction inside a topos using its internal (intuitionistic, higher-order) language.
entries.output: Internal object or theorem in E

entries.name: Geometric Morphism Construction
entries.description: A pair f^* left of f_* between toposes with f^* preserving finite limits: the morphisms of toposes.
entries.output: Geometric morphism f: E to F
entries.preserved: Geometric logic (inverse image preserves geometric formulas)

entries.name: Direct Image Functor
entries.description: The right adjoint f_* of a geometric morphism: pushforward of sheaves.
entries.input: Geometric morphism f: E to F
entries.broken: Colimits; exactness (derived functors R f_* measure it)

entries.name: Inverse Image Functor
entries.description: The left exact left adjoint f^*: pullback of sheaves.
