entries.preserved: Finite limits and all colimits; geometric formulas
entries.broken: Infinite limits; implication and universal quantification

entries.name: Logical Functor Application
entries.description: Applies a functor between toposes preserving finite limits, exponentials and the subobject classifier, hence all higher-order logic.
entries.broken: Colimits need not be preserved beyond finite ones

entries.name: Essential Geometric Morphism
entries.description: A geometric morphism whose inverse image also has a left adjoint f_!.
entries.output: Triple f_! left of f^* left of f_*

lean.note: f^* preserves limits.
f^* preserves colimits.

formal.note: f^* is right adjoint to f_! in the essential triple, so it preserves limits.
f^* is left adjoint to f_* in the triple, so it preserves colimits.

entries.name: Atomic Geometric Morphism
entries.description: A geometric morphism whose inverse image is logical; e.g. Galois toposes over Set.

entries.name: Local Homeomorphism Transformation
entries.description: A geometric morphism equivalent to E/X to E (etale); for spaces, a local homeomorphism corresponds to a sheaf.
entries.output: Etale geometric morphism E/X to E

entries.name: Grothendieck Topology Generation
entries.description: Specifies covering sieves on a category (closed under pullback, local character), making it a site.
entries.broken: Presheaves that fail to glue are excluded

entries.name: Lawvere-Tierney Topology Closure
entries.description: An operator j: Omega to Omega (inflationary, idempotent, meet-preserving); gives a closure on subobjects and a subtopos of j-sheaves.

entries.name: Sieve Saturation
entries.description: Replaces a family of morphisms by the sieve it generates, or a sieve by the closure under the topology.
entries.input: Family of maps into an object

entries.name: Sheafification
entries.description: Left adjoint to the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves; the plus construction applied twice.
entries.broken: Local information that does not glue

entries.name: Presheaf Category Formation
entries.description: Forms [C^op, Set], the free cocompletion of C.

entries.name: Classifying Topos Construction
entries.description: For a geometric theory T builds a topos Set[T] whose points (geometric morphisms from E) are T-models in E.
entries.output: Classifying topos Set[T] with generic model
entries.broken: Syntax presentation (Morita-equivalent theories have the same topos)

entries.name: Syntactic Category Construction
entries.description: Builds a category whose objects are formulas in context and morphisms provably functional relations; models are functors out of it.

entries.name: Effective Topos Construction
entries.description: Hyland's realizability topos over Kleene's first algebra: sets with realizers; every function N to N is computable internally.

entries.name: Object Classifier Evaluation
entries.description: In a higher topos, classifies morphisms (up to size) by maps into a universe object; the univalent universe.

entries.name: Diaconescu's Theorem Transformation
entries.description: Two theorems: (1) geometric morphisms E to presheaves on C correspond to flat functors C to E; (2) the internal axiom of choice implies excluded middle in a topos.
entries.input: Topos and small category (1); topos with choice (2)
entries.reading: The name matches two distinct theorems; both are recorded.

entries.name: Freyd Cover Construction
entries.description: Glues a topos along the global sections functor (Artin gluing, Sierpinski cone); proves disjunction and existence properties of intuitionistic logic.

entries.name: Hyperdoctrine Quotient Completion
entries.description: Adds quotients of equivalence relations to a doctrine (Maietti and Rosolini), building elementary quotient completions.

entries.name: Kripke-Joyal Semantics Interpretation
entries.description: Interprets internal formulas in a topos by forcing at stages (objects of a site).
entries.input: Formula in the internal language, topos

entries.name: Mitchell-B\u00e9nabou Language Translation
entries.description: Assigns to a topos its internal typed higher-order language.

entries.name: Forcing Interpretation in Topos
entries.description: Recasts Cohen forcing as passing to a sheaf topos (on a poset of conditions with the double-negation topology).
entries.broken: The continuum hypothesis (fails in the constructed model)

entries.name: Categorical Comprehension Evaluation
entries.description: Interprets comprehension {x | phi(x)} as the subobject or comprehension category (Lawvere, Jacobs).

entries.name: Categorical Quantifier Adjunction
entries.description: Existential and universal quantification as left and right adjoints to pullback (weakening): exists_f left of f^* left of forall_f.

entries.name: Dialectica Category Construction
entries.description: Categorical models of Goedel's Dialectica interpretation (de Paiva): objects are relations U x X to 2, morphisms pairs going forward and backward.

entries.name: Chu Space Construction
entries.description: Objects (A, X, r) with r: A x X to K; morphisms adjoint pairs. A star-autonomous model of linear logic.
entries.input: Symmetric monoidal closed category, dualizing object K

entries.name: Finiteness Space Construction
entries.description: Ehrhard's spaces: a set with a family of finitary subsets closed under orthogonal duality, giving a linear-logic model with linear maps as matrices.

entries.name: Coherent Logic Interpretation
entries.description: Interprets coherent (positive, finite disjunction) formulas in coherent categories.

entries.name: Geometric Logic Interpretation
entries.description: Interprets geometric formulas (finite conjunction, arbitrary disjunction, existentials) in toposes; preserved by inverse images.

entries.name: Cartesian Closed Category Semantics
entries.description: Interprets simply typed lambda calculus: types as objects, terms as morphisms, lambda as currying.

entries.name: Lambda Calculus Categorification
entries.description: The equivalence (Lambek) between typed lambda theories and Cartesian closed categories; the free CCC is the term model.

entries.name: Curry-Howard Correspondence Translation
entries.description: Translates proofs to programs and propositions to types (and to morphisms of a CCC: Curry-Howard-Lambek).

entries.name: Realizability Interpretation
entries.description: Interprets formulas by sets of realizers (programs) witnessing truth (Kleene).

entries.name: Coalgebraic Modal Logic Transformation
entries.description: Interprets modal logic over coalgebras of a functor via predicate liftings; bisimulation invariance.

entries.name: Stone Duality Transformation
entries.description: Dual equivalences between algebras and spaces: Boolean algebras and Stone spaces, frames and locales, commutative C*-algebras and compact Hausdorff spaces.

entries.name: Isbell Conjugacy
entries.description: The adjoint pair of Isbell conjugation between presheaves and copresheaves (the same as the Isbell duality transformation, stated as an operation).

entries.name: Giraud Theorem Framing
entries.description: Characterizes Grothendieck toposes intrinsically: exact, extensive, with a small generating set, and colimits commuting with pullbacks.

entries.name: Boolean Topos Reduction
entries.description: Passes to the double-negation subtopos, which is Boolean.

entries.name: Double Negation Translation
entries.description: Embeds classical logic in intuitionistic logic (Goedel-Gentzen, Kolmogorov), and topos-theoretically the not-not sheafification.
entries.broken: Constructive content of disjunction and existence

entries.name: Homotopy Coherent Nerve Construction
entries.description: Turns a simplicially enriched category into a quasicategory (Cordier); right adjoint of the rigidification.

entries.name: Simplicial Set Generation
entries.description: Builds a simplicial set from data: nerves of categories, singular complexes of spaces, or free generation from simplices.
entries.broken: Topology of the input beyond homotopy

entries.name: Kan Complex Fibration
entries.description: A map with the right lifting property against all horn inclusions; Kan complexes model spaces.

entries.name: Quasicategory Formulation
entries.description: Models an (infinity, 1)-category as a simplicial set with inner horn fillers (Joyal, Lurie).

entries.name: Straightening of Left Fibrations
entries.description: Lurie's equivalence: left fibrations over S correspond to functors S to spaces.

entries.name: Unstraightening Transformation
entries.description: The inverse direction: a functor S to Cat_infinity (or spaces) becomes a (co)Cartesian fibration (the infinity-Grothendieck construction).

entries.name: Cartesian Fibration
entries.description: A functor where every morphism in the base has Cartesian lifts; encodes contravariant families of categories.

entries.name: Cocartesian Fibration
entries.description: Dual: every base morphism has cocartesian lifts; covariant families.

entries.name: Inner Fibration
entries.description: A map of simplicial sets with lifting against inner horns; fibers are quasicategories.

entries.name: Left Fibration
entries.description: A map lifting against left horns; fibers are Kan complexes, covariant in the base.

entries.name: Right Fibration
entries.description: A map lifting against right horns; presheaves of spaces.

entries.name: Weak Equivalence Reduction
entries.description: Treats weak equivalences as isomorphisms in the homotopy category.
entries.broken: Point-set level structure; homotopy limits need care

entries.name: Bousfield Localization
entries.description: Enlarges the weak equivalences of a model category, keeping cofibrations; localizes spaces or spectra at a homology theory.
entries.input: Model category, class of maps or homology theory
entries.broken: Information invisible to the chosen theory

entries.name: Path Category Construction
entries.description: Builds a category of paths (Moore paths or free path category of a graph); also a category with a path object structure (Van den Berg and Moerdijk).
entries.preserved: Paths up to reparametrization or identity
entries.reading: Several standard meanings; recorded generically.

entries.name: Suspension Functor Application
entries.description: Forms S X, the double cone; left adjoint to loops. Shifts homology up by one.

entries.name: Loop Space Functor Application
entries.description: Forms Omega X of based loops; right adjoint to suspension; an A_infinity-space.
entries.broken: pi_0 of X; components not containing the basepoint

entries.name: Homotopy Pullback
entries.description: The pullback made homotopy invariant (replace a map by a fibration first).

entries.name: Homotopy Pushout
entries.description: The pushout made homotopy invariant (double mapping cylinder).

entries.name: Fiber Sequence Construction
entries.description: Extends f: X to Y to the Puppe sequence ... Omega Y to F to X to Y.
entries.preserved: Long exact sequence of homotopy groups

entries.name: Cofiber Sequence Construction
entries.description: Extends f to X to Y to C f to S X to ...

entries.name: Postnikov Tower Construction
entries.description: Approximates a space by stages X_n with pi_k(X_n) = pi_k(X) for k <= n and zero above; k-invariants glue stages.

entries.name: Whitehead Tower Construction
entries.description: Dual: kills homotopy groups from below by successive connected covers.

entries.name: Strictification of 2-Categories
entries.description: Every bicategory is biequivalent to a strict 2-category (Mac Lane and Pare).

entries.name: Lax Monoidal Construction
entries.description: Equips a functor with maps F A (x) F B to F(A (x) B) and a unit map, not necessarily invertible.

entries.name: Opetopic Set Generation
entries.description: Builds higher categorical shapes from opetopes (Baez and Dolan): cells with many inputs and one output.

entries.name: Segal Category Construction
entries.description: Models (infinity, 1)-categories as simplicial spaces with discrete objects satisfying the Segal condition.

entries.name: Complete Segal Space Transformation
entries.description: Rezk's model: Segal spaces whose space of objects is equivalent to the space of equivalences.

entries.name: Simplicially Enriched Category Formulation
entries.description: Presents an infinity-category as a category enriched in simplicial sets (Bergner model structure).

entries.name: Topologically Enriched Category Formulation
entries.description: Presents a category with spaces of morphisms.

entries.name: Operadic Composition
entries.description: Composes operations: gamma: P(k) x P(n_1) x ... x P(n_k) to P(n_1 + ... + n_k).

entries.name: Operadic Whiskering
entries.description: Composes an operation with the identity on some inputs (partial composition o_i).

entries.name: Multicategory Free Construction
entries.description: Generates the free multicategory (colored operad) on a signature of multi-input operations.

entries.name: Biased to Unbiased Bicategory Transformation
entries.description: Passes between bicategories with binary composition and those with composition of all arities (Leinster); they are equivalent.

entries.name: Boardman-Vogt Tensor Product
entries.description: Tensor of operads whose algebras are P-algebras in Q-algebras with interchange; E_m (x) E_n = E_{m+n} (Dunn additivity).

entries.name: Little Cubes Operad Application
entries.description: Acts by embeddings of little n-cubes into the unit cube; E_n-algebras are n-fold loop spaces up to group completion (May).
entries.preserved: Commutativity up to homotopy in n directions

entries.name: Swiss-Cheese Operad Application
entries.description: Two-colored operad of disks and half-disks (Voronov) modeling bulk-boundary structure; Kontsevich's deformation quantization.

entries.name: A_\\infty-Algebra Formulation
entries.description: Replaces associativity by a hierarchy of higher homotopies m_n; homotopy transfer preserves the structure.

entries.name: L_\\infty-Algebra Formulation
entries.description: Lie algebra up to coherent homotopy with brackets l_n; controls deformation problems.
entries.preserved: Jacobi up to homotopy; Maurer-Cartan elements

entries.name: E_\\infty-Algebra Formulation
entries.description: Commutative algebra up to all coherent homotopies; infinite loop spaces and cochains.

entries.name: Colored Operad Construction
entries.description: Operad with a set of colors (types); algebras are multisorted.

entries.name: Cyclic Operad Transformation
entries.description: Adds an action letting inputs and output be permuted cyclically (Getzler and Kapranov).

entries.name: Braided Operad Transformation
entries.description: Replaces symmetric groups by braid groups in the equivariance; algebras live in braided monoidal categories.

entries.name: PRO Construction
entries.description: A strict monoidal category whose objects are natural numbers with addition: many inputs, many outputs, no symmetry.
entries.input: Signature of operations m to n

entries.name: PROP Construction
entries.description: A symmetric monoidal category on the natural numbers: many inputs and many outputs with symmetry (bialgebras, Frobenius algebras).

entries.name: Trees and Grafting Operation
entries.description: Composes rooted trees by grafting a root onto a leaf; the free operad on generators is trees labeled by generators.

entries.name: Koszul Duality for Operads
entries.description: Associates to a quadratic operad P its dual P! (Ginzburg and Kapranov); Com and Lie, Ass and Ass are dual.
entries.output: Koszul dual operad; minimal resolution when Koszul
entries.preserved: Homotopy algebras (P_infinity from the cobar of P!)

entries.name: Kelly-Mac Lane Coherence Construction
entries.description: Decides which diagrams commute in closed (monoidal) categories via graphs of variables (Kelly and Mac Lane, 1971).
entries.input: Diagram in a free closed category

entries.name: Higher Topos Construction
entries.description: Builds an infinity-topos: left exact localization of presheaves of spaces (Lurie, Rezk, Toen and Vezzosi).

entries.name: Lens Get Extraction
entries.description: Reads the focus of a lens out of a whole: get: S to A.
entries.preserved: Lens laws (get after put returns what was put)
entries.broken: The residual complement of the whole

entries.name: Lens Set Modification
entries.description: Replaces the focus: put: S x A to S.
entries.input: Lens, whole s, new focus a

entries.name: Lens Modify Application
entries.description: Applies f: A to A through a lens: over f s = put(s, f(get s)).

entries.name: Prism Match Evaluation
entries.description: Tests whether a sum-type value matches a case: match: S to A + S (a partial get).

entries.name: Prism Build Construction
entries.description: Injects a focus into the sum: build: A to S.

entries.name: Traversal Optic Application
entries.description: Focuses on zero or more parts and maps an applicative effect over them (traverse).

entries.name: Iso Optic Transformation
entries.description: An invertible optic: a pair S to A, A to S that are mutual inverses.

entries.name: Grate Optic Transformation
entries.description: Optic for function-like (representable) structures: grate: ((S to A) to B) to T.

entries.name: Adapter Optic Transformation
entries.description: The simplest optic: a pair of maps S to A and B to T, with no residual.

entries.name: Setter Optic Transformation
entries.description: An optic that can only modify: (A to B) to (S to T).

entries.name: Getter Optic Transformation
entries.description: An optic that can only read: S to A.

entries.name: Fold Optic Extraction
entries.description: Read-only traversal: collects zero or more foci into a monoid.

entries.name: Profunctor Optic Tambara Module Application
entries.description: Represents an optic as a transformation natural in all Tambara modules (Pastro and Street; Riley; Clarke and coauthors).

entries.name: Mezzolens Construction
entries.description: An optic intermediate between lenses and traversals (O'Connor's mezzolens), focusing on a structure through a monoidal action.
entries.reading: Name recognized from functional-programming literature; details recorded from memory.

entries.name: String Diagram Wiring Operation
entries.description: Composes diagrams by plugging wires (operad of wiring diagrams, Spivak).

entries.name: Dagger Functor Inversion
entries.description: Applies the involution f to f^dagger reversing morphisms (the Hilbert-space adjoint).

entries.name: Completely Positive Map Transformation
entries.description: A map on operators that stays positive after tensoring with any identity; quantum channels are trace-preserving ones.

entries.name: Dagger Compact Closed Categorification
entries.description: Models finite-dimensional quantum mechanics as a dagger compact closed category (Abramsky and Coecke).

entries.name: Selinger's CPM Construction
entries.description: Builds completely positive maps from a dagger compact category: CPM(C), mixed states from pure ones.

entries.name: Stinespring Dilation
entries.description: Writes a completely positive map as an isometry into a larger space followed by a partial trace.

entries.name: Gelfand-Naimark-Segal Construction
entries.description: Builds a Hilbert-space representation of a C*-algebra from a state.

entries.name: Frobenius Algebra Measurement Operation
entries.description: Uses a special commutative dagger Frobenius algebra (an orthonormal basis) to copy and delete classical data.

entries.name: Spider Theorem Reduction
entries.description: Any connected diagram of Frobenius algebra operations equals a single spider depending only on its numbers of inputs and outputs.

entries.name: ZX-Calculus Diagrammatic Rewrite
entries.description: Rewrites ZX diagrams by spider fusion, color change and other rules; complete for qubit quantum mechanics.

entries.name: ZW-Calculus Diagrammatic Rewrite
entries.description: Rewrites diagrams generated by Z-spiders and W-nodes; complete (Hadzihasanovic).

entries.name: ZH-Calculus Diagrammatic Rewrite
entries.description: Rewrites diagrams with Z-spiders and H-boxes, suited to Toffoli and hypergraph states; complete.

entries.name: Quantum Channel Composition
entries.description: Composes completely positive trace-preserving maps sequentially or in parallel.

entries.name: Trace Evaluation
entries.description: Computes a categorical trace (feedback loop) in a traced monoidal category; the matrix trace in vector spaces.
entries.broken: Everything but the scalar or reduced map

entries.name: Marginalization Transformation
entries.description: Discards a subsystem (partial trace, or summing out a variable).

entries.name: Open System Resource Transducer
entries.description: Resource theories as symmetric monoidal categories (Coecke, Fritz, Spekkens): free processes convert resources.
entries.reading: Nonstandard name. Read as a free process in a categorical resource theory.

entries.name: Matrix Exponential Transformation
entries.description: exp: Lie algebra to Lie group; local diffeomorphism near 0.

entries.name: Tangent Space Differentiation
entries.description: Differentiates a Lie group homomorphism at the identity to get a Lie algebra map.
entries.broken: Global topology (covers have the same algebra)

entries.name: Jordan-Chevalley Decomposition
entries.description: Writes an endomorphism as commuting semisimple plus nilpotent parts, each a polynomial in it.
entries.input: Linear operator over a perfect field

entries.name: Root Space Decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes a semisimple Lie algebra under a Cartan subalgebra into root spaces.

entries.name: Weyl Character Formula Application
entries.description: Computes the character of an irreducible representation from its highest weight: alternating sum over the Weyl group divided by the Weyl denominator.

entries.name: Killing Form Evaluation
entries.description: Computes B(x, y) = tr(ad x ad y); nondegenerate iff semisimple (Cartan's criterion).

entries.name: Cartan Subalgebra Extraction
entries.description: Finds a nilpotent self-normalizing subalgebra (maximal toral in the semisimple case).

entries.name: Dynkin Diagram Classification
entries.description: Encodes a root system by simple roots and angles; classifies simple Lie algebras (A to G).

entries.name: Highest Weight Representation
entries.description: Constructs or classifies irreducible representations by dominant integral highest weights.

entries.name: Schur's Lemma Application
entries.description: Morphisms between simple modules are zero or isomorphisms; over algebraically closed fields endomorphisms are scalars.

entries.name: Quillen's Lemma Application
entries.description: Endomorphisms of a simple module over the enveloping algebra (of finite-dimensional Lie algebras) are algebraic over the field.

entries.name: Whitehead's Lemma Resolution
entries.description: For semisimple Lie algebras, H^1 and H^2 with finite-dimensional coefficients vanish.

entries.name: Verma Module Construction
entries.description: Induces from a character of a Borel subalgebra: U(g) (x) over U(b) of C_lambda; universal highest weight module.

entries.name: Weyl's Complete Reducibility Transformation
entries.description: Finite-dimensional representations of semisimple Lie algebras (compact groups) decompose into irreducibles.

entries.name: Borel Subalgebra Extraction
entries.description: Finds a maximal solvable subalgebra (Cartan plus positive roots).

entries.name: Levi Decomposition
entries.description: Writes a finite-dimensional Lie algebra (char 0) as radical semidirect semisimple.

entries.name: Mal'cev Decomposition
entries.description: Levi factors are conjugate (Mal'cev-Harish-Chandra); for groups, Mal'cev completion of nilpotent groups.
entries.output: Conjugacy of Levi factors (or rational completion)
entries.reading: Name admits several standard results by Mal'cev; the Levi-conjugacy reading is taken.

entries.name: Ado's Theorem Matrix Embedding
entries.description: Every finite-dimensional Lie algebra over a field of characteristic 0 has a faithful finite-dimensional representation.

entries.name: Iwasawa Decomposition
entries.description: G = K A N for a real semisimple Lie group.

entries.name: Kazhdan-Lusztig Polynomial Transformation
entries.description: Polynomials indexed by pairs of Weyl group elements from the Hecke algebra's KL basis; give multiplicities in category O and intersection cohomology of Schubert varieties.

entries.name: Abel Transform
entries.description: Projects axisymmetric 2D density to 1D line profile via line-of-sight integration. Inverse is Abel inversion.

entries.name: Aboodh Transform
entries.description: Scaled Laplace variant: A{f}(v) = (1/v)int_0^inf f(t)e^{-vt}dt. Simplifies boundary conditions for fractional ODEs.

entries.name: Bateman Transform
entries.description: Integral transform for wave equation solutions.

entries.name: Fourier Transform
entries.description: = D6-022 (Continuous Fourier transform). Primary entry.
entries.input: Function f in L^1(R) or L^2(R)
entries.output: Fourier transform f-hat in frequency domain

entries.name: Fourier Cosine Transform
entries.description: Real symmetric variant: F_c{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)cos(ut)dt. For even functions on [0,inf).

entries.name: Fractional Fourier Transform
entries.description: F^alpha: continuous rotation by angle alpha in time-frequency plane. alpha=pi/2 gives standard Fourier.

entries.name: Short-Time Fourier Transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Rectangular Mask Short-Time Fourier Transform
entries.description: Short-time Fourier transform with a rectangular (boxcar) window: the Fourier transform of each windowed segment.
entries.preserved: Energy up to window normalization; invertibility with sufficient overlap
entries.broken: Frequency resolution (sidelobe leakage from the sharp window)

entries.name: Fourier-Bros-Iagolnitzer Transform
entries.description: Phase-space transform for microlocal analysis. Gaussian-windowed Fourier detects wavefront sets.

entries.name: Gabor Transform
entries.description: STFT with Gaussian window. Achieves minimum Heisenberg uncertainty product.

entries.name: Hankel Transform
entries.description: Kernel: t J_nu(ut) (Bessel function). For cylindrically symmetric functions. Diagonalizes radial Laplacian.

entries.name: Hartley Transform
entries.description: Kernel: cas(ut) = cos(ut)+sin(ut). Real-valued, self-inverse.

entries.name: Hermite Transform
entries.description: Expansion in Hermite functions H_n(x)e^{-x^2/2}. Optimal for Gaussian-weighted L^2.
entries.preserved: Orthogonality in Gaussian-weighted space, quantum oscillator eigenstates

entries.name: Hilbert Transform
entries.description: Kernel: 1/(pi(u-t)). Principal value integral. 90-degree phase shift. Constructs analytic signal.
entries.output: Hilbert transform Hf (imaginary part of analytic signal)
entries.preserved: L^2 norm, analytic signal construction, power spectrum

entries.name: Hilbert-Schmidt Integral Operator
entries.description: The integral operator (K f)(x) = integral k(x, y) f(y) dy with square-integrable kernel; compact, and the kernel's L^2 norm equals the Hilbert-Schmidt norm.
entries.input: Kernel k in L^2(X x Y), function f in L^2(Y)
entries.broken: Invertibility (compact operators on infinite-dimensional spaces are not invertible)

entries.name: Jacobi Transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Laguerre Transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: Laplace Transform
entries.description: Kernel: e^{-st}. Maps time domain to complex s-plane. Reduces ODEs to algebraic. F(s) = int_0^inf f(t)e^{-st}dt.
entries.input: Function f(t) on [0,inf) with exponential growth bound

entries.name: Inverse Laplace Transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.

entries.name: Two-Sided Laplace Transform
entries.description: The bilateral Laplace transform F(s) = integral over R of f(t) e^{-s t} dt, converging in a vertical strip; contains the Fourier transform on the imaginary axis and the moment generating function.
entries.output: Analytic function F(s) on a strip
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information (invertible within the strip)
entries.broken: Causality information unless the strip is specified

entries.name: Laplace-Carson Transform
entries.description: sF(s) variant of Laplace. Historical operational calculus.

entries.name: Laplace-Stieltjes Transform
entries.description: Laplace with Stieltjes integral: int e^{-st} dF(t). For CDFs without continuous density.
entries.input: Cumulative distribution function F (not necessarily differentiable)

entries.name: Legendre Transform
entries.description: f*(p) = sup_x{px - f(x)}. Convex conjugate. Involution on convex functions.

entries.name: Associated Legendre Transform
entries.description: Expansion in associated Legendre functions P_n^m. Spherical domains.

entries.name: Linear Canonical Transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Mellin Transform
entries.description: Kernel: t^{s-1}. Maps multiplicative to additive: M{f}(s) = int_0^inf f(t)t^{s-1}dt. Scale invariance.
entries.output: M{f}(s) in vertical strip of convergence

entries.name: Inverse Mellin Transform
entries.description: f(x) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)x^{-s}ds.

entries.name: N-Transform
entries.description: Variant integral transform.

entries.name: Radon Transform
entries.description: Integrates f over hyperplanes: Rf(omega,s) = int_{x.omega=s} f(x)dx. Tomographic reconstruction core.
entries.preserved: Injectivity (for suitable classes), inversion formula, slice theorem

entries.name: X-Ray Transform
entries.description: Line integrals of function: Xf(L) = int_L f. 1D Radon. Basis of X-ray tomography.
entries.preserved: Line integrability, inversion via filtered backprojection

entries.name: Shehu Transform
entries.description: Generalized Laplace-type: combines Laplace and Sumudu properties.

entries.name: Stieltjes Transformation
entries.description: S{dmu}(z) = int dmu(t)/(z-t). Cauchy-type transform of measure. Analytic in C \ support(mu).
entries.output: Analytic function S(z) on C \ supp(mu)
entries.preserved: Analyticity, measure recovery via Stieltjes inversion

entries.name: Sumudu Transform
entries.description: S{f}(u) = (1/u) int_0^inf f(t)e^{-t/u}dt. Laplace variant preserving units and scale.

entries.name: Wavelet Transform
entries.description: = D6-024 (CWT). Primary entry. See also DWT (D6-035).
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Weierstrass Transform
entries.description: Gaussian convolution: W{f}(x) = (1/sqrt(4pi)) int f(t)e^{-(x-t)^2/4}dt. Heat equation propagator at t=1.
entries.output: Smoothed function Wf (heat diffusion at t=1)

entries.name: Discrete Hartley Transform
entries.description: Real-valued DFT alternative using cas(x)=cos(x)+sin(x).

entries.name: Discrete Sine Transform
entries.description: Sine-kernel DFT variant for odd-extension data.

entries.name: Discrete Cosine Transform
entries.description: Expresses a finite real sequence as a sum of cosines at discrete frequencies (DCT-II in common use); concentrates the energy of smooth signals in few coefficients (JPEG).
entries.output: Real coefficient sequence of length N

entries.name: Discrete Wavelet Transform
entries.description: Filter-bank implementation of wavelet analysis. Pyramid algorithm via conjugate mirror filters.

entries.name: Hadamard Transform
entries.description: H_N = (1/sqrt(N)) [[H_{N/2}, H_{N/2}],[H_{N/2},-H_{N/2}]]. Recursive +/-1 matrix. = Walsh-Hadamard.
entries.preserved: Parseval, self-inverse (up to scaling), only +/- operations

entries.name: Fast Wavelet Transform
entries.description: Mallat's algorithm: cascaded low/high-pass filtering + downsampling. O(N) implementation of DWT.

entries.name: Finite Legendre Transform
entries.description: Expansion in Legendre polynomials P_n on [-1,1].

entries.name: Irrational Base Discrete Weighted Transform
entries.description: Specialized number-theoretic transform in irrational base for crypto.

entries.name: Mojette Transform
entries.description: Discrete exact Radon on rectangular grid. Redundant projections for fault tolerance.
entries.output: Set of discrete projections along rational slopes

entries.name: Number-Theoretic Transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic Transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Stirling Transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence a_k to b_n = sum S(n, k) a_k with Stirling numbers of the second kind; the inverse uses the signed first kind. On exponential generating functions it is composition with e^x - 1.

entries.name: Z-Transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence x_n to X(z) = sum x_n z^{-n}, converging in an annulus; the discrete analogue of the Laplace transform.
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information within the region of convergence
entries.broken: Causality information unless the region is specified

entries.name: M\u00f6bius Transform
entries.description: Either the Moebius transformation z to (a z + b)/(c z + d) of the Riemann sphere, or Moebius inversion of set functions. In a category-theory domain the second (incidence algebra) reading is taken.
entries.input: Function on a locally finite poset (or subsets)
entries.reading: Ambiguous between the complex Moebius map and poset Moebius inversion; see D7-213.

entries.name: Abel transform
entries.description: Projects axisymmetric 2D density to 1D line profile via line-of-sight integration. Inverse is Abel inversion.

entries.name: Aboodh transform
entries.description: Scaled Laplace variant: A{f}(v) = (1/v)int_0^inf f(t)e^{-vt}dt. Simplifies boundary conditions for fractional ODEs.

entries.name: Affine transformation
entries.description: See Domain 4 home entry.

entries.name: Amplitude amplification transformation
entries.description: Generalized Grover iteration: rotates amplitude toward a marked subspace, boosting success probability a to near 1 in O(1/sqrt(a)) steps.
entries.input: Quantum algorithm with success amplitude sqrt(a)

entries.name: Approximation-preserving reduction
entries.description: Maps instances preserving approximation ratio for optimization.

entries.name: Associated Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in associated Legendre functions P_n^m. Spherical domains.

entries.name: Automorphism gadget transformation
entries.description: Builds local graph structure simulating automorphism constraints in reduction proofs.

entries.name: Bateman transform
entries.description: Integral transform for wave equation solutions.

entries.name: Bilinear transform
entries.description: Bilinear transform (Tustin): s=(2/T)(z-1)/(z+1). Continuous to discrete preserving stability. See D6-013.

entries.name: Binomial transform
entries.description: Transforms sequence {a_n} via binomial coefficients: b_n = sum C(n,k)(-1)^k a_k. Self-inverse.
entries.complexity: O(n^2) direct; O(n log n) via EGF

entries.name: Block Term Decomposition (BTD)
entries.description: Decomposes tensor into sum of matrix-vector outer products per block. Flexible multi-block structure.

entries.name: Bowyer-Watson transformation
entries.description: Computes Delaunay triangulation via incremental insertion with guaranteed mesh quality.

entries.name: Box-Cox transform
entries.description: The power family y = (x^lambda - 1)/lambda (log x at lambda = 0), with lambda chosen by likelihood to make data closer to normal with stable variance.

entries.name: Chambolle-Pock transformation

entries.name: Chew's second algorithm transformation
entries.description: Incremental insertion algorithm for quality Delaunay triangulation with guaranteed bounds.

entries.name: Chinese remainder algorithm transformation
entries.description: Chinese remainder reconstruction: recovers integer from residues modulo coprime moduli.

entries.name: Cholesky decomposition
entries.description: A = U*U for Hermitian positive-definite. Half cost of LU.

entries.name: Clarkson-Woodruff sketch transformation

entries.name: Clause gadget transformation
entries.description: Builds graph subnetwork simulating Boolean clause in 3SAT->GraphColoring reductions.

entries.name: Commutativity gadget transformation
entries.description: Builds graph gadget enforcing commutativity constraint in quantum/algebraic reductions.

entries.name: Confluent persistence transformation
entries.description: Transforms static read-only data structure into dynamic structure supporting O(log n) insertions/deletions via periodic rebuilding.
entries.input: Static data structure optimized for queries

entries.name: CP (CANDECOMP/PARAFAC) decomposition
entries.description: Decomposes tensor as sum of rank-1 components: T = sum lambda_r a_r o b_r o c_r. Unique under mild conditions (unlike SVD).

entries.name: Crout matrix decomposition
entries.description: Crout variant of LU decomposition: column-by-column computation.

entries.name: CUR matrix approximation
entries.description: Low-rank approximation A ≈ C * U * R selecting actual columns and rows of A. Interpretable.

entries.name: Delaunay triangulation transform
entries.description: Triangulates a point set so no point lies inside any triangle's circumcircle; dual to the Voronoi diagram.

entries.name: Discrete Chebyshev transform
entries.description: Expansion in discrete Chebyshev polynomials on finite set.

entries.name: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT)
entries.description: DFT: X_k = sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x_n e^{-2pi ikn/N}. N-point. Assumes periodicity.

entries.name: Discrete Hankel transform
entries.description: A discretization of the Hankel transform sampling at zeros of Bessel functions, approximately orthogonal; radial Fourier analysis on grids.

entries.name: Discrete Hartley transform
entries.description: Real-valued DFT alternative using cas(x)=cos(x)+sin(x).

entries.name: Discrete sine transform
entries.description: Sine-kernel DFT variant for odd-extension data.

entries.name: Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT)
entries.description: Filter-bank implementation of wavelet analysis. Pyramid algorithm via conjugate mirror filters.

entries.name: Discrete-time Fourier transform
entries.description: DTFT: X(omega) = sum x_n e^{-i omega n}. Periodic in omega. For infinite discrete sequences.

entries.name: Distance transform
entries.description: Computes Euclidean/geodesic distance from each point to nearest feature. Shape analysis foundation.

entries.name: Feature binning transformation

entries.description: Antisymmetric variant: F_s{f}(u) = sqrt(2/pi) int_0^inf f(t)sin(ut)dt.

entries.name: Series graph composition
entries.description: Constructs networks by sequential (series) concatenation of two-terminal graphs. The resulting class is efficiently analyzable for flow, resistance, and connectivity.

entries.name: Shearing transformation
entries.description: Moves points parallel to a fixed line by an amount proportional to their distance from it: (x, y) to (x + k y, y).

entries.name: Shehu transform
entries.description: See Domain 4 home entry.

entries.name: Short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: STFT: windowed Fourier for time-frequency. Heisenberg bound: Delta_t * Delta_f >= 1/(4pi).
entries.broken: Global frequency resolution (traded for time localization)

entries.name: Simplex graph transformation
entries.description: Builds a vertex per clique of G (including the empty clique), joining cliques differing by one vertex; a median graph.

entries.name: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
entries.description: Factors any matrix A = U Sigma V* with U, V unitary and Sigma diagonal nonnegative (the singular values).
entries.preserved: Rank; operator and Frobenius norms; best low-rank approximation (Eckart-Young)
entries.broken: Basis choice (singular vectors unique only up to phase and within repeated values)

entries.name: Sinkhorn normal form
entries.description: Iterative row/column normalization to doubly stochastic form.

entries.name: Source graph composition
entries.description: Unidentified as a standard named transformation.
entries.reading: Could not identify this name with confidence. Fields left as Unknown rather than invented.

entries.name: Spherical Harmonic transform
entries.description: Expansion in Y_l^m(theta,phi). Functions on S^2 decomposed into angular momentum eigenstates.

entries.name: Square root transform
entries.description: Applies y = sqrt(x), a variance-stabilizing transform for Poisson counts (Anscombe's variant sqrt(x + 3/8)).

entries.name: Stirling transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence a_k to b_n = sum S(n, k) a_k with Stirling numbers of the second kind; the inverse uses the signed first kind. On exponential generating functions it is composition with e^x - 1.

entries.name: Sub-Gaussian sketch transformation
entries.description: A sketching matrix with independent sub-Gaussian entries giving an oblivious subspace embedding.
entries.preserved: Norms on a subspace up to 1 +- epsilon

entries.name: Subresultant Pseudo-Remainder Sequence (PRS) transformation
entries.description: Computes subresultant sequence controlling coefficient growth in polynomial GCD computation.

entries.name: Succinctness transformation
entries.description: Applies any data-independent map to differentially private output. Privacy parameters preserved.
entries.output: Transformed output (still DP with same parameters)

entries.name: Sumudu transform
entries.description: Topological sort on DAG: linear ordering consistent with edge direction.

entries.name: Symbolic Cholesky decomposition
entries.description: Computes the nonzero pattern of a sparse Cholesky factor (the elimination tree and fill-in) before any numerics.
entries.input: Sparsity pattern of a symmetric positive definite matrix, ordering

entries.name: Symmetry disentangler transformation
entries.description: Builds gadget disentangling symmetric structures in quantum/complexity reductions.

entries.name: t-SVD
entries.description: Tensor SVD for 3rd-order tensors: uses FFT along tubes, applies matrix SVD in frequency domain.
entries.preserved: Optimal truncation (Eckart-Young for tensors), tubal rank

entries.name: Takagi's factorization
entries.description: Takagi factorization: symmetric matrix A = UDU^T with U unitary, D non-negative diagonal.
entries.output: U * D * U^T (unitary * non-neg diagonal * unitary transpose)

entries.name: Tensor Ring (TR) decomposition
entries.description: Cyclic generalization of Tensor Train: connects last core back to first via trace.
entries.output: Ring of 3D cores {G_k} with trace contraction
entries.preserved: Removes boundary effects of TT, cyclic symmetry

entries.name: Tensor Train (TT) decomposition
entries.description: Factors high-dimensional tensor into linear chain of 3D cores: T(i1,...,id) = G1(i1) * G2(i2) * ... * Gd(id). Eliminates exponential parameter scaling.
entries.output: Chain of 3D cores {G_k} with T = G1*G2*...*Gd
entries.preserved: O(d*n*r^2) parameters vs O(n^d) original. Linear in dimension d.
entries.complexity: O(d * n * r^2) storage; O(d * n * r^3) per operation

entries.name: Topological sort transformation
entries.description: Vietoris-Rips filtration. See D4-416. D8 adds algorithmic complexity context.

entries.name: Transpose graph transformation
entries.description: Reverses every edge of a directed graph.

entries.name: Truth-table reduction
entries.description: All oracle queries and Boolean evaluation table determined before any oracle call. Total computation regardless of oracle answers.
entries.input: Decision problem A + computable query generator + truth table
entries.output: Algorithm solving A with predetermined B-queries

entries.name: Tucker decomposition
entries.description: Approximates a tensor as a small core multiplied by a factor matrix in each mode.

entries.name: Turing (Cook) reduction
entries.description: Computes core tensor G multiplied by factor matrices along each mode: T = G x_1 U_1 x_2 U_2 x_3 U_3. Flexible multi-way PCA.
entries.preserved: Multi-way interaction structure, flexible ranks per mode

entries.name: Two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: The bilateral Laplace transform F(s) = integral over R of f(t) e^{-s t} dt, converging in a vertical strip; contains the Fourier transform on the imaginary axis and the moment generating function.
entries.output: Analytic function F(s) on a strip
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information (invertible within the strip)
entries.broken: Causality information unless the strip is specified

entries.name: Uniform sketch transformation
entries.description: Samples rows (or columns) uniformly at random and rescales.
entries.preserved: Norms approximately when coherence is low

entries.name: Unit-Scale-Invariant SVD
entries.description: Unit-scale-invariant SVD: diagonal scaling invariant under unitary transformations.

entries.name: Variable gadget transformation
entries.description: Builds graph gadget encoding Boolean variable assignment in reduction proofs.
entries.output: Variable gadget (e.g., two nodes for T/F linked to clause gadgets)

entries.name: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) transformation
entries.description: Hybrid quantum-classical: parameterized quantum circuit minimized by classical optimizer for ground state energy.

entries.name: Vietoris-Rips complex filtration
entries.description: Builds the nested family of Vietoris-Rips complexes as the scale grows; input to persistent homology.
entries.preserved: Persistence diagram stable under Gromov-Hausdorff perturbation

entries.name: Watershed transform
entries.description: Topographic segmentation by basin-of-attraction of gradient flow.

entries.name: Williamson's normal form
entries.description: Symplectic congruence of 2n x 2n pos-def matrix to diagonal form with symplectic eigenvalues.

entries.name: Y-\u0394 (Wye-Delta) transformation
entries.description: Replaces a three-terminal star (Y) network by an equivalent triangle (Delta) with the same behavior at the terminals; in graph theory, a Y-Delta exchange.
entries.input: Electrical network or graph with a degree-3 vertex
entries.output: Network with a triangle replacing it

entries.name: Z-transform
entries.description: Transforms a sequence x_n to X(z) = sum x_n z^{-n}, converging in an annulus; the discrete analogue of the Laplace transform.
entries.preserved: Convolution to product; information within the region of convergence
entries.broken: Causality information unless the region is specified

entries.name: \u0394-Y (Delta-Wye) transformation
entries.description: Replaces a triangle (Delta) with an equivalent star (Y) with a new internal node.
entries.input: Network or graph with a triangle
entries.output: Network with a star replacing it

entries.name: \u010cech complex filtration
entries.description: Builds the nested Cech complexes (nerves of growing balls); by the nerve theorem each has the homotopy type of the union of balls.
entries.input: Point cloud in a metric space
entries.preserved: Homotopy type of ball unions at each scale

entries.name: Algebraic polar decomposition
entries.description: Polar decomposition in algebraic setting.

entries.name: B\u00e4cklund transform
entries.description: Generates new solutions of integrable PDEs (KdV, sine-Gordon) from known solutions.
entries.input: Solution u of integrable PDE + Backlund equations
entries.output: New solution u' of same/related PDE

entries.name: Block LU decomposition
entries.description: LU on block-partitioned matrices. Optimized for parallel architectures.
entries.preserved: Same as LU at block level

entries.name: Box-Muller transform
entries.description: Exact normal generation: Z0=sqrt(-2ln U1)cos(2pi U2), Z1=sqrt(-2ln U1)sin(2pi U2).

entries.name: Chirplet transform
entries.description: Time-frequency using chirp atoms (frequency-varying).

entries.name: Compact Singular Value Decomposition
entries.description: Keeps only the r nonzero singular values: A = U_r Sigma_r V_r*.

entries.name: Complete orthogonal decomposition
entries.description: A = UTV* with T triangular, U,V unitary. Robust SVD generalization.

entries.name: Continuous Wavelet Transform
entries.description: Maps signal against scaled/translated mother wavelet psi: W_f(a,b) = int f(t) psi*((t-b)/a) dt/sqrt(a). Multiresolution: high freq -> short window, low freq -> long window.
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients W_f(a,b) in scale-position plane
entries.preserved: Multi-resolution analysis, admissibility condition, reconstruction formula

entries.name: Daubechies wavelet transform
entries.description: Discrete wavelet transform with Daubechies' compactly supported orthogonal wavelets of maximal vanishing moments for their support.
entries.output: Wavelet coefficients by scale and position
entries.preserved: Energy (orthogonal); polynomial reproduction up to the vanishing moments

entries.name: Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)
entries.description: Expresses a finite real sequence as a sum of cosines at discrete frequencies (DCT-II in common use); concentrates the energy of smooth signals in few coefficients (JPEG).
entries.output: Real coefficient sequence of length N

entries.name: Double graph transformation
entries.description: Builds a doubled graph: two copies of the vertex set with u' adjacent to v when u is adjacent to v (the bipartite double cover, G x K2), or the variant adding edges within copies.
entries.preserved: Degree sequence (doubled); bipartiteness for the cover
entries.reading: Several variants in the literature; the bipartite double cover is taken as primary.

entries.name: Dynamization transformation
entries.description: Transforms static data structure to support dynamic updates via periodic rebuilding.
entries.output: Dynamic structure with O(log n) updates

entries.name: Eigendecomposition
entries.description: A = VDV^{-1}. Diagonalizes matrix. Enables A^n = VD^nV^{-1}.

entries.name: Euclidean distance transform
entries.description: Exact Euclidean distance from each point to nearest feature.

entries.name: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)
entries.description: Cooley-Tukey: divide-and-conquer factorization of DFT matrix into sparse factors. Reduces O(N^2) to O(N log N).
entries.input: Sequence of length N (preferably power of 2)
entries.preserved: Same as DFT (implementation, not mathematically distinct)

entries.name: Fine-grained reduction
entries.description: Establishes exact polynomial lower bounds (e.g., proves Ω(n^2) conditional on SETH).

entries.name: Finite Legendre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Legendre polynomials P_n on [-1,1].

entries.name: Fourier transform
entries.description: = D6-022 (Continuous Fourier transform). Primary entry.
entries.input: Function f in L^1(R) or L^2(R)
entries.output: Fourier transform f-hat in frequency domain

entries.name: Fractional Fourier transform
entries.description: F^alpha: continuous rotation by angle alpha in time-frequency plane. alpha=pi/2 gives standard Fourier.

entries.name: Gabor transform
entries.description: STFT with Gaussian window. Achieves minimum Heisenberg uncertainty product.

entries.name: Gelfand transform
entries.description: Maps commutative Banach algebra to algebra of continuous functions on maximal ideal space: a -> a-hat.
entries.input: Element a of commutative Banach algebra A

entries.name: Hadamard transform
entries.description: H_N = (1/sqrt(N)) [[H_{N/2}, H_{N/2}],[H_{N/2},-H_{N/2}]]. Recursive +/-1 matrix. = Walsh-Hadamard.
entries.preserved: Parseval, self-inverse (up to scaling), only +/- operations

entries.name: Hankel transform
entries.description: Kernel: t J_nu(ut) (Bessel function). For cylindrically symmetric functions. Diagonalizes radial Laplacian.

entries.name: Hough transform
entries.description: Maps points to parameter space for detecting geometric shapes (lines, circles).

entries.name: Inverse Laplace transform
entries.description: Bromwich integral: f(t) = (1/2pi i) int_{c-i inf}^{c+i inf} F(s)e^{st}ds.

entries.name: Inverse two-sided Laplace transform
entries.description: Recovers f from its bilateral Laplace transform by a Bromwich integral along a vertical line inside the strip of convergence.
entries.input: Analytic F(s) and its strip of convergence
entries.broken: Nothing, given the strip; without it the inverse is ambiguous

entries.name: Jacobi transform
entries.description: Kernel: Jacobi polynomial P_n^{(alpha,beta)}(x). Orthogonal on weighted [-1,1].

entries.name: Jordan decomposition
entries.description: Writes a square matrix as P J P^-1 with J block diagonal of Jordan blocks (over an algebraically closed field).
entries.output: Jordan form J and change of basis P
entries.preserved: Similarity class; eigenvalues with algebraic and geometric multiplicities

formal.note: Mathlib has the Jordan-Chevalley decomposition (f = nilpotent + semisimple, over a perfect field), which the Jordan normal form implies. The normal form itself is not in Mathlib at the pin. The name also matches Mathlib's Jordan decomposition of signed measures, a different theorem.

entries.name: Laguerre transform
entries.description: Expansion in Laguerre functions L_n(x)e^{-x/2}. Semi-infinite domain [0,inf).

entries.name: LDLT factorization
entries.description: Factors a symmetric matrix as L D L^T with L unit lower triangular and D diagonal (or block diagonal with pivoting).

entries.name: LDU decomposition
entries.description: Variant extracting diagonal: A = LDU.

entries.name: Linear canonical transform
entries.description: 4-parameter family (a,b,c,d) with ad-bc=1 generalizing Fourier, fractional Fourier, Laplace. Metaplectic group action.

entries.name: Logarithmic-space reduction
entries.description: Reduction using only O(log n) workspace. Defines P-completeness, NL-completeness.
entries.input: Decision problem A + log-space computable f
entries.output: f mapping A to B in log space

entries.name: Modified discrete cosine transform
entries.description: A lapped transform on overlapping blocks (2N inputs to N outputs) whose aliasing cancels between neighbors (Princen-Bradley); used in audio codecs.
entries.preserved: Perfect reconstruction with overlap-add (time-domain aliasing cancellation)

entries.name: Mycielskian transformation
entries.description: Builds M(G) raising the chromatic number by one while keeping the graph triangle-free.

entries.name: Number-theoretic transform
entries.description: DFT over finite field/ring Z/mZ. Exact integer arithmetic, no roundoff.

entries.name: Parallel graph composition
entries.description: Constructs networks by identifying the source terminals and sink terminals of two two-terminal graphs. Commutative.
entries.input: Two-terminal graphs (G_1, s_1, t_1), (G_2, s_2, t_2)
entries.output: Two-terminal graph with s_1=s_2 and t_1=t_2

entries.name: Perspective projection transformation
entries.description: Projects 3D points onto an image plane through a center: (x, y, z) to (f x / z, f y / z). A projective map.

entries.name: Poisson-Mellin-Newton cycle
entries.description: The triangle of correspondences between Poisson generating functions, Mellin transforms and Newton (finite difference) series used in the analysis of algorithms (Flajolet and coauthors): a sequence's asymptotics read from the poles of a Mellin transform via Rice's integrals.
entries.reading: Recorded from memory of the analytic-combinatorics literature.

entries.name: Polynomial-time counting reduction
entries.description: Reduces counting problem A to B in polynomial time so that the count for A is computable from counts for B (Turing or parsimonious-type counting reductions).
entries.output: Instances of B and a recovery map

entries.name: PTAS reduction
entries.description: Approximation-preserving reduction: a PTAS for B yields one for A; defines APX-completeness.
entries.output: Instance of B and solution map

entries.name: Quantile transform
entries.description: Maps data through its empirical distribution function and a target inverse CDF, giving uniform or normal marginals.
entries.output: Data with a chosen marginal distribution

entries.name: Randomized halving transformation
entries.description: Halving trick for randomized algorithms: reduces failure probability by median of repeated runs.

entries.name: Randomized reduction
entries.description: Probabilistic transformation between problems.

entries.name: Rank factorization
entries.description: A = CF where C is m x r full column rank, F is r x n full row rank.
entries.output: C (m x r) * F (r x n)

entries.name: Real Schur decomposition
entries.description: Real arithmetic Schur: T quasi-upper-triangular with 2x2 blocks for complex eigenvalue pairs.
entries.preserved: Real eigenvalues on diagonal, complex pairs in 2x2 blocks

entries.name: Rectangular mask short-time Fourier transform
entries.description: Short-time Fourier transform with a rectangular (boxcar) window: the Fourier transform of each windowed segment.
entries.preserved: Energy up to window normalization; invertibility with sufficient overlap
entries.broken: Frequency resolution (sidelobe leakage from the sharp window)

entries.name: Reverse accumulation transformation
entries.description: = D8-097 Reverse accumulation (adjoint mode AD). See D8-097.
entries.input: Source code of function f: R^n -> R^m
entries.output: Augmented program computing f and v^T J (vector-Jacobian product)
entries.preserved: Exact gradient (to machine precision), chain rule

entries.name: Scaling / Dilation transformation
entries.description: Scales about a center by a factor k: x to c + k (x - c).
entries.broken: Size (lengths scale by k, areas by k^2)

entries.name: Square transform
entries.description: Applies y = x^2 to data (for example to reduce left skew, or to energy).
entries.reading: Generic reading as the power transform with exponent 2.

entries.name: Stieltjes transformation
entries.description: S{dmu}(z) = int dmu(t)/(z-t). Cauchy-type transform of measure. Analytic in C \ support(mu).
entries.output: Analytic function S(z) on C \ supp(mu)
entries.preserved: Analyticity, measure recovery via Stieltjes inversion

entries.name: Translation transformation
entries.description: Shifts every point by a fixed vector.

entries.name: Voronoi diagram transformation
entries.description: Partitions space into cells of points nearest each site.

entries.name: Walsh-Hadamard transform
entries.description: Recursive +1/-1 matrix. Sequency analysis. Only addition/subtraction needed.
entries.preserved: Sequency decomposition, O(N log N) with no multiplication

entries.name: Weierstrass transform
entries.description: Gaussian convolution: W{f}(x) = (1/sqrt(4pi)) int f(t)e^{-(x-t)^2/4}dt. Heat equation propagator at t=1.
entries.output: Smoothed function Wf (heat diffusion at t=1)

entries.name: X-ray transform
entries.description: Line integrals of function: Xf(L) = int_L f. 1D Radon. Basis of X-ray tomography.
entries.preserved: Line integrability, inversion via filtered backprojection

entries.name: Strict transform under a point blow-up
entries.description: Carries a curve through the blow-up of a point on a surface: the closure of the preimage of the curve with the point removed. Blowing up a smooth point of the curve lowers its self-intersection by 1; a point of multiplicity m lowers it by m squared.
entries.input: Surface X, curve C through a point P, the blow-up of X at P
entries.output: Strict transform C' in the blown-up surface, meeting the exceptional curve with multiplicity m
entries.preserved: C away from P; for P a smooth point of C, C' is isomorphic to C
entries.broken: Self-intersection: C'^2 = C^2 - m^2. A (-1)-curve blown up at one of its points becomes a (-2)-curve, which no longer contracts to a smooth point

receipts.quote: Blowing up a smooth point of any divisor decreases its self-intersection by1.
blowing up that point leads to a strict transform with self-intersection e−m2.

entries.name: Aufhebung of a level
entries.description: For a level i of a topos (an essential subtopos, with its adjoint modality, skeleton left of sheaf), the least level j above i at which every i-skeleton is a j-sheaf (Lawvere). In the colloquial form: the least k such that n-skeletal implies k-coskeletal. It need not exist.
entries.input: Topos with its lattice of levels; a level i
entries.output: The least level j resolving the opposite of i (every i-skeleton a j-sheaf), when it exists
entries.preserved: The lower level's objects: i-skeleta survive as j-sheaves
entries.broken: The opposition at level i: the skeleton side is absorbed into the higher level's sheaf side. The step depends on the shape category: n to n+1 for reflexive globular sets, n to 2n-1 for simplicial sets (n > 1), n to 2n for cubical sets

receipts.quote: iff it is a minimal level which resolves the opposites of level $i$
amounts to saying that every $i$-skeleton is a $j$-sheaf
is called the Aufhebung of B′
for reﬂexive globular sets this is indeed the case
If a simplicial set is n-skeletal with n > 1, it is (2n− 1)-coskeletal.
The Aufhebung relation for the topos of cubical sets is 2n.

lean.note: i-skeleta survive as j-sheaves: the entry's field, true by the nLab's definition.
i-sheaves survive as j-sheaves: the Aufhebung lies above i.
The least resolving level, when it exists, is unique up to having the same sheaves.

entries.name: Littlewood-Paley dyadic decomposition
entries.description: Splits a function into pieces with frequencies in dyadic annuli, 2^k to 2^(k+1), by Fourier multipliers (sharp or smooth cutoffs); the band index k is a scale. Used in place of orthogonality arguments outside L^2.
entries.input: Function f (on R^n, or a field on a domain)
entries.output: Band pieces f_k, one per dyadic frequency annulus, summing to f
entries.preserved: f itself (the pieces sum to it); in L^2 the pieces are orthogonal; in L^p comparable norms through the square function
entries.broken: Spatial locality (each band piece is spread in space by the uncertainty principle); pointwise identity of the pieces

receipts.quote: uses a decomposition of a function ''f'' into a sum of functions ''f''<sub>''ρ''</sub> with localized frequencies.
this gives a so-called "dyadic decomposition" of ''f''
It is typically used as a substitute for orthogonality arguments

entries.name: Duhamel propagation of a source
entries.description: Solves an inhomogeneous linear evolution by superposing homogeneous evolutions started at all earlier times, each with the source at that time as its initial impulse: u(t) = integral from 0 to t of G(t,s) f(s) ds, with G the propagator.
entries.input: Linear evolution operator (a propagator G(t,s)), source f(s)
entries.output: The solution u(t), or its projection onto a chosen mode: the integral of the pairing of G(t,s)* applied to the mode with f(s)
entries.preserved: Linearity: sources superpose; causality (only earlier times contribute)
entries.broken: Instantaneous locality: a source's effect at time t depends on its whole propagated history, so a pairing that vanishes at each instant can be nonzero after propagation

receipts.quote: the solution to an inhomogeneous, linear, partial differential equation can be solved by first finding the solution for a step input, and then superposing
superposing homogeneous evolutions started at all earlier times

entries.name: Kramers escape rate
entries.description: The rate at which a noisy particle in a potential well escapes over a barrier, in the overdamped regime: k = (w_a w_H / 2 pi gamma) exp(-(E_H - E_A)/k_B T). Mean lifetime is 1/k, so log lifetime is the barrier height over the noise, up to a prefactor.
entries.input: One-dimensional potential with a well and a barrier; damping gamma; noise temperature
entries.preserved: The exponential dependence on barrier height over noise; the well and barrier curvatures enter only the prefactor
entries.broken: Path detail inside the well (only the barrier height and two curvatures survive); valid when the barrier is high against the noise

receipts.quote: was able to derive a relationship between the shape of the potential-energy surface along the reaction coordinate and the transition rates of the system.
\frac{\omega_a\omega_H}{2\pi\gamma}\exp\left(-\frac{E_H-E_A}{k_\text{B}T}\right)

entries.name: First passage time of Brownian motion
entries.description: The time a Brownian motion first reaches a fixed level: Levy distributed (heavy t^(-3/2) tail, infinite mean) without drift; inverse Gaussian with mean distance/drift when drifting toward the level. The model for lifetimes ending at an adverse threshold.
entries.input: Brownian motion (diffusion constant, drift) and a threshold at a given distance
entries.output: Distribution of the first hitting time
entries.preserved: Scaling with distance: mean distance/drift with drift toward the threshold; typical time distance^2/D without drift
entries.broken: Finite mean without drift (the Levy tail); any exponential dependence on distance (there is no well)

receipts.quote: When the process reaches an adverse threshold state for the first time, the patient dies, or the device breaks down.
The first-passage time for a Brownian particle therefore follows a [[Lévy distribution]].
the inverse Gaussian describes the distribution of the time a Brownian motion with positive drift takes to reach a fixed positive level.

entries.name: Inclusion of a subtopos
entries.description: Takes a subtopos, such as the j-sheaves of a Lawvere-Tierney topology, to its inclusion into the ambient topos: a geometric embedding, whose direct image is fully faithful and whose inverse image (sheafification) is a left exact left adjoint.
entries.input: Subtopos Sh_j(E) of a topos E
entries.output: Geometric embedding i: Sh_j(E) into E (a geometric morphism with fully faithful direct image)
entries.preserved: Limits (the inclusion is a right adjoint); the subtopos's objects, unchanged
entries.broken: Nothing; it names the morphism implicit in the subtopos

receipts.quote: of [j-sheaves](#JSheaf) is a [[geometric embedding]].
the embedding is a [[full and faithful functor]] which has a [[exact functor|left exact]] [[left adjoint]] functor

lean.note: The inclusion of a subtopos preserves limits.
The inclusion is a geometric morphism with the reflector as inverse image.
Its direct image is fully faithful: a geometric embedding.

formal.note: For a Grothendieck topology, the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves creates limits. Grothendieck topologies give the subtoposes of presheaf toposes; the general Lawvere-Tierney case is not in Mathlib at the pin.
Sheafification is left exact, for Grothendieck topologies and coefficient categories meeting the stated hypotheses.
Any right adjoint preserves limits; the inclusion of a subtopos is right adjoint to sheafification (the entry's description).

entries.name: Level of an essential inclusion
entries.description: Takes an essential geometric embedding (an adjoint triple whose right end is fully faithful) to the level it defines: an essential subtopos, carrying the adjoint pair of modalities skeleton left of sheaf.
entries.input: Essential geometric embedding i_! left of i^* left of i_*
entries.output: Level (essential subtopos) with modalities: skeleton left of sheaf
entries.preserved: The adjoint triple (the level is its image); the subtopos
entries.broken: Nothing; it reads the triple as a level

receipts.quote: is called a _level_ of $\mathbf{H}$. This is equivalently the inclusion of the [[right adjoint]] of an [[adjoint cylinder]]/[[adjoint modality]].
yields two [[adjoint modalities]]

lean.note: The inclusion of a level is an essential geometric morphism: the entry's input kind.
The middle functor i^* of the triple preserves limits.
The middle functor i^* preserves colimits.
The level carries the adjoint modalities skeleton ⊣ sheaf: the opposition at the level.
The skeleton modality, whose fixed objects are the level's skeleta.

formal.note: In the triple i_! left of i^* left of i_*, the middle functor i^* is a right adjoint, so it preserves limits.
The middle functor i^* is also a left adjoint, so it preserves colimits.
